5c7614f1.title: Solution Architect, Retail ERP & Integration
5c7614f1.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect, Retail ERP to join our IT team, reporting to the Director, Retail ERP. In this role, you will design and implement solutions that connect our Retail ERP system with POS, and other platforms, bridging business requirements and technical implementation to ensure efficient data flow, real-time synchronisation, and optimal performance across our global systems.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements and architectural design
* Design, build, and integrate information systems that meet business objectives, ensuring seamless data exchange between ERP, POS, and other systems
* Develop and maintain the overall architecture for MS Business Central in retail, ensuring interoperability, data consistency, scalability, and flexibility
* Address functional/technical challenges as they arise, and troubleshoot issues related to data synchronisation, security, and performance
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for MS Business Central, including design specifications, data mapping, and configuration details
* Communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, keeping them informed of progress, challenges, and proposed solutions.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of experience as a Solution Architect or in a similar role, including previous project implementation experience in MS Business Central or MS D365 F&O is required.
* Solid knowledge of retail business and financial processes, knowledge of retail medical or audiology systems. and MS Business Central is advantageous
* Experience with systems integration using APIs (REST/SOAP), message buses (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ), ETL pipelines, and enterprise service buses (e.g. MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Azure Integration Services)
* Familiarity with Agile principles, data modelling and synchronisation techniques, and authentication/authorisation standards (OAuth2, SAML, JWT)
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Good communication skills, with English required and additional languages advantageous.

**Who We Are**
At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
  
  
Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
  
  
With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
  
  
Sounds wonderful? We can’t wait to hear from you.
  
  
*WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

7bd58f3f.title: Solution Architect (Backend - Node.JS/Java), AWS, AI)
7bd58f3f.description:
**Department:**
61-870 - Technology - Architecture

**Location:**
India - Hyderabad

**Description**
**The Role:**
As a Solution Architect, you will lead the architecture and solution design of large-scale technology initiatives spanning multiple systems across the OTT platform ecosystem. You will be responsible for translating business and product requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable technical solutions that align with the organization's strategic objectives. Our culture is highly delivery-focused, and the role extends well beyond producing architecture diagrams and design documentation. You will work closely with product, engineering, program management, operations, and external partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing hands-on architectural guidance, resolving technical challenges, managing design trade-offs, and ensuring successful implementation of solutions through to production release.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture and solution design of strategic initiatives across the OTT platform ecosystem, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology strategy.
* Drive architectural evolution by assessing existing systems, identifying improvement opportunities, and challenging established assumptions and technical constraints, including the pragmatic application of AI-enabled tools and capabilities where they deliver measurable value.
* Own solution delivery from concept through implementation, providing technical leadership, resolving complex challenges, and ensuring successful outcomes.
* Design scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions, defining both functional and non-functional requirements and producing key architectural artifacts, including requirements for responsible AI use, data privacy, security, observability, and governance where AI capabilities are involved.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, delivery, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles, standards, and best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and gaps, and drive continuous quality improvement.
* Support engineering teams throughout delivery with architectural guidance, governance, and decision-making for complex technical issues; promote effective and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering and delivery practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and OTT best practices, and relevant AI capabilities to enhance platform capabilities, engineering efficiency, and long-term architectural sustainability.

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**
**You’ll be set up for success if you have:**

* 10+ years' experience as a Solution Architect or similar role, designing and delivering large-scale technology solutions in complex environments.
* Deep understanding of OTT platform architectures and domains, including subscriptions, monetisation, identity and access management (IAM), content and metadata management, and related platform services.
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, distributed systems using Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) principles.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures and services, preferably AWS.
* Strong solution design expertise, including integration and management of third-party vendor solutions and in-house platforms.
* **AI fluency:**
  Practical understanding of generative AI, machine learning and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve architecture, analysis, documentation, engineering productivity, and problem solving, while validating outputs and retaining appropriate technical judgement.
* Ability to assess AI use cases, dependencies, risks and non-functional requirements.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, with hands-on experience in technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, or Go, and strong knowledge of database technologies. Proven ability to solve complex business and technology challenges, navigate ambiguity, and drive effective technical outcomes.
* Experience analysing and optimising business processes, operating models, and technology landscapes.
* Strong documentation skills and experience applying industry-standard architecture and design methodologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

**Even better if you have:**

* Experience designing and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.
* Experience integrating payment providers, subscription billing platforms, and related monetisation services. Experience working with external vendors and partners, including content security, authentication, authorisation, and platform protection.
* Experience designing event-driven integrations, data pipelines, and asynchronous workflows using messaging and streaming technologies.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including Scrum, backlog refinement, and technical planning.

50224282.title: Five9- Lead Business Transformation Architect- Sales & Service- Customer
50224282.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**#S&SArchitect**
#CCaaS
  
  
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level**
: Lead Business Transformation Architect
  
  
As a Lead Business Transformation Architect/ Specialist Master at Deloitte Consulting, you will drive the design, implementation, and delivery of cutting-edge artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
We are looking for a seasoned Five9 CCaaS Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise-grade cloud contact center solutions built on the Five9 Intelligent CX Platform. This is a senior technical role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, AI-driven automation, and client advisory — equal parts strategist and builder.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on Five9 expertise, a strong grasp of modern CCaaS architecture patterns, and the communication fluency to translate complex technical decisions into clear business value for clients and stakeholders.
  
  

* Solution Design & Architecture: Lead end-to-end CCaaS solution design — from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment, and rollout. Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Five9 architectures that align with client goals and industry best practices.
* Technical Leadership & Governance: Serve as the primary technical authority across multiple concurrent client engagements. Conduct solution and code reviews, establish architecture governance standards, and maintain quality assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Five9 Platform Configuration & Deployment: Design and configure the full breadth of Five9 capabilities including VCC Core, ACD/IVR/IVA (Intelligent Virtual Agent) with complex call flows, outbound campaigns and predictive dialing logic, Workforce Automation (WFA), Quality Management (QM/WEM), digital channels, and AI-driven features such as Five9 Genius AI.
* Integration & Connectivity Architecture: Architect and implement enterprise-grade integrations with CRM and ITSM platforms — including Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, and Zendesk — using Five9's pre-built adapters and the Agent Desktop Toolkit Plus (ADT+). 7 8 Design and implement REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, and advanced scripting. Implement identity and authentication frameworks including SSO, SAML, and OAuth.
* AI & Automation Strategy: Drive the adoption of Five9's Genius AI capabilities — including Intelligent Voice Assistants, AI-powered Agent Assist, the AI Summary Node, Knowledge Node (RAG-based), and the AI Trust & Governance framework. Provide architectural guidance on deploying responsible, hallucination-aware AI within the contact center environment. 9 10 Stay ahead of Five9's evolving Agentic CX roadmap and help clients position for next-generation capabilities.
* Performance Optimization & Reporting: Configure dashboards, real-time reporting, and supervisor tools to monitor and continuously optimize contact center operations. Guide clients on best practices for scalability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution
* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning application, platform, network, cloud, and telecom layers. Drive rapid resolution with minimal disruption to customer-facing operations.
* Collaboration, Scoping & Delivery: Partner with project managers for accurate effort estimation, scoping, risk management, and on-time delivery. Lead and mentor engineers, consultants, and junior delivery team members to elevate technical capability and solution quality across the team.
* Client Engagement & Presentations: Deliver compelling client-facing presentations, solution demonstrations, and value propositions. Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.

**The team:**
Our Sales & Service team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients’ brand values for measurable business growth. We help clients turn business values into measurable growth through creatively driven, personalized content, communications, and experiences that engage and inspire people to act. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients’ marketing and engagement operations into modern, data-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i.e, Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 5+ years of hands-on architecture experience with the Five9 Intelligent CX Platform, including VCC, IVR/IVA, WFA, QM/WEM, and digital channels
* Advanced understanding of CCaaS architecture patterns, enterprise scalability design, and cloud contact center infrastructure
* Solid understanding of core contact center operations: ACD, IVR, CTI, and CRM integration workflows
* Experience migrating legacy on-premise contact centers to Five9 cloud environments
* Proficiency in enterprise integration design using REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, and scripting languages (JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
* Strong command of authentication protocols: SSO, SAML, OAuth
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications in CX — chatbots, virtual agents, predictive analytics, agent assist, and GenAI-driven capabilities
* Awareness of compliance and security frameworks relevant to CCaaS: PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR
* Bonus: Server-side development experience in Node.js, Java, PHP, or .NET
* Excellent communication and documentation skills with the ability to present confidently to executive and technical audiences
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop delivery teams
* Strong client advisory mindset — able to frame technical decisions in terms of business outcomes

**Good To Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**

* Five9 Certifications: Five9 Certified Administrator, Five9 Certified Implementor, or Global Partner Certified Implementation Partner credentials are highly desirable
* AI/GenAI Certifications: A plus, given the growing centrality of Genius AI and agentic workflows in Five9 deployments

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Microsoft 365 solution architecture**
**/ Technical manager 1-2**
–

EY GDS Consulting – Digital is seeking an experienced Microsoft 365 Architect with a strong background in building and modernizing enterprise collaboration and content solutions. The role sits within the Enterprise Content and Modern Work practice, delivering integrated, compliant, and scalable solutions to clients across multiple regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for professionals with deep expertise in Microsoft 365 solution architecture, custom development, and integration to join our Digital Engineering Consulting team. This role offers the opportunity to work with a leading global organization, contribute to complex transformation and modernization initiatives, and play a key role in shaping and growing our modern workplace and integration service offerings.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Produces high-quality solution or infrastructure deliverables in accordance with project timelines and specifications, using sound coding and programming skills
* Performs coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project
* Maintains and enhances systems by fixing complicated errors, raising risks and escalating issues where necessary
* Works with users to capture detailed requirements, translating designs and solution architecture into design specifications
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and seeks areas for continuous improvement
* Ensures all activities adhere to the relevant processes, procedures, standards and technical design
* Develop and promote best practices for usage, operations and development
* Strong analytical and communication skills with intense drive to learn and adopt.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 7–12 years of experience in enterprise solution architecture and development
* Strong hands-on experience with:

+ SharePoint Framework (SPFx)
+ Microsoft Teams app development
+ .NET / C#
+ REST APIs and integration patterns

* Proven experience designing enterprise-grade M365 solutions
* Strong understanding of modern workplace concepts (collaboration, productivity, extensibility)
* Excellent architectural thinking beyond platform-specific constraints
* Experience designing integrated solutions across multiple systems
* Strong understanding of cloud-native and modern application architectures
* Ability to define standards, patterns, and best practices

**Core Skills:**

* Microsoft 365 & SharePoint: SPFx development, PnP Framework, PowerShell automation
* Application Development: .NET, C#, React, Azure Functions, enterprise-grade solution design
* Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents with governance awareness
* Dataverse: Data modeling, APIs, security, and integration with Power Platform and custom apps
* Integration Architecture: REST & SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, secure enterprise integrations
* Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control

**Desirable Skills:**

* Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
* Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
* AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
* Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
* Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
* PCF Controls: Custom PowerApps Component Framework development using React and TypeScript

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent Communication Skills
* Team Player
* Self-starter and highly motivated
* Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
* Excellent presentation skills
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree
* Strong experience across Microsoft SharePoint (on‑premises and online), with the ability to modernize and extend solutions beyond platform constraints
* Proven hands-on expertise with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps, and Power Automate for building modern, extensible business solutions
* Strong front-end development skills using TypeScript, React, Angular, and Fluent UI, with an emphasis on scalable and reusable components
* Solid experience with PowerShell and PnP for automation, provisioning, and enterprise governance
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to operate as a solution architect and trusted advisor

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**About EY**
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.
  
  
**If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.**
**Join us in building a better working world.**
**Apply now**
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The GTDA FinOps Strategy, Governance & Value Realization team sits at the intersection of technology, business, and finance. The team partners across Cloud Engineering, Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, Finance, and business leadership to improve cost transparency, capacity planning, optimization accountability, and investment value realization. Its mission is to build trusted reporting, governance standards, and decision-ready insights that help TransUnion manage cloud and infrastructure spend more effectively while enabling sustainable technology growth

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

We are looking for a data-driven, analytically minded Consultant to join TransUnion’s Enterprise Cloud Economics / FinOps team. This role sits at the **intersection of technology, business, and finance** , helping TransUnion improve how it understands, governs, and optimizes cloud, AI, and infrastructure spend.

In this role, you will transform raw cost, usage, and capacity data into transparent dashboards, actionable insights, and measurable business value. You will partner closely with Technology Strategy & Governance, Cloud Engineering, Finance, Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, and business stakeholders to support FinOps governance, cost transparency, capacity planning, optimization tracking, and executive reporting.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who enjoys connecting technical data with financial discipline and business decision-making in a large-scale enterprise technology environment.

* Build and maintain cloud, AI, and infrastructure cost dashboards for leadership, engineering, finance, and business stakeholders.
* Analyze cloud spend, infrastructure usage, capacity trends, cost variances, and optimization opportunities.
* Translate technical cost and capacity data into business and financial insights that support executive decision-making.
* Produce monthly reporting inputs, executive scorecards, and governance materials for cloud and AI economics.
* Develop capacity utilization reporting across cloud compute, storage, database, network, server, VMware, middleware, and related infrastructure domains.
* Consolidate demand signals from engineering and business teams into a forward-looking view of capacity requirements.
* Support performance and capacity analysis by working with application and platform owners on right-sizing, configuration, query/index optimization, and infrastructure improvement opportunities.
* Track cloud commitments, reservations, savings plans, committed-use discounts, GPU utilization, and other capacity or consumption-based economics.
* Manage the optimization pipeline from opportunity intake through prioritization, implementation, and Finance-validated value realization.
* Identify spend accountability gaps and help route ownership to the appropriate engineering, product, platform, or business teams.
* Support the FinOps governance calendar, ensuring operational changes align with finance close, forecasting, budgeting, and planning cycles.
* Partner cross-functionally across technology, business, and finance teams to improve cost transparency, accountability, and measurable outcomes.

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Experience in cloud financial management, capacity planning, IT finance, infrastructure reporting, or a related analytical field.
* Working understanding of enterprise infrastructure including server, storage, network, virtualization (VMware), database, middleware, and common operating systems.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure and business capacity planning, with demonstrated reporting and performance analysis skills.
* Working knowledge of public cloud platforms — GCP and/or AWS — including cloud cost fundamentals such as committed-use discounts, savings plans, tagging, and resource lifecycle.
* Proficiency in Google BigQuery for querying and analyzing cloud cost and usage datasets.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in reporting and analysis tools including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with cloud cost tooling such as Harness CCM is a plus.
* Experience building capacity utilization reports across storage, server, VMware, database, and network infrastructure domains.
* Ability to manage current usage statistics and develop projected growth estimates from business demand signals.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills — able to translate complex infrastructure and cost data into actionable insights for audiences at all levels.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
* Self-starter who works well independently and collaborates effectively within a cross-functional team.
* The ability to socialize ideas, make recommendations, and gather team consensus to move initiatives forward.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Familiarity with FinOps principles and frameworks — FinOps Foundation certification (FOCP or equivalent) is a plus.
* Scripting or automation skills such as VBA, PowerShell, or SQL to improve reporting efficiency.
* Experience with Splunk or similar observability/analytics platforms for infrastructure performance analysis.
* Experience integrating cloud economics data into financial planning workflows such as forecasting, budgeting, or chargeback/showback.
* Background supporting a federated or matrixed technology organization.
* Familiarity with workflow and ticketing systems such as JIRA or ServiceNow/Remedy.
* Experience with AI/ML or GPU infrastructure cost reporting and governance.
  

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

**Position: Project Manager - Language PMU**

**About:**

  
  

Aligned with NEP 2020, the Language Division PMU supports impact assessment and strategic directions for language institutions. The project maps the national language ecosystem, reviews institutional mandates and governance, strengthens outreach and digital visibility, and develops a performance-linked funding framework. The Project Manager will hold direct ownership of the Ministry and institutional relationship, lead a multidisciplinary team, and be accountable for institutional review and overall PMU delivery, bringing experience of managing central Ministry of Education engagements on the transformation of national institutions, higher education policy and financing, and technical education and skilling systems.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

1. Lead PMU planning, team coordination and timely delivery across concurrent workstreams, holding overall management responsibility at every level of the engagement; set quality standards and review mechanisms; track milestones, risks and dependencies, and conduct weekly progress reviews.

2. Lead institutional diagnosis and mandate assessment across language institutions, reviewing functions, governance structures, overlaps, performance and NEP 2020 alignment, and recommend structural changes to improve institutional functioning and ranking.

3. Coordinate merger, integration, specialization and role-rationalization analysis with the restructuring specialist; develop future institutional roles and implementation roadmaps, and support institutions from diagnosis through execution.

4. Oversee institution and scheme data collection, field visits, validation and analysis of courses, enrolment, faculty capacity and emerging demand to build the national language landscape, including which courses to add or retire, examination and quality gaps, and linkage of language programmes with job-market demand.

5. Guide the funding specialist in reviewing grants and expenditure, assessing alternate financing mechanisms at student, institutional and systemic levels, defining outcome KPIs and benchmarks, and developing institutional scorecards and a performance-linked funding framework.

6. Coordinate flagship initiative mapping, success stories, communications, digital visibility and outreach planning; lead the digital transformation workstream, including the introduction of AI and language technologies, and oversee minister-facing and administrative dashboard requirements.

7. Manage Ministry, State and institutional consultations with Secretaries, Joint Secretaries, Vice Chancellors, faculty, students and state education departments; synthesize specialist inputs into assessment reports, policy reports, concept notes, strategy documents, presentations and implementation plans.

8. Identify integration of language institutions with national missions, skilling priorities and other Ministries' initiatives, and author strategy documents on integration opportunities under the guidance of senior Ministry officials.

9. Support capacity building of institutional leadership and faculty, including training-needs analysis, professional development plans and pedagogy training, to embed recommended reforms.

e43bb598.title: Project Manager — Cloud, Data & Business Applications
e43bb598.description:
**Practice**
Delivery Management, Avanade India
  
  
**Location**
Bengaluru / Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid, with client travel)
  
  
**Experience**
12–15 years in IT, with proven delivery ownership of projects in one or more of cloud migration and application modernisation, data transformation, or CRM/ERP transformation — running teams of eight to ten people, with hands-on delivery experience on Microsoft technologies
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India is looking for a Project Manager to take end-to-end delivery ownership of client projects across cloud modernisation, data and business applications. This is a delivery leadership role for someone who has carried the plan, the budget, the team and the client relationship on real projects — not only reported on them.
  
  
You will run projects with teams distributed across different locations, own scope, schedule, cost, quality and risk, and be the client’s day-to-day point of accountability. We are not looking for experience in every domain: depth in one or two — cloud migration, application modernisation, data transformation, or a CRM or ERP programme — matters more than shallow coverage of all four. Experience delivering on Microsoft technologies is expected, as most of our work sits on the Microsoft stack.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of client projects — initiation, planning, execution, go-live and closure — against agreed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Build and maintain the project plan: work breakdown, estimates, dependencies, critical path, milestones and release schedule.
* Lead a delivery team of consisting of architects, developers, testers and analysts, including distributed onshore and offshore members.
* Own the commercials of the project — budget, forecast, effort tracking, resource utilization, revenue recognition and margin — and flag variance early.
* Run governance: steering committees, weekly status, RAID logs, dashboards and reporting to client and internal stakeholders.
* Manage scope and change control — impact assessment, change requests, re-baselining and the commercial conversation that goes with them.
* Identify, track and mitigate risks and issues, and escalate with a recommendation rather than only a problem.
* Act as the client’s day-to-day delivery contact, building trust with business and IT stakeholders and managing expectations through the difficult parts of a project.
* Run delivery in the method the engagement needs — agile, waterfall or hybrid — including sprint ceremonies, backlog management and release planning.
* Coordinate the delivery lifecycle across teams: requirements, design, build, testing (SIT/UAT), data migration, cutover, hypercare and transition to support.
* Manage resourcing and onboarding, workload allocation and knowledge continuity across the team.
* Hold quality and compliance — delivery standards, documentation, security and client policy requirements — and prepare for internal and client audits.
* Manage third parties, client teams and Microsoft or partner resources where they form part of the delivery.
* Support presales and account growth — estimation, delivery approach, plans for proposals, and identifying extension opportunities on live projects.
* Coach team members and junior project managers, and contribute delivery templates and lessons learned to the practice.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12–15 years of overall IT experience, with at least 5–6 years managing project delivery end to end.
* Proven delivery of projects in one or more of: cloud migration, application modernization, data platform or data transformation, and CRM or ERP transformation.
* Experience delivering on Microsoft technologies — Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Fabric or the wider stack.
* Demonstrated experience running teams of upto 15-20 resources, including distributed onshore and offshore members.
* Strong command of project management disciplines: estimation, planning, scheduling, budgeting, RAID management, change control and reporting.
* Hands-on with project management and delivery tooling — Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Planner, Excel-based tracking and reporting dashboards.
* Experience running both agile and waterfall delivery, and knowing which one a given engagement actually needs.
* Commercial awareness — managing budget, effort, utilization and margin, and handling scope and change commercially.
* Strong client-facing skills — steering committee presence, stakeholder management, and holding difficult conversations well.
* Experience across the full delivery lifecycle including testing, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare.
* Clear written communication — status reports, plans, governance packs and escalation notes at client-ready quality.

**Qualifications**

* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, Certified ScrumMaster or SAFe; Microsoft fundamentals certifications such as AZ-900, MS-900, PL-900 or DP-900.
* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar).
* Experience managing fixed-price as well as time-and-materials engagements.
* Exposure to programme management — coordinating several workstreams or projects under one client outcome.
* Background as a technical or functional consultant before moving into delivery management.
* Experience with client-side change management and adoption workstreams alongside technical delivery.
* Industry depth in one or more of BFSI, manufacturing, retail, energy, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience working with Microsoft field or partner teams on co-delivered engagements.
* Contribution to delivery accelerators, templates, estimation models or practice-building initiatives.

We are looking for an experienced **Automotive Program Manager** to lead exterior workstreams for a premium sports-car program based onsite in the UK.

The ideal candidate will have experience coordinating exterior product development, managing cross-functional interfaces, and driving program delivery from design maturity through validation and production readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead end-to-end program delivery for automotive exterior systems, ensuring milestones, deliverables, timelines, quality, and cost targets are met.
* Coordinate exterior workstreams covering areas such as bumpers, fenders, hood, doors, closures, tailgate or decklid, exterior trim, glazing interfaces, lighting interfaces, and sealing systems, as applicable.
* Demonstrate expert proficiency in CATIA V5, with exposure to NX and other PLM tools.
* Manage program plans, gateways, deliverables, risks, dependencies, engineering changes, and issue-resolution activities.
* Coordinate with styling, Class-A, design engineering, packaging, CAE, aerodynamics, lighting, validation, manufacturing, purchasing, quality, and supplier teams.
* Track surface and design maturity, fit-and-finish, gap-and-flush, interface resolution, validation status, and engineering release readiness.
* Lead customer and stakeholder reviews, communicate program status and escalations, and drive closure of open actions.
* Manage supplier deliverables and support the resolution of technical, timing, quality, tooling, and manufacturing issues.
* Ensure exterior development activities align with program requirements, applicable safety and regulatory requirements, and OEM processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of extensive experience in automotive exterior systems, along with 2–3 years of proven experience in Program Management.
* Proven automotive program management experience in exterior systems for premium, luxury, or sports-car programs.
* Experience working on Ferrari Amalfi, Aston Martin DB12, or McLaren vehicle programs will be considered an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of exterior development, styling-to-engineering handover, fit-and-finish, gap-and-flush, validation, and production-readiness processes.
* Experience managing schedules, risks, issues, engineering changes, milestones, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Excellent customer-facing communication, stakeholder management, reporting, and escalation skills.
* Must be willing to travel and work onsite in the UK as per project/customer needs and continue supporting the program from India upon return.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with European premium OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers.
* Familiarity with automotive PLM systems, BOM/change management, and program tracking tools.
* Experience coordinating Class-A, tooling, and supplier industrialization activities.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Opportunity to contribute to a premium European automotive program.
* Work onsite with international customer and engineering teams.
* Collaborate across vehicle development functions on a high-profile sports-car program.

Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. **Business Unit**

BXTI – Finance & Operations Technology

**Business Description**

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTi) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone’s businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTi is nimble and entrepreneurial – our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development mean that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge.

**Job Title**

Senior Vice President – Program Manager

**Job Description**

Blackstone is seeking a best-in-class Senior Vice President, Program Manager to shape and lead technology-enabled initiatives across its Finance and Operations Technology portfolio. Based in Bangalore, this leader will define the long-term direction and own the delivery of complex, multi-year programs spanning corporate finance, procurement, treasury, and fund accounting platforms, partnering closely with Finance, Treasury, Fund Operations, and Technology leadership across global offices.

The ideal candidate pairs deep corporate finance technology expertise (for example Oracle, Coupa, treasury management, and fund calculation platforms) with strategic foresight, exceptional problem-solving skills, strong program leadership, and a hands-on technical mindset. This person will anticipate future business and technology needs, use AI and data thoughtfully to improve decisions and delivery, and set the standard for program leadership in Bangalore. The role requires equal comfort shaping a compelling long-term vision, presenting recommendations to executive steering committees, and driving disciplined sprint-level execution in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of finance and operations technology programs, including general ledger, financial close, procure-to-pay, treasury and cash management, and fund calculation and allocation platforms.
* Own program strategy, target-state roadmaps, and multi-year delivery plans, anticipating future business capabilities and technology needs while translating objectives from the CFO organization, Controllers, Treasury, Tax, Procurement, and Fund Operations into clear priorities, requirements, and execution milestones.
* Drive large-scale implementations, upgrades, and integrations of enterprise platforms such as Oracle (Fusion/EBS), Coupa, treasury management systems (e.g. Kyriba, FIS Quantum, or ION), and fund accounting and waterfall engines.
* Establish and run program governance, including steering committees, executive status reporting, RAID management, budget and resource tracking, and benefits realization.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, data, architecture, information security, finance operations, and third-party vendors and system integrators, across Bangalore, New York, and other global locations, leveraging tools such as JIRA, Sigma, and Excel for planning, tracking, and analysis.
* Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior finance and technology leaders, structuring ambiguous problems, identifying root causes, developing practical options, and prioritizing investments based on long-term value, risk, scalability, and business impact.
* Manage vendor and system integrator relationships, including statements of work, delivery oversight, commercial tracking, and escalation.
* Define and track program success metrics (for example close-cycle time, straight-through processing rates, reconciliation breaks, and user adoption), using data and AI-enabled analysis where appropriate to surface insights, improve forecasting, strengthen decisions, and drive continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who work well in a team-driven working group, are highly motivated, intelligent, have sound judgment and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors.

  

* 15+ years of experience in financial services technology, with at least 8 years leading large, complex programs as a program manager, delivery lead, or senior technical project manager.
* Deep, hands-on experience delivering corporate finance technology, such as Oracle ERP (Fusion or EBS), Coupa, treasury management systems, and fund accounting, fund calculation, or waterfall and allocation platforms.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance and fund operations concepts, including general ledger, consolidation, financial close, accounts payable, cash management, fees, carried interest, capital calls and distributions, and investor allocations, and how they translate into data, systems, and processes.
* Proven track record delivering multi-workstream, cross-regional programs in a high-expectation environment, ideally at a top-tier asset manager, private equity firm, investment bank, or leading technology or consulting organization.
* Experience leading distributed teams and working across time zones, including partnering with US- and Europe-based stakeholders from an India delivery center.

* Demonstrated critical thinking beyond immediate delivery, define a credible long-term vision and roadmap, and connect near-term priorities to broader business, operating model, data, and technology outcomes while remaining close to execution.
* Exceptional problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complex and incomplete information, challenges assumptions constructively, and drives decisions and outcomes without heavy supervision.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, to build clear, visually compelling executive materials; synthesize complex information into a concise narrative; facilitate decision-oriented discussions; and tailor messages for technical, business, and senior leadership audiences.

* High level of critical and systems thinking, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and professionalism, to evaluate second-order impacts and make balanced recommendations aligned with Blackstone’s culture of and performance.
* Proficiency with JIRA (or similar tools) for backlog management, sprint planning, portfolio and program tracking, and status reporting.
* Solid understanding of finance system integration patterns, including ERP interfaces, bank connectivity (SWIFT, host-to-host, payment file formats), subledger and journal feeds, and master data management.
* Strong understanding of modern system architectures, including cloud-native and SaaS platforms, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, event-driven integrations, and enterprise application ecosystems.
* Experience partnering with technology teams on data model reviews, technical requirements, solution architecture, and end-to-end delivery across upstream and downstream platforms.
* Command of both Agile and waterfall delivery, including SDLC governance, DevOps concepts, release planning, testing coordination, environment management, and production implementation readiness.
* Hands-on, resourceful, and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership over delivering outcomes rather than just managing processes.
* Forward-looking, curious, analytical, and intellectually rigorous, to connect market, business, data, and technology trends to a practical long-term strategy.
* Confident and credible with senior leaders, to present a clear point of view, communicate complex trade-offs simply, influence decisions, and navigate competing priorities with maturity and discretion.
* A leader who builds trust across geographies and develops talent within the Bangalore team.
* Strong alignment with Blackstone’s values, including ethical judgment teamwork, innovation, and long-term partnership with colleagues and investors.

**Description**
Are you passionate about building innovative technology solutions that drive Prime membership growth and deliver personalized experiences? Join our IES Prime team where you'll lead complex technical programs across multiple stakeholders to create differentiated customer journeys throughout the Prime lifecycle. In this role, you'll leverage your deep technical expertise in large-scale distributed systems to drive strategic initiatives that connect various Amazon systems, enhancing the end-to-end Prime experience for customers in Emerging Markets.
  
  
Working at the intersection of customer experience and technical implementation, you'll tackle challenges across distributed systems, customer-facing applications, high-throughput production environments, and the application of ML/AI to enhance the Prime membership journey. This unique position offers exceptional visibility across Amazon's ecosystem while contributing to Prime's north star vision of becoming Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and validate complex program requirements across multiple stakeholder teams, solving ambiguous problems and proactively identifying risks related to Prime lifecycle experiences
* Partner with engineering teams to create high-level technical designs and architectural for implementing solutions that integrate with various Amazon systems, ensuring scalability and performance for high-volume customer experiences
* Drive end-to-end program management for technical initiatives that enhance Prime membership growth, benefit engagement
* Lead technical discussions with cross-functional teams to align business needs with technical constraints, making smart trade-offs between short and long-term requirements
* Streamline processes and implement operational excellence procedures to improve concurrent project delivery while monitoring metrics and program health

A day in the life
  
  
As an example - Your day begins with leading a cross-team planning session to align stakeholders on integration challenges for an upcoming Prime benefit enhancement. You'll brainstorm solutions for scaling a personalized post-signup journey, then unblock your team by facilitating a design review with partner engineering teams. Afterward, you'll contribute to the team's architectural evolution during a technical review session, analyze program metrics, and prepare updates for leadership on the progress of your initiatives that improve Prime's value-for-money promise in price-sensitive markets.
  
  
**About The Team**
Prime's north star vision is to be Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program, delivering profitable growth by improving the Amazon experience. Our tech team drives Prime business growth in Emerging Markets through innovative technology solutions. The IES Prime team drives the growth of Prime membership by delivering personalized, contextual, and value-led experiences across the member lifecycle. Our mandate spans creating differentiated post-sign-up journeys, deepening benefit engagement, communicating value realized through personalized experiences, and enabling seamless renewals that reinforce Prime's value-for-money promise—a core differentiator in price-sensitive markets.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. a543aea5.title: Sr Technical Program Manager
a543aea5.description:
**Life at Plume**
At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life’s moments better. Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.
  
  
We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.
  
  
With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can’t do it exceptionally well, we don’t do it. It’s how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it’s how we’re reinventing what’s possible every day.
  
  
**This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location.**
**Job Summary**
Seeking an experienced, energetic and collaborative Engineering Program Manager to define and drive product success for our cloud based service platform.
  
  
They will be able to lead multiple simultaneous projects or programs that are complex and are able to develop recovery strategies for those that stray from their plan while being part of the collaborative, and fun loving team at a rapidly growing organization.
  
  
Plume develops and deploys cloud based control planes with scale to manage 10’s of millions of customer homes through some of the world’s largest ISPs. Plume cloud applications include WiFi network management and optimization, device access control, network provisioning and end customer user interaction through mobile apps. Our focus is on the home market and we support B2B and B2C product offerings.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain the project plan including scope, schedule and risk management
* Drive execution and demonstrate end to end ownership of complex, technical programs to successful completion
* Drive deep collaboration across a network of critical dependencies
* Identify and resolve conflicts, inter-dependencies and program issues quickly and efficiently
* Lead cross functional project meetings and milestone reviews
* Deliver executive communication and drive the decision-making process
* Manage stakeholder and team communications and updates
* Develop roadmaps and development milestones for projects based on input from Product teams
* Monitor progress to plan and design a recovery strategy if project deviates from baseline plan

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or relevant industry-standard experience, with 10+ years of experience.
* Experience working in rapidly growing organizations
* Must have strong technical background and Hands on experience in software development. Strong preference for candidate transitioned from lead development into Program Management
* Lead end-to-end program execution for initiatives such as feature development, interoperability, performance optimization, certification. working closely with firmware, driver, hardware, QA, and product teams to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.
* Must have prior experience working in the Wi-Fi domain and be able to understand and engage in technical discussions related to Wi-Fi protocols, features, performance issues, and firmware architecture. Ability to work closely with firmware teams on architecture, release planning, dependency management, defect triage, and risk mitigation is essential.
* Able to think strategically and tactically and to build consensus to make programs successful
* Demonstrable ability to think outside the box to resolve technical issues and resource conflicts
* Thorough knowledge of software engineering principles and agile methodologies
* 5+ years’ experience managing fast-paced agile software projects with aggressive schedules
* Ability to quickly pick up new technologies and industry trends
* Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills and passion to solve hard problems
* Excellent leadership and communication skills

**About Plume**
As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world’s largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.
  
  
Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume’s software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.
  
  
Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

88ba79a2.title: Technical Program Manager
88ba79a2.description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**About The Role**
At PayPal, real-time decisioning powers customer protection and global commerce. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end delivery across a portfolio of risk strategies and the next-generation Risk Decisioning Platform. From roadmap to production, you’ll be accountable for the integrated plan, the cross-team execution, and the measurable results. You’ll partner with the Product Manager, risk strategy leaders, data science, modeling, and engineering to turn the roadmap into outcomes: loss reduction, approval rates, and customer experience.
  
  
Near term, you’ll lead the program to move strategies off legacy systems and ramp them to full production. Beyond that, you’ll orchestrate the launch of new strategies and build the delivery mechanisms, including experimentation and automation, that keep them improving.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Scope: The project & program responsibilities are focused on internal information system-specific project tasks or non-technical project completion using an internal customer perspective, both typically from initiation through delivery.
* Organize daily activities based on organizational goals.
* Develop and implement new programs that support objectives.
* Monitor projects and oversee project managers.
* Evaluate program strengths and weaknesses.
* Develop program budgets and plans.
* Meet with stakeholders to discuss program status and goals.
* Improve strategies with the marketing team.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own end-to-end program delivery. Turn the product roadmap into an integrated, multi-quarter plan spanning rules, models, data pipelines, platform capabilities, and customer treatments, with clear milestones, owners, and dependencies. Lead independently.
* Lead the legacy migration. Own the strategy, sequencing, and execution of moving risk strategies to the Risk Decisioning Platform, including parity validation, shadow and champion/challenger testing, cutover, and ramp to full production.
* Drive new strategy launches. Establish repeatable launch processes, from design through readiness reviews, rollout gating, monitoring, and rollback, that other teams adopt as the standard.
* Align teams and leaders. Partner across data science, modeling, engineering, platform, risk operations, and strategy teams on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs. Resolve cross-org blockers early and influence without direct authority.
* Manage dependencies and risk. Make critical paths and dependency maps visible, and anticipate risks to data, models, platform capacity, and infrastructure before they hit the schedule.
* Enable experimentation and automation. Work with engineering and data science to make testing, deployment, and strategy optimization faster and safer, focusing on the highest-leverage automation.
* Track, report, and govern. Define program metrics and dashboards covering delivery health, strategy performance, and captured savings. Present in program, product, and steering committee reviews, shaping the narrative and trade-off recommendations for senior leadership.
* Raise the bar. Introduce scalable program practices and post-launch retrospectives, and mentor other program managers.

What you bring
  
  

* 5+ years of program or technical program management experience delivering complex, cross-functional technical programs, including programs spanning multiple teams or organizations
* Strong technical fluency in data pipelines, model deployment, APIs, and distributed systems, enough to engage credibly with engineers and data scientists and challenge technical trade-offs
* Proven experience leading large-scale migrations or platform transitions, including cutover and ramp planning, with ownership of strategy as well as delivery
* Excellent planning, prioritization, and risk management skills, with a record of delivering on time in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across competing priorities without direct authority
* Outstanding written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief executives and steering committees
* Comfort working with data: you define metrics, read dashboards, and use them to steer the program

2c665ca0.title: Senior Program Manager
2c665ca0.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
The mission of the Engineering Program Management Office (PMO) is to implement program and project management methodologies that enable Fivetran to deliver complex products and initiatives on time and within expectations. In addition, the Engineering PMO serves as the subject-matter expert body on project and program management standards, directing a department-wide approach to program delivery and communication. You will help plan, track, and execute the company's most critical and cross-cutting Product and Engineering objectives. You will be responsible for leading cross-functional teams, managing complex programs and projects, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions that meet our customers' needs. You will communicate and work in close collaboration with partners across the engineering team and other business partners to achieve this vision.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore Office, India.
  
  
**Technologies you will use:**

* G Suite, AI LLM and Agents (Claude Code, Gemini, ChatGPT, and similar), Jira, Looker, Graphana, Lucid Charts, Workday, Sigma, Figma, BigQuery, Custom Apps.

**What You’ll Do:**
**Program/Project Management**

* Manage key engineering projects, and/or programs, or initiatives from initiation to closing.
* Provide regular status updates on a variety of internal channels to all levels of the organization.
* Define program charters, plans, and schedules. Drive Program execution.
* Drive Product representatives in providing timely direction and requirements.
* Lead internal cross-functional teams in engineering and validation activities.
* Ensure tight inter-team coordination and communication.
* Digest, understand, and communicate complex, technical/engineering issues.
* Identify and resolve conflicts or issues quickly, efficiently, and effectively.
* Surface and mitigate risks or defects, and lead technical task forces to ensure proper risk responses or issue resolution.
* Manage interdependencies across multiple engineering disciplines and stakeholders, including platform, SRE, & QA.
* Develop creative solutions, remove obstacles, and redefine approaches to balance cost, quality, and delivery priorities.
* Work closely with product management, data analytics, enablement & support.
* Define and own specific program metrics and objectives.
* Track and report on PMO KPIs.

**Process Improvement**

* Act as a role model for project/program management processes.
* Surface feedback and enhancement to project/program management processes.
* Align stakeholders and team members towards project/program management best practices.

**Skills We’re Looking For:**

* 1+ years of experience in a technical position (software engineer, QE/QA, platform engineer, etc.).
* Software project management experience is a strong plus.
* 4+ years of experience in technical project/program management.
* Agile and waterfall project/program management experience.
* Familiarity with project management tools like Jira.
* Can lead large and complex initiatives with minimal oversight.
* Can introduce structure and order in volatile conditions.
* Can clarify vague goals and requirements.
* AI LLMs and AI Agents usage proficiency.
* AI skills development.
* In-depth knowledge of the technologies and methodologies used in program management.
* Ability to work directly with senior leadership on programs, including leading R&D-wide (engineering, product, design, security) initiatives from start to finish.
* You can facilitate discussions with engineering subject-matter experts on topics such as System Design, Data Architecture, Infrastructure Management (including cost management), and Quality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact and collaborate with technical and non-technical groups at all levels.
* A data-driven and action-oriented mindset with excellent planning, analytical, problem-solving, project/program management, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Proficient in addressing technical issues and providing effective mitigation plans.
* Can align team members to program goals and objectives.
* Demonstrates integrity, upholding professional codes of conduct.

**(Optional) Bonus Skills**

* Start-up experience a strong plus
* PMP certification is a plus
* Familiarity with the following technologies is a plus: Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), ETL or ELT, modern data stack.

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:
  
  
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
  
  
We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
  
  
We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
  
  
**Your Career**
The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. As a Solutions Consultant for IT/ITeS, you will be part of the core technical team, architecting solutions for large IT/ITeS customers in the region. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

**Role**
Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
  
  

* Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.

* Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers

Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead.
