07146d61.title: Forward Deployed Architect { Mumbai}
07146d61.description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as
**a hands-on senior technical architect**
on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end-to-end design and delivery of AI-driven business transformation projects.
  
  
You'll work closely with pre-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands-on coding to build proofs-of-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
  
  
As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
  
  
This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real-world business impact.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers
* Design & Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype & Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof-of-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long-term scalability.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 7+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* Data-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

3c26ffc9.title: MS-FDL-Senior Manager - Solution Architecture
3c26ffc9.description:
Location: Noida

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 30, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1756005

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title: Senior Manager – Solution Architecture**

**Summary:**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Solution Architecture to lead the design and governance of end-to-end enterprise solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.

This role combines solution strategy, architecture leadership, and people management, translating complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. The ideal candidate will connect business processes, applications, data, integration, and cloud technologies to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.

You will own solution architecture quality across engagements, lead a team of architects, and partner with enterprise architecture, product, engineering, security, and business leaders to guide solutions from discovery through implementation and business value realization.

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Solution Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across complex transformation initiatives, aligning business capabilities, functional requirements, and technology choices with enterprise strategy.
* Lead discovery and architecture workshops to define solution scope, assess current-state landscapes, and develop target-state designs and phased transition roadmaps.
* Define architecture across application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains, with clear component responsibilities, interfaces, deployment models, and dependencies.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy options, cloud services, enterprise products, and emerging technologies through structured trade-off analysis and targeted proofs of concept.
* Establish reference architectures, design patterns, architecture decision records, and review standards; ensure alignment with enterprise principles and govern justified exceptions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve cross-domain design challenges, balancing business fit, scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

  

**Architecture Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across concurrent engagements, maintaining traceability from requirements to design decisions, implementation, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to translate designs into actionable work, validate feasibility, and manage technical dependencies, design changes, and architecture risks.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, recovery, and supportability; guide validation through testing and operational readiness reviews.
* Develop migration and modernization approaches, including data migration, coexistence, cutover, and rollback; align sequencing, estimates, and cost assumptions with delivery teams.
* Embed security, privacy, data governance, and applicable compliance requirements in solution designs, working with control owners to assess risks and close design gaps.

  

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale a solution architecture team, coordinating application, data, integration, cloud, and security specialists across engagements.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance architecture practice focused on sound judgment, collaboration, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource allocation, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with business demand and technology priorities.
* Mentor architects and technical leads on design quality, business understanding, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen communities of practice and peer reviews.

  

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with business leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, product owners, and clients to clarify needs and translate them into feasible solution options.
* Present solution alternatives, investment needs, trade-offs, and risks to decision-makers; secure alignment on scope, target architecture, and expected business outcomes.
* Lead architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations, including solution narratives, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and implementation approaches.
* Communicate architecture decisions, delivery implications, technical risks, and business value clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable solution blueprints, accelerators, and integration patterns that improve consistency, reduce delivery effort, and support repeatable client outcomes.
* Assess opportunities to simplify application portfolios and modernize legacy solutions, balancing reuse and standardization with business-specific requirements.
* Evaluate analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions through business cases and proofs of value, addressing data readiness, security, responsible use, and operational feasibility.

  

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, enterprise integration, or data platforms, including ownership of complex enterprise solution designs.
* 5+ years of architecture or engineering people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or technical leads across multiple programs or engagements.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including hybrid integration, deployment models, resilience, and cost considerations.
* Strong expertise in application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, enterprise integration patterns, and the trade-offs between distributed and simpler architectures.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, including transactional systems, data warehouses or lakehouses, data pipelines, master data, and analytics integration.
* Experience producing architecture models, interface specifications, decision records, and non-functional requirements; familiarity with frameworks or methods such as TOGAF, C4, or ArchiMate.

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Type of Work: Highly consultative, collaborative with internal Sales and architectural . The daily focus is on independently leading technical pre-sales for mid-to-large enterprise accounts, leading whiteboarding sessions, and designing hybrid telecom/cloud networks. You will also play a critical role in identifying and scoping automation opportunities within customer deployments.
* Expected Volumes: Managing a robust pipeline of concurrent enterprise deals independently, while partnering with Architect IIIs on specific components of global strategic accounts. You will oversee technical discovery, design full network topologies, and guide Architect Is in building the corresponding lab/PoC environments.
* Risk & Criticality: Moderate-to-High commercial risk. You are independently designing solutions and scoping out automation requirements for significant revenue-generating accounts. Inaccurate scoping, missed requirements during discovery, or flawed architectural designs can lead to delivery delays, margin erosion, or lost competitive bids.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Mid-to-Large Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead for mid-to-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* Automation Scoping & Strategy: Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* Technical Discovery & Whiteboarding: Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* Solution Architecture & Validation: Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.

* Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid-market feature requests.

ec436352.title: Tech Principal, AI Solutions
ec436352.description:
**Tech Principal, AI Solutions**

  

Location: Hybrid | Type: Full-time

  

**About Newpage Solutions**

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data- driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview.

We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in peoples lives.

  

**Your Mission**

We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping: when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement,

a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence: you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data

engineering. Third, delivery governance: you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably. You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built: not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge

of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.

  

**What Youll Do**

**Shape Solutions in Discovery**

* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the clients problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end: target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually: layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership: team shape, phasing,milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.

**Set the Engineering Standards**

* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build: reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.

**Govern and Steer Delivery**

* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects: regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.
* Unblock teams directly: get into the codebase, pair on the hard problem, and make the call when a team is stuck between options.
* Keep delivery, client, and leadership views aligned on where each project genuinely stands.
* Feed lessons from delivery back into standards, so every project makes the next one better.

  

**What You Bring**

* 12+ years of engineering experience, with architecture-level ownership on multiple production systems and at least 3 years building LLM-powered and agentic applications end-to-end.
* A consulting or client-facing solutioning background: you have shaped
* engagements from ambiguous conversations, won technical confidence in the room, and carried trade-off discussions with business leadership without locking them in.
* Direct hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered products: RAG pipelines, prompt and context engineering, eval harnesses, and vendor-agnostic LLM abstractions.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models: you have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, Auto Gen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You have built Next.js applications, Fast API services, and similar.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and templates.
* Working fluency across the capabilities you will set standards for: QA and test automation, DevSecOps, and data engineering. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in each, but you must speak each language credibly and know what good looks like.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud-native architectures on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. Cloudflare experience a plus.
* Experience governing or assuring delivery across multiple concurrent teams: technical oversight, quality gates, and steering without micromanaging.
* Strong written communication: you author ADRs, standards, scope memos, and decision documents that hold up under review.
* Storytelling craft: you turn discovery conversations into narratives that make clients see their own problem more clearly, and you present architectures and live demos to executive audiences with confidence.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A founders mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.

  

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Prior Tech Principal, Principal Consultant, Solution Architect, or Field CTO experience at a consultancy.
* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI. LLMOps and observability experience (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), and
* model serving where the problem calls for it (Bedrock, SageMaker, vLLM).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act readiness, internal AI policy and risk frameworks).
* Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Relevant cloud architecture certifications.

  

**What We Offer**

At Newpage, were building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters.

  

**We offer:**

* A people-first culture: supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration: work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts: we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow: opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards: competitive compensation that recognizes both contribution and potential.

  

**Ready to Apply?**

Lets build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to

ramadevi.bhumireddy@newpage.io with any questions.

35a51e28.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Fee Strategy Operations team is seeking an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Program Manager to drive cross-functional go-to-market (GTM) execution for fee and incentive launches across Amazon's worldwide marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—partnering with Fee Strategy, Product, Operations, Legal, Seller Communications, and regional stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery of fee/incentive changes to Sellers globally. This role provides the unique opportunity of managing billion dollar incentive programs across stores and drive seller success.
  
  
Our environment is fast-paced and demands a self-starter who is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable navigating ambiguity across multiple teams, partners, and levels of management. You will own end-to-end program delivery, understand business problems at a strategic level, and have the ability to prevent or mitigate the consequences of poor business decisions. As the program owner, you will look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and deliver results with minimal oversight.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management  
  
Partner with worldwide cross-functional teams to align GTM strategy, timelines, and deliverables for fee and incentive launches and changes. Collaborate closely with Fee Strategy Product Managers to understand GTM requirements, translate them into actionable work-backwards plans, and drive execution of GTM activities across all fee/incentive types. Act as the primary liaison between Fee Strategy and WW partner teams—Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Science, Seller Communications, Reporting, and Operations—to track, report, and monitor launch readiness, central content readiness, country teams' readiness, announcement plans, and cross-team alignment. Develop working-backwards plans and establish mechanisms to track, monitor, and report on GTM execution and launch readiness.  
  
GTM Execution & Content Management  
  
Identify and deliver updates to Seller-facing communications (SeCe), partnering with Country Fees POCs and partner teams to prepare and align on internal content and readiness for launches and changes. Manage end-to-end delivery of content updates for BRDs, TRDs, ARDs, Help Pages, Paragon SOPs, and country/partner teams' internal readiness for all fee/incentive types, following the GTM Launch Playbook. Maintain a centralized repository of Seller-facing content resources and internal launch documentation, managing ongoing content updates throughout the year while ensuring accuracy and version control.  
  
Process Development & Operational Excellence  
  
Build and implement program mechanisms to drive GTM execution, collect Seller Voice of Seller (VOS) feedback, define program performance metrics, synthesize insights, and share actionable summaries with product teams. Perform fee/incentive change validation activities, report observations and discrepancies to Product and Tech teams, and drive resolution to closure.  
  
Program Leadership  
  
Execute high-priority, cross-functional, high-impact projects self-sufficiently with minimal oversight. Solve complex, ambiguous problems independently by applying sound judgment, data-driven analysis, and structured thinking. Identify process gaps and proactively propose scalable solutions that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk. Analyze the overall program performance and drive program roadmap with product.  
  
A day in the life  
As a Senior Program Manager in Fee Strategy Operations, you operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. Your day involves leading cross-functional syncs with Fee Strategy PMs, Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Seller Communications, and Operations to align on launch readiness, resolve blockers, and confirm content and announcement timelines across regions. You manage hands-on deliverables—reviewing and updating Help Pages and Paragon SOPs in the centralized content repository, tracking program documentation completion and updates, performing fee change validations against Seller-facing surfaces, and escalating discrepancies to Tech/Product teams for resolution. Equally, you invest time in building scalable mechanisms—developing work-backwards plans for newly approved fee/incentive changes, synthesizing Seller VOS feedback into actionable insights for product teams, and refining the GTM playbook based on lessons learned from prior cycles. You independently manage ambiguity across 6+ partner teams spanning multiple geographies, drive cross-functional alignment without authority, and deliver results with minimal oversight—balancing strategic coordination with operational rigor every single day. You monitor the performance of the program, identify gaps, and work with country team to improve key conversion and selection metric.

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* 4+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

You’ll be the hands-on demo specialist for MAX in APAC and Europe. You will deliver sharp, client-specific demonstrations to senior procurement and supply chain leaders, and you’ll build the collateral that makes those demos land.
  
  
You’ll work under the direction of the Presales & Solutions lead. Your job is to make every client conversation look polished, relevant and credible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Demonstrations**

* Deliver MAX demos to CPOs, CFOs, heads of category and supply chain leaders at enterprise accounts across APAC and Europe
* Tailor each demo to the client’s categories, spend profile, regional context and business priorities, using discovery notes from the account team
* Tie each demo to a clear value story (savings, risk reduction, speed to decision) and agree a concrete next step with the account executive
* Handle client questions on product, data and integration with confidence. Build a working understanding of AI and security topics (e.g., how MAX models work, data handling, access controls) so you can respond credibly, and escalate deeper technical questions to Product or the Director

**Collateral and demo assets**

* Build and maintain client-facing materials: tailored demo decks, one-pagers, use-case stories, ROI and business-case templates, and leave-behinds
* Create demo scripts and storylines by industry (e.g., pharma, chemicals, food & beverage, CPG), following the narrative standards set by the Director
* Work with Product to keep demo environments, sample data and sandboxes current and realistic
* Keep a clean, versioned library of assets that account teams can reuse

**Deal and event support**

* Support account executives with pre-demo preparation and follow-up materials
* Contribute to RFP and RFI responses on MAX (a regular part of the role, though not its core focus)
* Contribute to pilot design and success criteria, and help prepare pilot results readouts
* Represent MAX at industry events, client workshops and joint sessions with Kearney
* Capture client reactions and objections after each demo and share them with the Director, Product and Marketing

**Qualifications**
**Must-have**

* 10+ years in B2B software, consulting or procurement/supply chain, including 3+ years in presales, solution consulting, product specialist or demo roles
* Proven ability to deliver polished, client-specific demos to senior business audiences
* Working knowledge of procurement, sourcing or supply chain, from practice, consulting or selling into those functions
* Strong storytelling and visual communication skills, with a track record of building high-quality decks and collateral
* Comfort explaining AI and analytics platforms in plain business terms, or the curiosity and ability to build that quickly
* Excellent written and spoken English, and experience working with clients across multiple cultures and regions

**Nice-to-have**

* Background in procurement tech (e.g., Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer) or procurement intelligence
* Consulting experience in operations or procurement
* Industry exposure to pharma/life sciences/chemicals or CPG

fbff2f1d.title: Senior Technical Architect
fbff2f1d.description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
We are a virtual-first company, and your primary work experience will be virtual / working from your home, when not traveling to customer or prospect facilities in this specific role. Occasional travel to a physical office may be required to enhance working relationships, collaboration, design, strategy, and alignment.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced and seasoned technology professional to join us as a Senior Technical Solution Architect within our Presales / Sales Engineering organization. In this highly customer-facing role, you will lead and sustain advanced technical exchanges with key prospects and global enterprise customers, translating complex requirements into robust, secure, and scalable integration solutions. You will specialize in Application-to-Application (A2A), Business-to-Business (B2B) or EDI, and Business-to-Government (B2G) integrations, driving technical win strategies and bridging enterprise platforms with next-generation cognitive systems.
  
  
If you are a deep integration expert skilled in customer engagement, modern enterprise middleware, API strategies, and AI Agent integration layers, this is the perfect opportunity to drive significant impact across our presales engagements and global enterprise sales cycle.
  
  
In addition, you will serve as the technical authority during presales discoveries, architectural workshops, and solution demonstrations, partnering closely with sales leadership and business consultants. You will be providing customer-driven feedback to Product R&D as well.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Technical Discovery & Customer Exchanges: Conduct deep-dive technical discovery sessions, lead advanced architectural exchanges with prospective clients, and articulate complex enterprise integration strategies to key business and technical stakeholders.
* Integrate via Enterprise Tools: Architect enterprise-grade integrations, based on our QAD Integration Platform and through middleware, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), and ESB (Enterprise Service Bus) platforms.
* Master Protocols & API Layers: Design robust integration via API and protocol layers utilizing REST APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, and other modern communication frameworks.
* Demonstrate Integration Platform and AI Solutions: Present and demonstrate advanced integration capabilities with 3rd party applications and AI Agents, cognitive workflows to client executives and technical panels.
* Presales Partnership: Partner directly with Account Executives and Business Consultants to respond to complex RFPs/RFIs, address technical objections, validate solution feasibility, and ensure seamless handoffs to Implementation Services.
* Create Architectural Blueprints: Develop, maintain, and own high-quality technical diagrams, data-flow schemas, and system topology designs for cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployments.
* Engage C-Level Stakeholders: Direct and lead deep technical discovery and architectural discussions with top-tier prospects, customers, and key enterprise executives.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Advanced Integration Skills: 10+ years of professional experience in technical solutions architecture, system integration, or software engineering.
* Cloud & SaaS Expertise: Proven experience managing and architecting within Cloud and SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of security protocols, data privacy, and compliance.
* A2A, B2B & B2G Expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of Application-to-Application (A2A) flows, Business-to-Business (B2B) standards, and Business-to-Government (B2G) integration frameworks
* AI Integration Layer Mastery: Strong capability and current technical knowledge of AI Agent integration layers, large language model (LLM) orchestration pipelines, and cognitive agent frameworks.
* API & Protocols: Full command of RESTful APIs, SOAP, web services, microservices design patterns, and routing topologies.
* Enterprise Tooling: Mastery of middleware platforms (e.g., Boomi, MuleSoft, or equivalent), ETL, and ESB systems.
* ERP Landscapes: Strong familiarity with manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial enterprise software landscapes is highly desirable.
* Exceptional Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and visual presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical jargon into business value for C-level executives.
* Customer Engagement & Presales Track Record: Proven experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, delivering compelling technical demonstrations, and leading architectural workshops for customer stakeholders.
* Language Proficiency: Excellent English (verbal and written)

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional qualifications.
* Relevant industry certifications (PMP, Boomi/MuleSoft Architect, AI/LLM Engineering, or AWS/Azure Solution Architect) are highly valued.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well-being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.

**Compensation Package**

* Compensation will vary based on knowledge, skills, experience, and market location variations as well as internal peer equity.
* Local country-based benefits package.

**About QAD**
**Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set.**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior technology architect specializing in Kinaxis based supply and demand planning solutions for global retail and supply chain clients. Design scalable planning platforms guide complex implementations and ensure hybrid delivery excellence while aligning technology strategy with business goals for measurable operational impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect end to end Kinaxis based planning solutions that address complex supply and demand planning needs for large retail and supply chain enterprises
* Design robust data and integration architectures that enable reliable planning inputs from enterprise resource planning systems and external partner platforms
* Lead high level and detailed solution design workshops with client planners and operations stakeholders to translate business scenarios into Kinaxis configurations
* Configure Kinaxis supply planning capabilities to support inventory optimization replenishment planning and exception based management tailored to retail networks
* Configure Kinaxis demand planning features to support forecasting promotion planning and demand sensing while ensuring alignment with business planning cycles
* Define modelling approaches that align Kinaxis fundamentals with client planning processes including hierarchy design time fences and policy controls
* Collaborate with business process experts in retail planning and supply chain management to harmonize process design with system capabilities and constraints
* Guide performance tuning and scalability improvements so that Kinaxis solutions handle large volumes of planning data and complex multi node supply networks
* Oversee hybrid delivery activities by coordinating on site and remote teams to ensure consistent implementation quality and adherence to project timelines
* Provide governance on solution standards reusable components and reference architectures that promote consistency maintainability and future extensibility
* Review functional and technical design deliverables to ensure that proposed solutions align with enterprise architecture principles and security requirements
* Coach project team members on Kinaxis best practices and planning domain concepts so that configuration and customizations remain sustainable and supportable
* Partner with client leadership to define value realization metrics and roadmaps that demonstrate how planning transformations improve service levels and reduce costs
* Drive defect triage and complex issue resolution during testing and hypercare phases to maintain solution stability and planning confidence
* Engage with platform and infrastructure teams to optimize environment setup capacity planning and backup strategies for critical planning applications
* Document solution decisions design rationales and operating procedures to support future enhancements and knowledge transfer across global teams

**Qualifications**

* Possess extensive experience with Kinaxis supply planning including configuration scenario modelling and deployment in large scale environments
* Demonstrate strong expertise in Kinaxis demand planning with hands on experience in forecast models statistical parameters and consensus planning workflows
* Exhibit solid grounding in Kinaxis fundamentals including data modeling planning engine concepts and administration of user roles and planning calendars
* Apply deep domain experience in retail planning to design solutions that address assortment allocation replenishment and store level planning needs
* Utilize comprehensive knowledge of supply chain management to align technology solutions with sourcing manufacturing distribution and logistics processes
* Communicate effectively in hybrid work settings by collaborating with distributed stakeholders and teams while maintaining clear documentation and updates
* Adapt quickly to evolving client requirements and emerging Kinaxis features while upholding high standards of architecture integrity and delivery quality

**Certifications Required**
Kinaxis RapidResponse Author Certification or equivalent Kinaxis certified professional credential

d8311442.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Networking and Compute Infrastructure
d8311442.description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Solution Architect, Networking and compute Infrastructure to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centres. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyse, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Develop tooling to automate and manage of large-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self-service consumption of resources.
* Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage.
* Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level.
* Being a technical resource, develop, re-define and document standard methodologies to share with customer and internal teams Support activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements.
* Experience with system administration on Linux systems required (CentOS, RHEL, and Ubuntu preferred)

**What We Need To See**

* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering fields with at least 5+ years’ work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data centre compute architecture.
* Advance knowledge of HPC, AI & EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VXLAN protocols.
* Deep understanding of DC architecture fundamentals such as compute, storage (PFS) & InfiniBand, Ethernet, NVLink.
* Experience running HPC performance benchmarks, cluster health checks, and profiling tools to identify infrastructure bottlenecks.
* Python programming, bash scripting experience and Advance Linux knowledge.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning and comfortable with automation and configuration management tools including Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet. Chef, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Excellent customer-facing and communication skills (verbal and written in both languages), enabling effective engagement with customers, partners, and cross-functional teams across the India region. Listening skills in English are critical.
* Willingness to travel

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Knowledge of CPU and/or GPU architecture including of Kubernetes, container related microservice technologies.
* Background with RDMA (InfiniBand or RoCE) fabrics.
* Linux or Networking Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE) or NVIDIA-related certifications.
* Deep Knowledge on observability stack and build experience.

**Title: Architect, IT Solutions – Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms**

**Location: Pune, India(Hybrid)**

**CTH/ Full time**

Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.

· Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.

· Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

· Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.

· Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.

· Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

· Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.

· Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.

· Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

· Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.

· Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What You'll Need (Required)**

· 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.

· 3+ years in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.

· Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).

· Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).

· Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.

· Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.

· Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).

· Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

· Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

· Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.

· Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.

· Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.

· Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.

· Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.

· Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.

· Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

· Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.

· Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position

This role combines deep architectural expertise with emerging AI and cloud technologies to design future-ready platforms that accelerate business value, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making.**

Working closely with business stakeholders, product managers, engineers, data scientists, and platform teams, the architect will drive the design and adoption of innovative solutions leveraging cloud-native technologies, data platforms, integration services, automation, and Generative AI capabilities.**

****Job Responsibilities****
**Scope / (Content Leadership)**

* Architect and deliver scalable, resilient, secure, and business-driven solutions that align with strategic product goals, enterprise architecture principles, and AWS best practices
* Establish and govern end-to-end solution architectures, including non-functional requirements (NFRs), architecture fitness functions, technology standards, and critical design decisions throughout the product lifecycle
* Leverage proven architecture frameworks, design patterns, and modern engineering practices to create consistent, maintainable, and future-ready solutions across complex products, platforms, and enterprise ecosystems
* Champion the adoption of cloud-native, data-driven, and AI-enabled architectures, enabling innovation, operational excellence, and accelerated business value delivery

* Lead the architecture and delivery of complex, cross-functional solutions spanning multiple products, platforms, and business domains
* Establish and maintain architecture vision, roadmaps, and technology strategies while proactively identifying dependencies, risks, opportunities, and business impacts
* Define reference architectures, integration patterns, API strategies, data models, and governance frameworks to ensure consistency and scalability
* Champion modern software engineering practices, cloud-native architectures, platform engineering, automation, and Generative AI capabilities to accelerate value delivery
* Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches to solve business challenges and drive continuous modernization

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making
* Influence strategic direction and gain alignment across product, engineering, data, security, operations, and architecture teams
* Foster collaboration, architectural excellence, and knowledge sharing across the organization
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders on architecture, innovation, and technology investment decisions

**Impact/Strategy:**

* Identify opportunities to modernize platforms, reduce technical debt, improve reliability and operational efficiency, and accelerate innovation through AI, automation, and cloud technologies

* Navigate architectural decisions involving competing priorities, regulatory requirements, scalability challenges, and organizational dependencies

**Business / Technical ability:**

* Apply deep expertise in solution architecture, software engineering, AWS cloud technologies, data engineering, data and integration architecture, analytics platforms, AI/ML solutions, and enterprise technology strategy
* Balance business objectives, user needs, technical constraints, operational excellence, and risk management to deliver sustainable architectural outcomes

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field
* Extensive experience designing and delivering scalable enterprise solutions and leading architecture strategy, modernization, and digital transformation initiatives
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, cloud platforms, and modern architecture patterns is preferred
* Demonstrated experience implementing cloud-native, AI/ML, and Generative AI solutions in enterprise environments
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence architecture decisions across organizational boundaries

**Description**
AWS Profesional Services is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager (Sr TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data / Analytics, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. The TAM works with customers as a trusted advisor to enable their cloud journey and grow their knowledge of AWS cloud services and technologies to support their business goals.
  
  
As we continue to rapidly expand AWS’s Enterprise Support organization you’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop your technical, consulting, operational and leadership skills. You’ll work with talented cloud technologists whilst expanding your knowledge of AWS products. You’ll also have the chance to receive mentor-ship and active support to achieve AWS certifications.
  
  
This role is within our Strategic Industries group, and specifically within the team looking after strategic accounts in the Energy and Utilities vertical.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers, working alongside the broader dedicated account team. If you wish to be at the forefront of customer strategies and innovation, come join us!

Develop trusting relationship with customers, understand their business needs / drivers, review service disruptions, provide monthly / quarterly metrics and assist with pre-launch planning
  
  

* Utilize technical skills to solve difficult support issues and technical challenges
* Understand operational parameters and troubleshooting process for customer issues and escalations
* Advocate for customer needs to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development
* Improve customer capabilities by running workshops, operations and architecture reviews
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing costs and driving efficiencies to mitigate risks in customer operations plans and product adoption
* Work with customers across all levels from developers through to C-Suite executives
* Collaborate across multiple functions within AWS, such as: Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, Global TAM teams and Sales Account Managers

A day in the life
  
  
A TAM's daily activities involve managing complex technical and critical service events while serving as the principal technical advisor for enterprise customers. They spend their time partnering with customers to optimize AWS usage, tracking operational issues, managing feature requests and launches, while also working directly with internal AWS teams to exceed customer expectations.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, they provide strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, while keeping their customers' AWS environments operationally healthy.

Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment

1c68a753.description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

Platform Architect, Developer Productivity

**The role**
------------

You will set the multi-year architecture for Myntra’s developer platform: the CI/CD, environments, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering workflows that every engineering team builds on. You will be the final authority on trade-offs between developer experience, reliability, security, and cost. The goal is to make shipping fast, safe, and cheap for engineers across Myntra, and to measure it by outcomes rather than activity. You will own the platform blueprint across multiple product areas, not just one, and will weigh emerging technology trends against long-term business goals.

  
  

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Define the architecture and roadmap for a unified internal developer platform, with paved paths for build, test, deploy, observe, and operate. The platform should support 10x scale.
* Own the architecture blueprint across product areas. Unify duplicated patterns, tooling, and service hops into shared platforms, and remove silos between teams.
* Turn vague developer pain points, such as slow pipelines, environment sprawl, and on-call toil, into clear problems and technical directions, and drive them to shipped systems.
* Decide which problems matter at division scale and which to ignore, and drive major technology decisions to closure across product areas.
* Set the standard for AI-assisted engineering across the division: agent workflows, secure prompting, AI code review and verification, and token/compute governance.
* Define AI-native engineering paradigms for the division, including how autonomous agents are used, supervised, and kept within safe boundaries.
* Make build vs. buy vs. offload calls on tooling (including AI tools) using cost data. Replace expensive vendor tools with leaner internal or open-source ones where the numbers support it.
* Establish observability, SLO, and chaos-engineering standards that reduce org-wide MTTR. Design for graceful degradation and BCP.
* Design platforms that are self-healing and debuggable by design, remove single points of failure, and isolate heavy AI/compute workloads from core traffic.
* Own FinOps and security guardrails for platform services, including zero-trust, data privacy, and responsible-AI boundaries.
* Set division-wide compliance, security, and cost-governance standards, and balance large multi-cloud infrastructure investments against their return.
* Measure developer productivity with SPACE and DORA, not PR or line counts. Cover satisfaction, flow, and cognitive load as well as delivery speed.
* Act as the DRI across teams. Resolve cross-functional impasses by speaking both technical and business language, and advise VPs and managers.
* Represent the platform in executive and external technical forums.
* Mentor senior engineers and sponsor named people into larger roles.
* Mentor and sponsor other architects, and build mentorship frameworks that scale beyond your direct network.
* Mentor senior engineers and sponsor named people into larger roles.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Deep experience architecting large-scale platforms, such as cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and internal developer platforms.
* Strong grounding in distributed systems design, SRE practice (SLIs/SLOs, incident response, RCA discipline), and Kubernetes, IaC, and multi-region/hybrid-cloud resilience.
* Hands-on fluency with AI IDEs and agents, plus judgment on verifying AI output, building evals, and modelling inference cost.
* Track record of adoption: platforms and standards that teams outside your own use, not slide-deck architecture.
* Cost and risk judgment, including cloud/GPU capacity planning and data-privacy compliance.
* Excellent communication, with the ability to make the final call when a group is stuck and keep trust.
* Experience owning architecture across multiple product areas or a whole division, including multi-million-dollar infrastructure decisions.
* A record of developing other architects and tech leads.

As a VP/Manager, Fund Solutions, you will be responsible for supporting complex fund liquidation and wind-down engagements across jurisdictions. In addition to training junior staff members, the successful candidate will work on a range of assignments including supporting the global teams including management of fund operations (mainly in End Of Fund Life situations for global funds) such as accounting, taxation, legal and investor relations. * Ability to interpret and apply foreign rules, regulations and laws is a plus. Ability to work in regulated environments like SEC, Cayman, Mauritius etc.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with fund managers, financial sponsors, creditors, asset agents and solicitors.

**Essential Traits**

* Strong interpersonal, written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to develop and drive relationships with individuals from all industries.
* Ability to master new tasks quickly whilst showing strong attention to detail.
* Ability to lead a team consisting of Senior Associates and Analysts.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise tasks and work on multiple assignments
* Ability to manage rapidly changing assignments and work well under pressure.
* Strong team player and work in a team environment, across multiple mandates.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

d1836d60.description:
**Job Information**
-------------------
