**About Us**
------------

Intelehealth is an international non-profit committed to improving access to primary health care in underserved regions of the world through its innovative technology platform. Intelehealth can be used by health organizations to set up high quality primary health care programs connecting patients in remote and rural communities to doctors.

We believe work should be meaningful as well as enriching. At Intelehealth, we’re taking on one of the world’s biggest development’s challenge - solving the health access gap for last mile populations. We believe in creating and maintaining an organizational culture of innovation which is conducive for the incredible people who work with us.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital health technologies are transforming healthcare by enabling innovative solutions that enhance health system efficiency, service delivery, and patient outcomes, contributing to the achievement of Universal Health Coverage (UHC) and the health-related Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

The Government of Chhattisgarh has formally requested WHO-SEARO's technical support to develop and implement a roadmap for UHC and health-related SDGs in the state. This collaboration was advanced through the Joint Consultative Meeting for the Development and Implementation of UHC and Health SDG Roadmaps in Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh (Bhopal, April 2026) and the Swasth Chhattisgarh Consultation (Raipur, June 2026). Digital health and AI constitute a cross-cutting enabler of the state's UHC acceleration agenda, with implementation to be intensified in designated beacon districts alongside statewide efforts.

As part of this agenda, WHO-SEARO is supporting the Government of Chhattisgarh on the state's digital health action plan, the evaluation of AI tools in health — including SAKSHAMA and other AI applications proposed to be taken forward for evaluation in the state — and the scale-up of digital health innovations. Intelehealth is supporting the Government of Chhattisgarh and WHO-SEARO in operationalising telemedicine, digital health, and AI interventions in the state, including under an Agreement for Performance of Work (APW) with WHO.

The Senior Digital Health & AI Project Coordinator will be Intelehealth's dedicated in-state resource, based in Raipur, to coordinate digital health and AI interventions across Chhattisgarh — including AI evaluations and digital health innovations — working in close collaboration with WHO-SEARO's Digital Health team and the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh.

Under the supervision of the designated lead at Intelehealth and in close collaboration with WHO-SEARO's Digital Health team , the Senior Digital Health & AI Project Coordinator will undertake the following responsibilities:

* Serve as the state-level project coordinator for digital health and AI interventions supported by WHO-SEARO and Intelehealth in Chhattisgarh, at the state level and in the designated beacon districts, under the state's UHC and health-SDG acceleration agenda.
* Support the Government of Chhattisgarh in the development, refinement, and implementation of the state's Digital Health and AI roadmap/action plan, ensuring alignment with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), national digital health standards (including HL7 FHIR), and WHO guidance.
* Coordinate the design, protocol development, ethics and regulatory processes, field operations, and reporting of AI evaluations in the state — including the evaluation of SAKSHAMA and other AI tools taken forward for evaluation in Chhattisgarh — in collaboration with government counterparts, evaluation partners, academic institutions, and funders.
* Coordinate the implementation and scale-up of digital health innovations in the state, including telemedicine (hub-and-spoke models and eSanjeevani last-mile strengthening), AI-enabled screening and decision-support tools, and digital platforms for maternal and child health, communicable diseases, and NCDs.
* Support the operationalisation of digital health and AI activities under the WHO–Intelehealth workplans, including readiness assessments, capacity building of frontline health workers and medical officers, and support to the NHM Programme Management Unit.
* Provide expert technical advice to the Department of Health and Family Welfare, NHM, and State Health Systems Resource Centre on program objectives, execution options, and implementation plans for digital health and AI.
* Support the framing and application of context-appropriate frameworks by which AI models are evaluated for accuracy, safety, usability, equity, and cost-effectiveness, and the pathways by which promising AI applications transition from proofs-of-concept to scaled, sustainable deployments in the state.
* Establish and maintain monitoring mechanisms, dashboards, and progress reports to track digital health and AI implementation in the state and beacon districts, and its contribution to health outcomes and equity.
* Facilitate coordination across stakeholders — state government, technology partners, evaluation partners, academic institutions, and funders — including organising review meetings, workshops, and field visits.
* Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, and capacity-building initiatives to enhance digital health and AI literacy among state and district health officials and frontline workers.
* Conduct research and analysis on emerging digital health and AI trends, opportunities, and challenges relevant to Chhattisgarh to inform state policy and programming.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing and documentation of best practices through reports, publications, presentations, and digital platforms.
* rovide technical assistance on digital health and AI-related projects as required by Intelehealth and WHO-SEARO.

**Over a 12-month period, the Senior Digital Health & AI Project Coordinator will:**

* Coordinate and support the completion of the SAKSHAMA evaluation in Chhattisgarh, including finalised evaluation protocol, ethics/regulatory clearances, field data collection, and evaluation report.
* Coordinate and support additional AI evaluations taken forward in the state, with agreed protocols, implementation plans, and progress reports for each.
* Support finalisation and phased implementation of the Chhattisgarh Digital Health and AI roadmap/action plan, with a costed workplan for the state and beacon districts.
* Deliver quarterly progress reports and dashboards on digital health and AI implementation in the state and beacon districts, shared with the Government of Chhattisgarh, WHO-SEARO, and Intelehealth.
* Support the operationalisation of telemedicine and digital health interventions, including readiness assessments, training completion reports, and documentation of hub-and-spoke operationalisation.
* Develop capacity-building materials and facilitate training sessions on digital health and AI applications for state and district health officials and frontline workers.
* Document and disseminate best practices and lessons learned from digital health and AI implementation in Chhattisgarh, including at least two knowledge products (case studies, policy briefs, or presentations).
* Facilitate and assist in organising state-level review meetings and at least one state workshop on digital health and AI.

### **Requirements**

**Education Qualification :**

* **Essential:** Master's degree in data science, public health, computer science, engineering, mathematics, law, or a related field with 5+ years of combined education and experience in health and technology development/application
* **Desirable:** Additional degree or specialized training in artificial intelligence, data science, or health informatics.

**Prior Experience:**

**Essential:**

* Excellent executive presence and upward communication skills with senior officials like IAS in the Government Systems.
* Liasoning with the senior IAS officials in the Government systems, senior executives in the
* At least 4 years of experience working on digital and AI projects or delivering data science applications in health services.
* Experience in developing conceptual frameworks, policy proposals, or strategic plans for digital and AI and data science.
* Direct experience in advising on the technical implementation of digital, AI and data science in health systems.
* Experience in having supported the development, testing, launch, or actual scale-up of any AI-based technology. Experience in technology assessment and product development is an advantage.
* Collaborative track record of partnering with governments, Ministries of Health, NGOs, academic institutions, and global funders, particularly in the Global South, including playing a technical advisory role.
* Demonstrated program or project management expertise: from work plan concept development through implementation, with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
* Attention to detail, including the ability to scrutinize budgets against work plans and deliverables.
* A demonstrated understanding of AI at a conceptual level.
* Excellent presentation design skills

**Desirable:**

* Experience in research-to-policy engagements, and facilitation of digital & AI strategies in health
* Experience of working with state governments in India, particularly with the National Health Mission and state health departments
* Working knowledge of Hindi and familiarity with the Chhattisgarh health system context

**Skills:**

* Excellent executive presence and upward communication skills with senior officials like IAS in the Government Systems.
* Proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking) at an advanced level.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing digital & AI initiatives in health.
* Strong knowledge of digital & AI applications for public health innovation and health system strengthening.
* Experience in digital transformation and health policy development at the national level.
* Ability to provide sound policy and technical advice on AI in health to institutions and governments.
* Familiarity with project management methodologies, process reengineering, and innovation frameworks.
* Proficiency in standard office productivity tools (text processing, spreadsheets, presentations).
* Strong ability to work in a dynamic, multidisciplinary, and international environment.
* Emotional intelligence and the ability to manage stakeholder relationships effectively.

**Ideal Persona:**

A compassionate and proactive professional having strong executive presence, excellent upward communication skills with senior IAS officials, Strong Digital Health and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Health experience, who is comfortable working in complex and dynamic settings, able to thrive at the intersection of health, technology, innovations and program management. Should have strong communication, negotiation and collaboration skills.

### **Benefits**

* Great work culture.
* Group Medical Insurance.

7c5e57a8.title: Senior Program Manager, Seller Fees Science & Tech
7c5e57a8.description:
**Description**
The Fee Strategy Operations team is seeking an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Program Manager to drive cross-functional go-to-market (GTM) execution for fee and incentive launches across Amazon's worldwide marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—partnering with Fee Strategy, Product, Operations, Legal, Seller Communications, and regional stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery of fee/incentive changes to Sellers globally. This role provides the unique opportunity of managing billion dollar incentive programs across stores and drive seller success.
  
  
Our environment is fast-paced and demands a self-starter who is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable navigating ambiguity across multiple teams, partners, and levels of management. You will own end-to-end program delivery, understand business problems at a strategic level, and have the ability to prevent or mitigate the consequences of poor business decisions. As the program owner, you will look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and deliver results with minimal oversight.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management
  
  
Partner with worldwide cross-functional teams to align GTM strategy, timelines, and deliverables for fee and incentive launches and changes. Collaborate closely with Fee Strategy Product Managers to understand GTM requirements, translate them into actionable work-backwards plans, and drive execution of GTM activities across all fee/incentive types. Act as the primary liaison between Fee Strategy and WW partner teams—Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Science, Seller Communications, Reporting, and Operations—to track, report, and monitor launch readiness, central content readiness, country teams' readiness, announcement plans, and cross-team alignment. Develop working-backwards plans and establish mechanisms to track, monitor, and report on GTM execution and launch readiness.
  
  
GTM Execution & Content Management
  
  
Identify and deliver updates to Seller-facing communications (SeCe), partnering with Country Fees POCs and partner teams to prepare and align on internal content and readiness for launches and changes. Manage end-to-end delivery of content updates for BRDs, TRDs, ARDs, Help Pages, Paragon SOPs, and country/partner teams' internal readiness for all fee/incentive types, following the GTM Launch Playbook. Maintain a centralized repository of Seller-facing content resources and internal launch documentation, managing ongoing content updates throughout the year while ensuring accuracy and version control.
  
  
Process Development & Operational Excellence
  
  
Build and implement program mechanisms to drive GTM execution, collect Seller Voice of Seller (VOS) feedback, define program performance metrics, synthesize insights, and share actionable summaries with product teams. Perform fee/incentive change validation activities, report observations and discrepancies to Product and Tech teams, and drive resolution to closure.
  
  
Program Leadership
  
  
Execute high-priority, cross-functional, high-impact projects self-sufficiently with minimal oversight. Solve complex, ambiguous problems independently by applying sound judgment, data-driven analysis, and structured thinking. Identify process gaps and proactively propose scalable solutions that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk. Analyze the overall program performance and drive program roadmap with product.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Senior Program Manager in Fee Strategy Operations, you operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. Your day involves leading cross-functional syncs with Fee Strategy PMs, Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Seller Communications, and Operations to align on launch readiness, resolve blockers, and confirm content and announcement timelines across regions. You manage hands-on deliverables—reviewing and updating Help Pages and Paragon SOPs in the centralized content repository, tracking program documentation completion and updates, performing fee change validations against Seller-facing surfaces, and escalating discrepancies to Tech/Product teams for resolution. Equally, you invest time in building scalable mechanisms—developing work-backwards plans for newly approved fee/incentive changes, synthesizing Seller VOS feedback into actionable insights for product teams, and refining the GTM playbook based on lessons learned from prior cycles. You independently manage ambiguity across 6+ partner teams spanning multiple geographies, drive cross-functional alignment without authority, and deliver results with minimal oversight—balancing strategic coordination with operational rigor every single day. You monitor the performance of the program, identify gaps, and work with country team to improve key conversion and selection metric.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* 4+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience managing competing priorities across a wide range of stakeholders
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Experience with go-to-market planning, launch execution, or operational readiness programs

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. c9c4786a.title: NewPage - Technical Principal - AI Solutions
c9c4786a.description:
**Job Description :**
Tech Principal, AI Solutions. Location : Hybrid | Type : Full-time.
  
  
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices. We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping : when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement, a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence : you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering. Third, delivery governance : you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably.
  
  
You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built : not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Shape Solutions in Discovery :
* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the client's problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end : target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually : layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership : team shape, phasing, milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.
* Set the Engineering Standards :
* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build : reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.
* Govern and Steer Delivery :
* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects : regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.
* Unblock teams directly : get into the codebase, pair on the hard problem, and make the call when a team is stuck between options.
* Keep delivery, client, and leadership views aligned on where each project genuinely stands.
* Feed lessons from delivery back into standards, so every project makes the next one better.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of engineering experience, with architecture-level ownership on multiple production systems and at least 3 years building LLM-powered and agentic applications end-to-end.
* A consulting or client-facing solutioning background : you have shaped engagements from ambiguous conversations, won technical confidence in the room, and carried trade-off discussions with business leadership without locking them in.
* Direct hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered products : RAG pipelines, prompt and context engineering, eval harnesses, and vendor-agnostic LLM abstractions.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models : you have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You have built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and templates.
* Working fluency across the capabilities you will set standards for : QA and test automation, DevSecOps, and data engineering. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in each, but you must speak each language credibly and know what good looks like.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud-native architectures on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. Cloudflare experience a plus.
* Experience governing or assuring delivery across multiple concurrent teams : technical oversight, quality gates, and steering without micromanaging.
* Strong written communication : you author ADRs, standards, scope memos, and decision documents that hold up under review.
* Storytelling craft : you turn discovery conversations into narratives that make clients see their own problem more clearly, and you present architectures and live demos to executive audiences with confidence.
* A real, recent trail of built things : GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Prior Tech Principal, Principal Consultant, Solution Architect, or Field CTO experience at a consultancy.
* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* LLMOps and observability experience (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), and model serving where the problem calls for it (Bedrock, SageMaker, vLLM).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act readiness, internal AI policy and risk frameworks).
* Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Relevant cloud architecture certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer :
  
  

* A people-first culture : supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration : work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts : we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow : opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards : competitive compensation that recognizes both contribution and potential.

(ref:hirist.tech)

a88b5c4a.title: Functional Architect
a88b5c4a.description:
**Job Summary**

This hybrid role is for a functional architect with seven to ten years of experience who specializes in o9 supply chain master planning o9 supply chain analytics o9 MEIO and Python within make to stock and configure to order models in the high tech domain delivering resilient and data driven planning solutions for a global multinational company.

**Responsibilities**

* Design end to end supply chain planning solutions in o9 platforms that optimize inventory service levels and capacity for make to stock and configure to order operations in the high tech domain
* Translate complex business needs from supply chain planners and domain experts into detailed o9 functional designs that can be implemented by technical teams without ambiguity
* Configure o9 supply chain master planning modules to support demand planning supply planning and scenario planning that align with enterprise planning cycles and decision forums
* Develop functional designs and validation rules for o9 supply chain analytics that provide clear performance dashboards alerts and insights to planners and executives
* Apply o9 MEIO capabilities to define multi echelon inventory strategies that balance working capital service risk and supply uncertainty across global networks
* Use Python to prototype analytical models perform data validation and create reference calculators that support complex planning logic and what if analysis within o9 solutions
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to define data requirements mapping rules and quality checks that ensure the integrity of demand supply and inventory data used by o9 applications
* Partner with business stakeholders to design planning calendars control towers and exception workflows that improve planner productivity and decision accuracy in day to day operations
* Conduct functional testing user acceptance testing and regression testing for o9 use cases to ensure that new releases and enhancements maintain stability and expected business outcomes
* Document solution designs process flows and user guides in clear and structured formats that help planners adopt new capabilities and reduce dependency on support teams
* Provide hypercare and ongoing functional support for o9 platforms by monitoring issues prioritizing fixes and fine tuning configurations to improve solution performance over time
* Coordinate with cross functional teams from procurement manufacturing logistics and finance to ensure that o9 planning outputs are actionable and align with enterprise objectives
* Advise stakeholders on best practices in digital supply chain planning scenario modeling and analytics adoption so that technology investments deliver measurable value and societal impact through resilient product availability

**Qualifications**

* Possess seven to ten years of experience in supply chain planning solutions with a primary focus on functional architecture and design in enterprise scale environments
* Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in o9 supply chain master planning including configuration scenario design and integration with upstream and downstream systems
* Bring practical experience in o9 supply chain analytics with the ability to define key metrics design dashboards and guide users on interpreting insights for daily decisions
* Show proven knowledge of o9 MEIO concepts such as safety stock modeling service level targeting and multi echelon policies that support high tech product portfolios
* Hold solid proficiency in Python for data analysis prototyping algorithms and supporting complex planning logic that complements o9 platform capabilities
* Exhibit deep domain understanding of make to stock and configure to order models in the high tech industry including product lifecycles lead times and configuration complexity
* Display strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills to work effectively with planners engineers and managers in hybrid work arrangements across global teams
* Work comfortably in a hybrid work model that balances remote collaboration with onsite workshops while supporting day shift schedules and minimal travel requirements

524e62e9.title: Senior Demo Platform Architect
524e62e9.description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience**
**Position Overview:**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
* Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
* Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
* Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
* Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
* Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
* Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
* Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
* Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
* Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
* Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
* Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
* Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
* Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
* Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
* Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.
* Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.
* Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios.
* Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
* Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
* Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
  
  
**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
  
  
Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
  
  
As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.
  
  
Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here.
  
  
Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.

00f8530a.description:

**Responsibilities**

* Develop APIs/microservices with Python, .NET, or Node and integrate them with UIs and enterprise systems
* Drive agentic AI development using Azure AI Foundry and Copilot Studio
* Implement CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps and manage cloud deployments across AKS, App Service, and Functions
* Build data and feature pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or Databricks and manage embeddings and prompt versioning
* Deploy models into production and maintain them over time
* Adhere to coding standards and AI principles by conducting regular health checks, audits, and code reviews to ensure clean, maintainable, production-level code across project teams

**Requirements**

* 6-14 years of overall IT experience
* Strong coding skills in Python, C#, and REST/GraphQL APIs, along with experience in testing and code reviews
* Hands-on expertise in the Azure AI stack, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Cognitive Services
* Familiarity with Azure AI Search, NLP, and Azure ML, along with vector databases such as AI Search vector index, Cosmos DB, or PostgreSQL
* Experience in agentic development using the Azure AI stack
* Proficiency in CI/CD with GitHub, branching strategies, and coding standards such as linters, formatters, and PEP8, along with GitHub Actions pipelines
* Skills in containerization with Docker and deployment to AKS, App Service, or Functions
* Knowledge of secrets management via Key Vault and Managed Identity, along with RBAC and network security basics
* Understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, and data security in enterprise settings

**Nice to have**

* Experience with GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Studio (Power Platform)
* Familiarity with PromptFlow, MLflow, Databricks, and Streamlit or React
* Background in MLOps and/or LLMOps practices
* Azure certifications (AI-102, AZ-204)
* Experience working with one of the big cloud environments (e.g. Azure)
* Knowledge of RAG patterns, prompt design, tool/function calling, embeddings, retrieval, and caching
* Preferred experience working with Asset projects

AI Infrastructure Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. Optimize AI infrastructure/hardware performance, power consumption, cost and scalability of computational stack. Advise on AI infrastructure technology and vendor evaluation, selection and full stack integration.

15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Azure, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized compute infrastructure for large-scale AI and machine learning systems. You will design scalable distributed training environments, model-serving foundations, automation patterns and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, cloud modernization, regulated workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Azure-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Azure compute infrastructure for large-scale AI/ML systems, including distributed training, GPU/accelerated compute, container platforms and model-serving environments.
  
  
Design and tune large-scale Azure GPU clusters and distributed training systems using services such as Azure VMs, AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Storage, Azure NetApp Files, Azure Virtual Network, Entra ID, Azure Monitor and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions, including accelerator selection, networking and high-throughput storage design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Azure, applying deep knowledge of Azure AI/ML services, accelerators, networking, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Azure AI infrastructure services including Azure VMs, AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Storage, Azure NetApp Files, Azure Virtual Network, Entra ID, Azure Monitor and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
  
  
Experience architecting GPU/accelerated compute, distributed training, model serving, high-throughput storage, container platforms and secure cloud networking.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of Bicep/ARM/Terraform, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, InfraOps, MLOps, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Azure AI infrastructure for performance, power, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable infrastructure patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Azure certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure AI Engineer or Azure Data Engineer credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where AI infrastructure must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to LLM infrastructure, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, GPU scheduling, high-performance storage, low-latency model serving and model optimization techniques.
  
  
Knowledge of enterprise architecture governance, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

306977c6.description:
**Description**
Are you interested in launching the next generation of Amazon sites in India? Do you want to be part of the ongoing growth and expansion of Amazon’s infrastructure? The IN-Engineering Services Team is seeking an experienced Amazon Operator or Program Manager to join the IN-Launch Team to support the expansion of operation sites in India. The Launch Program Manager is a key player in the end-to-end delivery of the complex challenge of launching new buildings, driving improvements and standards to enable new buildings to achieve benchmark rates while ramping to meet network capacity. In this role, you will influence a team comprising of General Managers, Senior Operations Managers, Operation Managers, Change Ops manager, Area Managers, Project Managers, Process SMEs, Design Engineers, Real Estate, RME, CP as well as representatives of various key stakeholder teams including Supply Chain & Transportation, WHS, WFS, L&D, ICQA, EHS, Legal, L&P, ER, Finance and many others. This role calls for an individual who is operationally knowledgeable, structured, confident and professionally and socially adept to earn credibility and trust with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization, keeping an open mind, sense of humor, multi-tasking, ability to manage and deal with constant change, a drive-and-ambition and ability to deal with ambiguity will help you remain innovative in our culture
  
  
In order to be successful in this position, you need to be comfortable interfacing and driving various BU’s launches, including INFC, IXD/RC, DRCC, SDC, SC, AMZL, GSF, QC & 3P launches for respective BU’s. This will be an exciting opportunity for you if you possess a high level of autonomy and integrity while managing a variety of job responsibilities. You will be part of a high functioning team that is interconnected and supportive of each other to help complete multiple, complex and high capital projects simultaneously.
  
  
The individual will be responsible for entire region (IN Network Operate in 3 Regions, “North & East”, “South & Central” and “West”). The role will be based out of 3 regions with up to 50% of time on job travel across states. This is the fusion of strategical as well as tactical during full cycle of launch.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**The Successful Candidate**

* Is structured and organized, to plan the use of resource to meet deadlines.
* Has strong interpersonal skills, to motivate and lead core teams working on launch.
* Has strong communication skills to build relationships and identify with stakeholders across the organization.
* Is able to use their initiative and make decisions under pressure.
* Has the ability to seek opportunities to drive year on year performance and process improvements
* Will compile, manage and report on weekly launch metrics and be responsible for leading many high-profile meetings to align on launch requirements.
* Has the ability to learn fast and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.
* Has operational skills and experience.
* Can work closely with core team from operational and construction sites.
* Setup mechanism for tracking overall launch, support function 4M and signage delivery system.
* Drive learnings and adhoc requirements through CM mechanism from respective stakeholders.
* Can work independently to solve problems and drive actions with a variety of stakeholders.
* Monitors and reports on the progress of all launch activity within the site project including significant milestones and any conditions which would affect project schedule.
* Should be able to ask “Why” and request details in regards to the impact of any changes requested by different teams.
* Is capable of taking accountability while providing status, asking for help, and immediately escalating issues and problems as necessary.
* Should be able to coordinate activities while onsite as well as from the office.
* Possesses a broad technical background and has the ability to “roll up their sleeves” and jump in to support, along with Coordinating the activities of different functions and act as the anchor or single point of contact for the launch process

A day in the life
  
  

* End-to-End project coordination, managing multiple stakeholders to ensure all Road to Launch tasks are completed as per program
* Managing Launch calls with regional teams, documenting key actionable and ensure closure of key points.
* Ensuring support function 4M cycle completion as per process.
* Ensuring all function signage cycle completion as per process.
* Ensure 5S marking BOQ closure as per site requirement.
* Coordinate with RE for site selection process as per SLA and POR NBD with SIM mechanism in place.
* Ensure TAX registration process and support seller onboarding process as per Launch tenets.
* Ensuring overall site readiness through thorough composite reviews and effective communication on in-flight changes
* Post launch lessons learned sessions to drive year-on-year improvements
* Managing continuous improvement in 4M, Playbook, Signages and launch mechanism.

**About The Team**
Our team is focused on driving programmatic excellence across Amazon, delivering results that matter to customers and the business. We operate in a collaborative environment where new ideas are welcomed and simplification is a priority. As we continue to grow, we are investing in automation, data-driven planning, and scalable mechanisms that raise the bar on how we deliver. This is a team where your leadership will have a direct impact on both the people you manage and the programs you own.

* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

05ddfc44.title: Senior Business Solution Architect
05ddfc44.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Finance & Accounting Solution Architect**
**Position Summary**
The Finance & Accounting (F&A) Solution Architect is responsible for designing end-to-end Finance and Accounting outsourcing solutions for prospective clients. This role combines deep F&A operational expertise with business process transformation, benchmarking, commercial modeling, and proposal development capabilities. The Solution Architect works closely with sales, operations, pricing, transition, technology, and client stakeholders to develop competitive, scalable, and outcome-based solutions that address client business challenges.
  
  
The individual will lead solution design activities during pursuit and proposal phases, develop staffing and delivery models, leverage industry benchmarks to establish operational assumptions, and create compelling responses to RFPs, RFIs, and client presentations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Deal Shaping**

* Design end-to-end Finance & Accounting service delivery solutions across:

+ Source to Pay
+ Order to Cash
+ Record to Report

* Assess client requirements and translate them into scalable operating models.
* Develop service delivery strategies leveraging onshore, nearshore, offshore, and hybrid delivery models.
* Design organizational structures, staffing models, governance frameworks, and service management models.
* Identify process improvement and automation opportunities utilizing workflow, AI, OCR, RPA, and analytics solutions.

**Benchmarking & Operational Analysis**

* Utilize internal and external benchmark data to establish:

+ Productivity assumptions
+ Staffing estimates
+ Cost models
+ Performance targets
+ Service level commitments

* Analyze transaction volumes, handling times, complexity factors, and operating metrics.
* Develop capacity models and forecasts to support deal pricing and business cases.
* Recommend best practices based on industry-leading F&A operations.

**RFP & Proposal Development**

* Lead the F&A solution response for RFPs, RFIs, and client pursuits.
* Develop solution narratives, executive summaries, staffing approaches, transition methodologies, and service delivery models.
* Collaborate with pricing teams to create cost models and commercial recommendations.
* Support proposal reviews and ensure alignment between solution, pricing, and operational assumptions.
* Participate in client presentations, solution workshops, and due diligence sessions.

**Client Engagement**

* Facilitate discovery workshops to understand client objectives, pain points, and requirements.
* Present solution recommendations to executive stakeholders.
* Respond to client questions regarding operating models, transformation opportunities, staffing, governance, and delivery capabilities.
* Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the sales lifecycle.

**Transition & Transformation Planning**

* Develop transition and implementation approaches for new engagements.
* Assess transition risks and mitigation strategies.
* Define governance, reporting, and continuous improvement frameworks.
* Support the handoff from sales to implementation teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
* 8+ years of Finance & Accounting operations, consulting, outsourcing, shared services, or business process services experience.
* 3+ years designing solutions for F&A outsourcing, managed services, or shared services organizations.
* Experience supporting large-scale RFP responses and competitive pursuits.
* Strong understanding of F&A process areas and operating models.
* Experience building staffing, productivity, and financial models using benchmark data.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Strong business writing and executive presentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in BPO, shared services, consulting, or finance transformation environments.
* Knowledge of ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle
* Experience with automation technologies including RPA, OCR, AI, and workflow platforms.
* Familiarity with Six Sigma, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies.

**Critical Competencies**
**Functional Expertise**

* Finance & Accounting Operations
* Shared Services
* Outsourcing and Managed Services
* Benchmarking and Analytics
* Financial Modeling
* Workforce Planning

**Business Development**

* RFP Response Development
* Solution Design
* Deal Shaping
* Commercial Awareness
* Executive Presentation Skills
* Client Relationship Management

**Leadership**

* Cross-functional Team Leadership
* Stakeholder Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Negotiation and Influencing

**Flexible Working**
At Conduent, we value individuality and flexible working arrangements. In this role, you can expect:
  
  

* Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of working from home while optimizing your work-life balance.

**Working for You**
We offer perks and rewards designed to support you:
  
  

* Health & Welfare Benefits: Comprehensive plans tailored to your needs, effective from day one.
* Retirement Savings: Robust programs to help you secure your financial future.
* Employee Discounts: Access to a wide range of discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more.
* Career Growth Opportunities: Paths for advancement within a global organization.
* Paid Training: Learn while you earn with award-winning learning platforms.
* Paid Time Off: Competitive PTO packages to help you recharge.
* Great Work Environment: Join an award-winning culture that values diversity and inclusion.

**Join Us**
At Conduent, we are united by a shared mission. We understand that our success is driven by the success of our associates. When you join us, you’ll find opportunities to:
  
  

* Bring your authentic self to work every day.
* Grow and thrive both personally and professionally.
* Make a meaningful impact with our clients, in our communities, and for the millions of people we serve.

With over 50,000 associates in 24 countries, you’ll be part of a global team that’s shaping the future — for the company and for yourself.
  
  
Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

Complete the form and then email it as an attachment to FTADAAA@conduent.com. You may also click here to access Conduent's ADAAA Accommodation Policy.

1b883ea2.title: Senior Data Architect
1b883ea2.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Data Architect

**Experience:** 7+ Years

**Location:** India (Ahmedabad / Hybrid/Remote)

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Architect to support the modernization and enhancement of Enterprise Analytic Data Warehouse (ADW). The candidate will be responsible for evaluating existing data architecture, designing scalable data models, assessing data integration across clinical, operational and financial domains, and establishing data governance and data quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess and review the existing Enterprise Analytic Data Warehouse architecture, database structures and data integration processes.
* Design and improve enterprise data models covering clinical, operational, financial and revenue-cycle information.
* Define data architecture standards, database structures, data relationships and integration strategies.
* Evaluate data flows between source systems and the data warehouse.
* Design and review source-to-target mappings and data lineage.
* Identify architectural gaps affecting data completeness, consistency, integrity and reporting accuracy.
* Establish standardized data definitions, data governance practices and metadata management.
* Ensure consistent patient, facility, payer and other critical identifiers across different datasets.
* Support integration of billing, claims, payment, denial and accounts receivable (AR) data.
* Work with SQL and Python-based data processing solutions to investigate and validate data structures.
* Recommend improvements to warehouse scalability, performance, reliability and maintainability.
* Develop a prioritized architecture and modernization roadmap for future implementation.
* Coordinate with data engineers, analytics engineers and business stakeholders.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in Data Architecture and Enterprise Data Warehousing.
* Advanced SQL and relational database concepts.
* Experience with data modelling (conceptual, logical and physical).
* Knowledge of ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration.
* Experience with data profiling, data lineage and metadata management.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality and data validation frameworks.
* Experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Python knowledge for data analysis and validation.
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms or modern data warehouse technologies.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Databricks, Azure, AWS or similar cloud data platforms.
* Experience with healthcare data warehouses.
* Knowledge of clinical, financial, billing and claims datasets.
* Understanding of HIPAA, PHI and healthcare data security principles.
* Experience with healthcare analytics, reimbursement and revenue-cycle data.

Pay: ₹2,500,000.00 - ₹3,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380054

 • Experience working with System Integrators and external delivery partners.

**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both**

  

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

  

**What the week contains**

  

Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.

  

**The uncomfortable part**

  

Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.

  

**Looking for**

  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering or a customer-facing technical role
* Enough hands-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience

  

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.

  

*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer-facing engineering roles here.*

One coherent target architecture that every workstream builds toward, cross-team technical decisions made quickly, and visible progress in modernizing the product.

ae3a2be4.description:
Lead Specialist, Solution Architect - OnVUE

  
  

About OnVUE

  
  

OnVUE is Pearson’s online proctored test delivery platform, supporting the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments for Pearson’s certification and professional testing business. The platform enables candidates to test remotely while maintaining exam integrity through identity verification, monitoring, secure delivery workflows, and operational controls. The OnVUE environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery, candidate and proctor experience, and improved developer and operational practices.

  
  

Role summary

  
  

As a Lead Specialist, Solution Architect, you are a recognized subject-matter expert who provides technical leadership for sophisticated, high-impact solution work. You independently translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into secure, scalable, viable, and maintainable architectural models and guide solution delivery from inception through implementation.

  
  

You maintain technical consistency within the assigned scope, balance advanced solution design with hands-on support for complex delivery challenges, and resolve day-to-day integration and build issues. You influence through depth of knowledge, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to steer architecture discussions toward practical outcomes. You mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers, establish trusted technical patterns within your domain, ensure conformance to established frameworks, and escalate decisions that materially exceed the assigned scope to senior experts.

  
  

Key responsibilities

  
  

Solution architecture and technical leadership

  

  
* Translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into robust architectural models and fit-for-purpose solution designs.
  
  
* Own solution architecture from discovery and design through implementation and production adoption.
  
  
* Provide technical leadership for high-impact projects, major features, product changes, services, domains, or business capabilities.
  
  
* Maintain technical consistency within the assigned product, service, project, domain, or broader solution footprint.
  
  
* Evaluate and communicate tradeoffs involving scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, integration, delivery risk, operational needs, and business value.
  

  

Implementation and delivery guidance

  

  
* Guide engineering and delivery teams through implementation while preserving architectural intent.
  
  
* Resolve complex architectural, integration, and build issues within the assigned scope.
  
  
* Consult on technical feasibility for major features, updates, integrations, and solution approaches.
  
  
* Identify high-stakes architectural risks early and coordinate practical mitigation.
  
  
* Adapt architecture to changing requirements without sacrificing solution stability, security, or long-term maintainability.
  

  

Standards, influence, and capability building

  

  
* Establish trusted and repeatable technical patterns within the assigned domain while ensuring conformance with established architecture frameworks, standards, and guidelines.
  
  
* Participate in architecture forums and guide discussions toward sound, practical outcomes.
  
  
* Mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers in solution design, technical practices, and architectural decision-making.
  
  
* Communicate design options, recommendations, constraints, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Escalate decisions outside the assigned scope or requiring senior technical or enterprise direction.
  

  

Required education and experience

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
* Progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience designing sophisticated solutions and guiding delivery from inception through implementation.
  
  
* Experience translating business needs and technical constraints into secure, scalable, maintainable architecture.
  
  
* Experience influencing architecture and delivery outcomes without formal authority.
  

  

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

  

  
* Strong solution architecture, system design, integration, and technical problem-solving skills.
  
  
* Ability to evaluate solution options and explain tradeoffs across business value, delivery feasibility, risk, and long-term technology health.
  
  
* Working knowledge of Java-based enterprise application stacks, cloud-native design, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, containers, orchestration, CI/CD, observability, security, data consistency, and operational readiness.
  
  
* Practical familiarity with service decomposition, API gateway patterns, versioned API contracts, distributed tracing, messaging, data-driven backend systems, and headless or decoupled front-end and back-end architecture patterns.
  
  
* Strong documentation, facilitation, communication, and influencing skills.
  
  
* Ability to mentor others and introduce trusted, repeatable technical approaches.
  

  

Success measures

  

  
* Architecture artifacts are clear, fit for purpose, timely, and enable secure, scalable, stable implementation.
  
  
* Solution designs are adopted successfully, integrate effectively, and remain durable in production.
  
  
* Design choices minimize avoidable rework, support business continuity, and reduce preventable technical risk.
  
  
* Technical blockers and high-stakes architectural risks are identified and resolved or escalated in time to protect delivery.
  
  
* Documentation and quality standards are met with limited revision cycles.
  
  
* Repeatable technical approaches, mentorship, and knowledge transfer improve team effectiveness.
  
  
* Stakeholders trust the role to explain design options, constraints, and tradeoffs and to guide solution delivery.
  

  

Leadership behaviors

  

  
* Customer Centricity — Tailors architecture decisions to real operational and business needs and responds quickly when issues threaten outcomes.
  
  
* Raise the Performance Bar — Applies advanced design techniques, strengthens technical practices, and shares approaches that improve solution quality.
  
  
* Exceptional Collaboration for Value — Guides technical discussions, incorporates different perspectives, and supports alignment and integration across the assigned scope.
  
  
* Our Leaders Inspire — Models technical curiosity, sound judgment, visible accountability, and a commitment to developing others.
  

  

**Location & Working Pattern**

  
  

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process.

This is an opportunity to develop engineering talent, strengthen delivery and quality practices, and help teams adopt emerging AI-assisted ways of working across technology that supports assessment experiences at scale.

358f90f0.description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.

**What We Need To See**

* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
* At least 5+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, Ethernet or InfiniBand World.
* Hands-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Be proficient in end-to-end IB/Eth cluster deployment, adapter configuration and firmware maintenance, and able to conduct professional performance benchmarking with mainstream RDMA testing tools.
* Capable of independently diagnosing and troubleshooting typical IB/Eth network anomalies, including link flapping, connection failure, as well as bandwidth and latency jitter issues.
* Master practical RDMA network optimization strategies such as QP tuning, MTU configuration and congestion control optimization.
* Hands-on working experience in RDMA-accelerated business scenarios, including distributed storage and high-performance computing clusters.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
* Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Advanced Linux or Networking Certifications.
* Experience with High-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers(Slurm, PBS) work.
* luster management technologies knowledge (bonus credit for BCM (Base Command Manager).)
* Experience with GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) focused hardware/software.
