d3b2241d.title: Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India)
d3b2241d.description:
As an Applied AI Architect for the Meta Enterprise Platform, you are the strategic technical advisor who helps enterprise customers understand the full potential of our Enterprise AI products (such as Model API) and design the right architectures to unlock that value. You combine deep knowledge of Generative AI with enterprise architecture expertise and effective communication skills to guide customers from initial discovery through successful deployment, ongoing adoption and expansion.This role combines pre-sales technical leadership with post-sales customer adoption and expansion. You will design scalable architectures, develop evaluation frameworks, create reference implementations, and serve as the technical authority that gives customers and internal stakeholders the confidence to purchase. You are the architect of the blueprint - ensuring the right technical foundation is in place before and during implementation. You will not just design architectures; you will help to deploy end-to-end AI solutions that drive actual AI usage such as API consumption and business ROI. You will own the customer's technical success from the initial scoping phase through to live production deployment, post-sales adoption and growth.  
  
  

### **Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India) Responsibilities:**

* \*\*Technical Discovery & Solution Design\*\* - Partner with sales to deeply understand customer requirements, business context, and existing technology stacks. Translate these into clear, technically feasible AI solution architectures and integration plans
* \*\*Technical Account Ownership\*\* - Establish technical account plans covering current use cases, adoption milestones and agreed measures of value. Review API usage, technical account health and blockers. Qualify additional use cases and help build the technical case for expansion. Coordinate specialist input where needed and follow through on agreed actions
* \*\*AI Architecture Advisory\*\* - Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the customer's AI / API adoption journey. Guide architecture decisions around LLM selection, RAG patterns, prompt engineering strategies, agentic workflow and tool use, data pipelines, and enterprise integration points
* \*\*Evaluation & Proof of Value\*\* - Design and guide customer evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI performance for specific use cases. Create compelling demos, reference architectures, and lightweight POCs that demonstrate practical value and feasibility. Agree acceptance criteria for quality, latency, cost and reliability, linking evaluation results to customer business goals and a decision on production deployment
* \*\*Enterprise Trust & Governance\*\* - Address enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). Navigate complex sales lifecycles involving IT, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders to build technical confidence
* \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration\*\* - Act as the bridge between customers and internal Product, Engineering, and PMM teams. Gather technical feedback, identify common integration patterns, surface product gaps, and contribute field insights that shape the product roadmap and GTM strategy
* \*\*Thought Leadership & Enablement\*\* - Create technical content including architecture guides, best-practice documentation, and industry-specific solution briefs. Enable the broader sales and partner ecosystem with technical training and reusable assets
* \*\*Hands-on Solutions\*\* - Act as the primary technical owner for strategic accounts. Assist in the design, prototyping, and deployment planning for customer full-stack applications, RAG pipelines, and custom integrations using our AI APIs. Contribute reference implementations and technical reviews
* \*\*Rapid Prototyping\*\* - Translate customer business problems into concrete technical plans. Rapidly develop and iterate on functional proofs-of-concept (POCs) to demonstrate immediate value
* \*\*Production Implementation\*\* - Guide customers through the "Integration Wall." Navigate enterprise security, legacy databases, and complex infrastructures
* \*\*Technical Advisory\*\* - Serve as the subject matter expert on Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI security/guardrails for C-level executives and lead developers
* \*\*Travel\*\* - Flexibility to travel up to 30% of the time

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience engaging enterprise customers through the sales lifecycle, purchasing and deployment decisions, involving multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Legal, and executive leadership
* Comfortable with Python and able to build lightweight demos, scripts, and reference implementations (not expected to write production-grade application code)
* Familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem: APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks. Ability to use LLM APIs to build and evaluate lightweight demos, prototypes and reference implementations
* Ability to design use-case-specific evaluation tests and assess quality, latency, cost and reliability against agreed customer requirements and business goals
* Experience planning and managing customer technical engagements, resolving blockers and coordinating customer and internal teams through evaluation, integration and adoption. A high degree of ownership, and the ability to thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments
* Experience communicating and translating complex AI/ML concepts for C-suite executives, IT leaders, engineering teams and non-technical business leaders while simultaneously working with customer engineering teams

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with AI safety, responsible AI practices, and implementing guardrails for LLM applications in regulated industries
* Experience creating and delivering technical enablement programs for sales teams, partners, or customer communities
* Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HIPAA) in the context of AI deployments
* Experience architecting AI/ML solutions at scale in enterprise environments, including model deployment, monitoring, and governance. Experience helping customers move from evaluation to live applications with measurable business value
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with AI observability, evaluation frameworks (evals) assessing quality, latency, cost and reliability, and implementing enterprise-grade security guardrails for AI applications
* Hands-on experience building applications using AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem (Vector Databases, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, tool use and frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

As an Applied AI Architect for the Meta Enterprise Platform, you are the strategic technical advisor who helps enterprise customers understand the full potential of our Enterprise AI products (such as Model API) and design the right architectures to unlock that value. You combine deep knowledge of Generative AI with enterprise architecture expertise and effective communication skills to guide customers from initial discovery through successful deployment, ongoing adoption and expansion.This role combines pre-sales technical leadership with post-sales customer adoption and expansion. You will design scalable architectures, develop evaluation frameworks, create reference implementations, and serve as the technical authority that gives customers and internal stakeholders the confidence to purchase. You are the architect of the blueprint - ensuring the right technical foundation is in place before and during implementation. You will not just design architectures; you will help to deploy end-to-end AI solutions that drive actual AI usage such as API consumption and business ROI. You will own the customer's technical success from the initial scoping phase through to live production deployment, post-sales adoption and growth.
  
  
Applied AI Architect, Meta Enterprise Platform (India) Responsibilities:
  
  

* \*\*Technical Discovery & Solution Design\*\* - Partner with sales to deeply understand customer requirements, business context, and existing technology stacks. Translate these into clear, technically feasible AI solution architectures and integration plans
* \*\*Technical Account Ownership\*\* - Establish technical account plans covering current use cases, adoption milestones and agreed measures of value. Review API usage, technical account health and blockers. Qualify additional use cases and help build the technical case for expansion. Coordinate specialist input where needed and follow through on agreed actions
* \*\*AI Architecture Advisory\*\* - Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the customer's AI / API adoption journey. Guide architecture decisions around LLM selection, RAG patterns, prompt engineering strategies, agentic workflow and tool use, data pipelines, and enterprise integration points
* \*\*Evaluation & Proof of Value\*\* - Design and guide customer evaluation frameworks (evals) to measure AI performance for specific use cases. Create compelling demos, reference architectures, and lightweight POCs that demonstrate practical value and feasibility. Agree acceptance criteria for quality, latency, cost and reliability, linking evaluation results to customer business goals and a decision on production deployment
* \*\*Enterprise Trust & Governance\*\* - Address enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR). Navigate complex sales lifecycles involving IT, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders to build technical confidence
* \*\*Cross-Functional Collaboration\*\* - Act as the bridge between customers and internal Product, Engineering, and PMM teams. Gather technical feedback, identify common integration patterns, surface product gaps, and contribute field insights that shape the product roadmap and GTM strategy
* \*\*Thought Leadership & Enablement\*\* - Create technical content including architecture guides, best-practice documentation, and industry-specific solution briefs. Enable the broader sales and partner ecosystem with technical training and reusable assets
* \*\*Hands-on Solutions\*\* - Act as the primary technical owner for strategic accounts. Assist in the design, prototyping, and deployment planning for customer full-stack applications, RAG pipelines, and custom integrations using our AI APIs. Contribute reference implementations and technical reviews
* \*\*Rapid Prototyping\*\* - Translate customer business problems into concrete technical plans. Rapidly develop and iterate on functional proofs-of-concept (POCs) to demonstrate immediate value
* \*\*Production Implementation\*\* - Guide customers through the "Integration Wall." Navigate enterprise security, legacy databases, and complex infrastructures
* \*\*Technical Advisory\*\* - Serve as the subject matter expert on Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI security/guardrails for C-level executives and lead developers
* \*\*Travel\*\* - Flexibility to travel up to 30% of the time

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience engaging enterprise customers through the sales lifecycle, purchasing and deployment decisions, involving multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Legal, and executive leadership
* Comfortable with Python and able to build lightweight demos, scripts, and reference implementations (not expected to write production-grade application code)
* Familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem: APIs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks. Ability to use LLM APIs to build and evaluate lightweight demos, prototypes and reference implementations
* Ability to design use-case-specific evaluation tests and assess quality, latency, cost and reliability against agreed customer requirements and business goals
* Experience planning and managing customer technical engagements, resolving blockers and coordinating customer and internal teams through evaluation, integration and adoption. A high degree of ownership, and the ability to thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments
* Experience communicating and translating complex AI/ML concepts for C-suite executives, IT leaders, engineering teams and non-technical business leaders while simultaneously working with customer engineering teams

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with AI safety, responsible AI practices, and implementing guardrails for LLM applications in regulated industries
* Experience creating and delivering technical enablement programs for sales teams, partners, or customer communities
* Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HIPAA) in the context of AI deployments
* Experience architecting AI/ML solutions at scale in enterprise environments, including model deployment, monitoring, and governance. Experience helping customers move from evaluation to live applications with measurable business value
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with AI observability, evaluation frameworks (evals) assessing quality, latency, cost and reliability, and implementing enterprise-grade security guardrails for AI applications
* Hands-on experience building applications using AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and familiarity with the Generative AI ecosystem (Vector Databases, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, tool use and frameworks like LangChain/LangGraph)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

a5a5dcb8.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team
a5a5dcb8.description:
**Description**
Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team exist to ensure device and application customers have delightful experiences using the product by enabling swift, precise, and privacy-compliant observability and issue resolution across all devices and applications. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of device data into actionable insights that drive product stability and customer satisfaction. To achieve this mission, we provide comprehensive technology solutions spanning the entire observability lifecycle. This includes on-device crash and log management, high-scale data ingestion services, advanced analytics dashboards, and intuitive troubleshooting interfaces.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager for the Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services team, you will drive critical initiatives that enhance the detection, diagnosis, and resolution of issues across Amazon's device ecosystem. This high-visibility role requires exceptional leadership in coordinating across several engineering teams, data engineers, applied scientists,BIEs and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable troubleshooting solutions that improve customer experience. You will be responsible for influencing feature priorities and getting buy in from engineering teams for delivery of large cross-organization programs. You will leverage your technical knowledge to drive technical trade-off decisions. You will represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to technical and business leaders to help them understand decisions and options. As a Technical Program Manager, you will be one of the key leaders on the team and have an impact by defining strategy & requirements, developing processes & schedules, and driving forward progress on major initiatives.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will bring strong project management skills to systematically drive programs and deliver results. You possess good technical skills to deal with ambiguous programs to drive clarity in scope and execution. You are have demonstrated ability in driving programs with multiple stakeholders, use escalation mechanisms and negotiation skills to drive the right outcomes. You have good communication skills, both written and verbal and are adept in communicating with stakeholders and executives with right level of detail and clarity.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will drive key business collaborations critical to improving the customer experience with Amazon Devices.
  
  

* You will partner with Senior Leaders within Amazon Devices to identify opportunities to increase device stability, reduce device resource utilizations, save costs and improve efficiency.
* You will define and implement strategical partnerships that enables businesses in Amazon Devices scale faster, save costs, and improve efficiency.
* You will establish mechanisms and processes that drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
* You will establish metrics and design self-serve reports to keep stake-holders informed and excited about the progress

A day in the life
  
  
This role will drive engagement across different product lines to design and drive programs that will improve the stability, reduce the resource utilization of the devices. You will also help build mechanisms to prevent duplication of tools across teams for troubleshooting and analysis. As a direct result, this role offers the challenge as well as the opportunity to bring structure and clarity to a fast-moving space. This high visibility role is inherently cross-organizational in nature. You will be a champion of this product to senior leadership.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services (ADTS) team ensures that troubleshooting is quick, easy, and privacy-centric for device and application teams, so that end customers have delightful experiences with their Amazon Devices. We provide a single place for device and application teams to troubleshoot known issues, uncover emergent trends or regressions, and quantify the impact in the context of the customer journey. We build technology to deliver high-quality user experiences for troubleshooting and analysis, ensure stability of the device, and proactively present critical issues and root causes to relevant teams based on a wide range of health and customer journey data.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

7cba452e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Amazon Now
7cba452e.description:
**Description**
We build the customer experience platform behind Amazon's quick commerce businesses, the platform that powers shopping journeys across marketplaces at roughly 700K orders a day. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive platform programs spanning 12+ tenants and 500+ developers as we evolve from a multi marketplace stack into a true multi business platform.
  
  
You will own the programs that turn a single business stack into versioned API contracts, a federated front end, and surface agnostic shopping capabilities that any Amazon business can configure into a journey of its own shape. Each tenant brings different needs, and your job is to sequence that work so businesses compose journeys instead of forking the platform.
  
  
This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical programs and many stakeholder coordination, who can hold a three year architectural direction while shipping quarter over quarter, and who cares that a page is ready in sub-second at Amazon volume.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own cross team programs that deliver certified, versioned API contracts and a bring your own API extension path, so new businesses onboard by configuration rather than by forking the stack.
* Drive the front end federation program (shell, component registry, tenant packages, build time isolation) across feature teams shipping independently to production.
* Coordinate onboarding of new tenants and marketplaces, cutting time to launch from three months toward weeks, and track the platform effort each onboarding costs.
* Run the performance, resilience, and observability programs that keep every journey fast and tenant isolated at scale, including interaction budgets, alarm based rollback, and prevention of cross tenant incidents.
* Build the mechanisms that govern what earns a place in the shared core versus what stays a business owned extension, resolving competing tenant needs across 12+ clients.
* Manage dependencies with partner platforms and drive convergence decisions.
* Establish program rhythm across 500+ developers: roadmaps, release schedules, risk and critical path management, and quarterly checkpoints against annual targets.
* Translate a three year platform vision into sequenced, committed deliverables with clear exit criteria.

A day in the life
  
  
You start with the programs in flight across the platform, unblocking a tenant onboarding here and a contract certification there. You work with multiple senior and principal engineers on architecture tradeoffs, with product managers on which capabilities graduate into the core, and with partner teams on shared dependencies. You keep the performance and resilience bars visible, chase down a latency regression before it crosses tenants, and prep the quarterly checkpoint against annual targets. Your stakeholders span multiple leaders from fast growing businesses WW, and your customers are the Amazon teams building shopping experience using our platform.
  
  
**About The Team**
We currently run the customer experience platform behind Amazon's quick commerce businesses. What began as one team's customer journey stack has grown into a single platform serving multiple marketplaces at roughly 700K orders a day. We are a B2B product whose customers are Amazon businesses, and our mission is to let any of them launch, experiment, and scale a shopping journey without building the stack beneath it. Multiple Amazon businesses came to us organically because the paradigm works. We are now one architectural shape away from becoming the default place a new shopping journey starts at Amazon, and this role helps get us there.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience owning program strategy for a platform, set of APIs, or shared services consumed by multiple internal teams
* Experience delivering versioned API contracts, developer facing tooling, or tenant onboarding programs at scale
* Experience driving performance, resilience, or observability programs across distributed systems
* Experience developing and executing technical roadmaps across many stakeholder teams

7ffe0bd0.title: BIM Architect
7ffe0bd0.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented BIM professional with strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit to develop, manage, and coordinate Building Information Models (BIM) across architectural and construction projects. The role involves translating architectural concepts, design development, and engineering inputs into accurate, coordinated, and construction-ready BIM models and documentation.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of architectural detailing, construction methodologies, building systems, and multidisciplinary coordination, with the ability to work independently and deliver models and drawings to defined project standards.

Key Responsibilities

**1. BIM Modelling & Documentation**

* Develop and maintain detailed architectural BIM models using Autodesk Revit.
* Prepare architectural plans, elevations, sections, reflected ceiling plans, schedules, and construction documentation.
* Develop detailed 3D models with appropriate Levels of Development (LOD) based on project requirements.
* Generate accurate construction drawings, details, schedules, and quantity take-offs from BIM models.
* Maintain model accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project BIM standards.

**2. BIM Coordination**

* Coordinate architectural models with Structural and MEP models.
* Identify and resolve design clashes, spatial conflicts, and discrepancies.
* Work with multidisciplinary consultants to integrate engineering inputs into coordinated models.
* Support model reviews and coordination exercises using Navisworks or equivalent tools.

**3. Construction & Technical Detailing**

* Develop detailed construction assemblies, wall sections, floor and roof systems, openings, and architectural interfaces.
* Understand material specifications, junction details, buildability, and construction sequencing.
* Translate design intent into technically accurate and constructible documentation.
* Support the development of fabrication and shop drawings where required.

**4. Model Management & Quality Control**

* Maintain model integrity, naming conventions, view templates, families, and project parameters.
* Ensure models are optimised, organised, and compliant with project-specific BIM execution requirements.
* Review drawings and models for dimensional accuracy, coordination, and completeness.
* Incorporate design revisions and maintain drawing and model version control.

Software Proficiency

**Essential:**

* Autodesk Revit - Advanced proficiency in architectural modelling and documentation.
* AutoCAD - Working knowledge of 2D drafting and detailing.

**Preferred:**

* Navisworks - Model federation, clash detection, and coordination.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360 - Model sharing and collaboration.
* Dynamo - Basic automation and workflow optimisation.
* SketchUp - Understanding of 3D design workflows.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Degree or diploma in Architecture, Architectural Technology, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 1-3 years of professional experience in BIM modelling and architectural documentation.
* Demonstrated experience delivering architectural BIM models and construction drawing packages.
* Strong understanding of building construction, materials, detailing, and architectural assemblies.
* Ability to interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and coordination skills.

Key Competencies

* Strong technical and spatial understanding.
* Ability to translate design intent into buildable solutions.
* Proficiency in BIM workflows and model-based documentation.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple deliverables.
* Clear communication and coordination with design and engineering teams.
* Commitment to drawing accuracy, quality, and deadlines.

Expected Deliverables

* Architectural BIM models and coordinated 3D models.
* GFC (Good for Construction) drawing packages.
* Architectural detailing and construction documentation.
* Coordinated architectural, structural, and MEP models.
* Schedules, quantity take-offs, and model-based documentation.
* Fabrication and assembly drawings, where applicable.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Are you equipped to work remotely using your own computer/workstation and Autodesk Revit software?

Work Location: Remote

**Job Description: Senior Data Platform Architect**

**Experience:** 1218+ Years  
 **Location:** Bangalore / Chennai  
 **Role Type:** Senior Architecture / Technical Leadership

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced **Senior Data Platform Architect** with deep expertise in Databricks architecture and enterprise-scale data platform design. The ideal candidate will have strong architectural ownership and the ability to envision, design, and enhance modern data platforms covering data ingestion, transformation, data quality, profiling, and governance.

The candidate will be responsible for evaluating open-source and commercial technologies, developing reusable architecture frameworks, enriching the existing Reference Architecture (RA), and translating architectural concepts into actionable development requirements. The role requires close collaboration with customers, product vendors, and implementation partners to drive platform innovation and accelerate delivery.

Experience with Apache NiFi, Cloudera, and on-premises data platforms will be a significant advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Data Platform Architecture:** Design and define end-to-end data platform architectures, with a strong focus on Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and enterprise data engineering.
* **Data Platform Capabilities:** Architect reusable frameworks for data ingestion, transformation, data quality, data profiling, and data governance.
* **Architecture-to-Delivery Translation:** Break down architectural capabilities into Epics, Features, User Stories, and Tasks to enable effective implementation by engineering teams.
* **Technology Evaluation:** Assess open-source and commercial technologies to identify solutions that accelerate platform development, including Apache NiFi-based data ingestion frameworks.
* **Internal Tools and Frameworks:** Understand and leverage existing assets, including the Data Engineering Toolkit, Data Ingestion Framework, and Neoware CodeX, to improve reusability and development efficiency.
* **Reference Architecture:** Understand the existing enterprise Reference Architecture, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to its evolution and standardization.
* **Cloudera and On-Premises Platforms:** Develop an understanding of Cloudera-based on-premises data platforms and their integration with modern data platform architectures.
* **Vendor and Stakeholder Engagement:** Lead technical discussions with Databricks, Cloudera, other product vendors, customers, and implementation partners.
* **Technical Leadership:** Provide architectural guidance to engineering teams, validate design decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise standards and strategic technology roadmaps.

**Mandatory Skills and Experience**

* 12–18+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial experience in data platform architecture and design.
* Deep, hands-on architectural expertise in **Databricks-based enterprise implementations**.
* Strong understanding of Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and enterprise data engineering architecture.
* Proven experience designing end-to-end data platforms, including ingestion, transformation, data quality, and profiling.
* Experience defining reusable data frameworks, architecture patterns, and platform capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technologies and translate architectural requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, and Tasks.
* Experience contributing to enterprise Reference Architectures, technical roadmaps, and architecture standards.
* Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to engage customers, vendors, and cross-functional engineering teams.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with Apache NiFi and reusable data ingestion frameworks.
* Exposure to Cloudera, Hadoop ecosystem technologies, and on-premises data platforms.
* Experience evaluating open-source and commercial data platform technologies.
* Familiarity with the Data Engineering Toolkit, Data Ingestion Framework, or Neoware CodeX.
* Databricks certification.
* TOGAF certification or equivalent enterprise architecture experience.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a **true Data Platform Architect**, not just a data engineer or Databricks developer. They should be able to conceptualize the capabilities required for a modern enterprise data platform, make architecture-level technology decisions, define reusable frameworks, and guide engineering teams from architecture through implementation.

Candidates must be able to explain real-world Databricks architecture implementations, including platform design decisions, governance, scalability, integration patterns, and architectural trade-offs.

**Candidates Who Are Not a Fit**

* Data Engineers whose experience is limited to Python, SQL, PySpark, and pipeline development.
* Databricks developers who have not owned platform-level architecture and design.
* Project Managers who primarily coordinate delivery without strong technical architecture expertise.
* Solution Architects focused exclusively on applications, Java, or infrastructure without substantial data platform experience.
* Candidates who mention Databricks on their resumes but cannot explain the architecture and design decisions of a real implementation.

4562feca.title: Azure Finops/ Azure Practioner/Cloud Finops
4562feca.description:
About the role:-

We are looking for a hands-on FinOps practitioner who can cut Azure spend measurably while building lasting cost accountability across engineering, finance and business teams. You will own cost visibility, optimization and governance for client Azure estates, typically USD 1M40 M+ in annual spend.

The role blends technical depth in Azure with financial fluency. You will sit between cloud engineers and finance controllers, translating usage into business value and turning recommendations into executed savings.

Key responsibilities:-

Inform — visibility and allocation

Build and maintain cost visibility using Azure Cost Management, Cost Exports to storage, and Power BI or FOCUS-aligned datasets.

Design and enforce tagging, management group and subscription strategies that enable accurate showback and chargeback.

Allocate shared costs (networking, AKS, shared databases, support plans) using fair, documented allocation models.

Produce monthly cost reports, variance analysis and executive dashboards for finance and engineering stakeholders.

Set up budgets, cost alerts and anomaly detection, and run the triage process when spikes occur.

Reservation and savings plan planning.

Optimize — rates and usage:-

Run rate optimization: Reserved Instances, Azure Savings Plans for compute, Azure Hybrid Benefit (Windows Server, SQL Server) and Dev/Test pricing.

Model commitment coverage and utilization, and recommend purchase, exchange and renewal decisions.

Drive usage optimization: VM and database rightsizing, idle and orphaned resource cleanup, storage tiering and lifecycle policies, scheduling of non-production workloads.

Optimize PaaS and container spend, including AKS node pools, App Service plans, Azure SQL / Cosmos DB throughput, and Log Analytics ingestion and retention.

Analyze data transfer, egress and networking costs, and propose architectural changes where they deliver sustained savings.

Validate Azure Advisor recommendations and convert them into prioritized, owner-assigned backlogs with tracked savings.

Operate — governance and culture:-

Implement cost guardrails using Azure Policy, RBAC and landing-zone standards (allowed SKUs, regions, mandatory tags).

Embed cost estimation into delivery: review architecture designs and IaC (Bicep / Terraform) for cost impact before deployment.

Run FinOps cadences: monthly cost reviews, optimization stand-ups and quarterly business reviews with clients.

Support forecasting and budgeting with finance, including EA / MCA invoice reconciliation and amortized vs actual cost views.

Define unit economics (cost per customer, transaction or environment) with product teams.

Mentor junior engineers and contribute playbooks, templates and accelerators to the FinOps practice.

Must-have skills and experience:-

Core focus areas for this role:

Reservations and Savings Plans: hands-on purchase, exchange, refund and renewal of Azure Reservations and Savings Plans for compute; coverage and utilization analysis; break-even and commitment modelling; Azure Hybrid Benefit.

Cost allocation: designing allocation models for shared services (networking, AKS, shared databases, support plans), amortizing commitment costs back to consuming teams, and using Azure cost allocation rules.

Tagging: defining a tagging taxonomy (cost center, application, environment, owner), enforcing it through Azure Policy (deny, append, inherit tags), and remediating untagged spend.

Cross charge (showback / chargeback): setting up showback and chargeback to business units, cross-charging shared and commitment costs, and reconciling internal recharges with finance.

Billing understanding: strong grasp of EA, MCA and CSP agreements, billing accounts, profiles and invoice sections, amortized vs actual cost, Azure Prepayment, credits and marketplace charges, and monthly invoice reconciliation.

Also required:

3–10 years in IT, cloud operations or cloud finance, with 3+ years dedicated to Azure cost management or FinOps.

Hands-on with Azure Cost Management + Billing, Cost Exports, Azure Advisor, Azure Policy and Resource Graph.

Data skills to build cost reports: KQL, SQL and Power BI (or equivalent), plus Excel modelling for forecasts. ( Nice to Have)

Scripting in PowerShell, Azure CLI or Python to automate tagging checks, cleanup and reporting.( Nice to Have)

Working knowledge of the FinOps Framework and the FOCUS specification.

FinOps Tools exp - Cloudability & Corestack.

Track record of presenting savings and recommendations to engineering leads and finance stakeholders.

This role is positioned at the intersection of SAP transformation advisory, test strategy design, solution engineering, demo storytelling, and enterprise deal progression. The role requires a professional who can understand complex SAP landscapes, identify testing gaps, design structured testing strategies, present solution demonstrations, support RFP/RFI responses, run proof-of-concept engagements, and influence customer confidence across S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, API, integration, and regression testing environments.

• Build testing approaches for RISE with SAP programs, Fiori modernization, SAP steady-state operations, and ongoing transformation initiatives.

• Create structured test blueprints covering business process mapping, regression suite design, impact-based testing, and risk-based prioritization.

• Consider cross-module dependencies, release cycles, upgrade readiness, and industry-specific SAP process complexity.

• Address customer objections around methodology, automation strategy, integration reliability, migration readiness, and testing governance.

• Hands-on understanding of SAP S/4HANA migration approaches, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition.

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

a7c094ce.title: Solution Architect
a7c094ce.description:
**Company Description**

**Who are we?**

At Rotork, we offer more than a career; we offer the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.  
We’re a global leader in mission-critical flow control and instrumentation solutions. For over 60 years, we’ve helped industries manage the flow of liquids, gases and chemicals, making operations cleaner, safer and more efficient. With more than 3,500 employees across 170 countries, our reputation is built on innovation, reliability and quality.

But what defines us isn’t just our technology, it’s our purpose. Whether it’s enabling cleaner energy, reducing emissions or ensuring safe water reaches communities, we’re helping solve some of the world’s most pressing challenges and shaping a more sustainable future. Our DNA is what make this possible. It guides our decisions, shapes our culture and defines how we work together:

* **We value our customers** - Delivering value through clarity and simplicity for our customers and colleagues.
* **We grow together** - Continually striving to deliver our best, inspiring each other to learn and grow.
* **We win as a team - A**chieving success together with integrity, ensuring the best for our people, customers and Rotork.

Keeping the world flowing for future generations. Together.

 **Job Description**

* The Application Architect shapes and governs the design of business-critical applications and their integrations across Rotork’s landscape, aligning solutions to EA strategy, principles, and roadmaps.
* The role partners with product and platform owners to ensure our application portfolio is fit for purpose, secure, cost effective, and future ready, and that delivery conforms to Enterprise Architecture governance via the Enterprise Design Authority (EDA) and Architecture Review Board (ARB).
* Supporting the development of specific solutions working with solution architects to ensure they are technically fit for purpose - translating functional and technical (including non-functional) requirements into an effective architecture and design that will ensure the applications we use are optimised and efficient.
* Analyse business requirements and work with stakeholders and other architects to ensure alignment between expectations and technology capability.
* Assist with determining which technologies are most appropriate to deliver a solution and work closely with developers to ensure proper implementation – and within the agreed enterprise architecture, support the definition and design of technology solutions to assist the business in meeting their business objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert within specialist applications, interpreting industry best practice and other broad policy for Rotork – guiding the design and development of integrated IT solutions that meet current and future business needs across the application technology stack.
* Understand the interim and long-term roadmap for the applications and use the architecture governance processes to manage changes, including understanding the development of applications and ensuring relevant architectures, strategies, polices, standards and practice are considered.
* Maintain standards, policies and guidelines for use internally and by external software providers.
* Develop and maintain target and transitional application architectures, blueprints, and guardrails for your assigned domains, ensuring alignment with EA strategy, principles, and roadmaps; present designs to the EA Design Authority/EAB and secure decisions.
* Drive portfolio rationalisation and simplification, partnering with EA peers to reduce redundancy and technical debt through proactively identifying obsolescence, end of life, and consolidation opportunities; raising recommendations into EDA/ARB with options and recommendations.
* Embed security by design and data protection into solutions; evidence controls and NFRs in designs and ensure changes follow Rotork’s governance and CAB routes where required.
* Create reference architectures, patterns, and reusable building blocks to accelerate delivery and ensure consistency across squads and vendors.
* Maintain portfolio truth in LeanIX (applications, interfaces, technologies, providers, risks), linked to initiatives and roadmaps for transparency and prioritisation.
* Maintain LeanIX portfolio accuracy >95% for applications ensuring key data such as lifecycle and risk positions are visible and used in planning.
* Produce designs aligned to principles and standards for initiatives and solutions to be reviewed and approved through EDA and handed to delivery for implementation.

 **Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Understanding of emerging technology platforms and solutions-service capabilities.
* Experience of linking applications to business capabilities to assist with the understanding of our enterprise architecture.
* Experience of designing solutions using COTS applications and software development for global organisations.
* Knowledge of current well-known enterprise applications and technologies e.g. Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365.
* Proven experience as an Application Architect / Solution Architect in complex, integrated landscapes, ideally with Microsoft centric enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, M365/Power Platform, Azure) and modern web/application architectures.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of Microsoft technologies (Power Platform, Microsoft 365).
* Experience working within enterprise architecture governance and contributing to design authorities or architecture boards.
* Familiarity with LeanIX (or equivalent APM/EAM tools) and maintaining application/interface lifecycles and standards.

03e1744b.title: Senior Presales AI Solutions Architect
03e1744b.description:
**Role: Senior AI Solutions Architect**

**Job Profile Summary**

The Senior AI Solutions Architect is an advanced subject matter expert responsible for shaping, validating and assuring complex artificial intelligence solutions during the opportunity-to-order lifecycle.

The role operates as the primary technical and delivery interlock between regional go-to-market teams and the Global AI Delivery Unit. It enables sellers and regional solution teams to access AI delivery expertise without requiring core delivery resources to become extensively engaged in routine pre-sales activity.

The Senior AI Solutions Architect works with clients, sales teams, solution teams, commercial management, delivery leaders and specialist technical teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, commercially viable and delivery-ready AI solutions.

The role contributes to, or leads, the development of solution architectures, prototypes and proofs of concept where required. It validates solution feasibility, delivery scope, resource requirements, effort estimates, commercial assumptions, delivery risks and contractual commitments before NTT DATA enters into a client agreement.

As part of the Global AI Delivery Unit, the role helps protect delivery outcomes and the AI Delivery P&L by ensuring that proposed solutions have an appropriate delivery structure, cost-recovery model, risk position and transition plan before customer signature.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Deal intake and GTM interlock**

* Act as the primary technical and delivery interlock for assigned AI opportunities from qualified intake through solution approval, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Engage with regional GTM, sales and solution teams early in the opportunity lifecycle to understand the clients business problem, intended outcomes, technical environment, data landscape and commercial requirements.
* Assess whether the opportunity is sufficiently qualified for Global AI Delivery engagement and identify any additional information, discovery or customer validation required.
* Review use-case descriptions and business requirements to assess whether the proposed use of AI is appropriate, feasible and aligned with measurable client outcomes.
* Support structured discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into actionable technical and delivery requirements.
* Identify the specialist capabilities required to support the pursuit and coordinate targeted engagement from Global AI Delivery Unit, security, legal, commercial and regional delivery teams.
* Manage the involvement of delivery specialists carefully, ensuring that delivery expertise is used for material design decisions and specialist validation without drawing delivery teams unnecessarily into general pre-sales activity.
* Maintain clear communication with opportunity owners regarding solution status, outstanding decisions, risks, dependencies and readiness for assurance.

**AI solution architecture and design**

* Shape or own the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions across application, model, data, integration, infrastructure and security domains.
* Evaluate architecture options and select appropriate AI models, cloud services, orchestration frameworks and third-party technologies, balancing cost, performance, scalability, security and delivery complexity.
* Define secure integration, functional and non-functional requirements, data governance and responsible AI requirements for the proposed solution.
* Align solutions with NTT DATA reference architectures, reusable assets, delivery patterns and approved technology standards.

**Prototyping and feasibility validation**

* Develop, lead or coordinate prototypes and proofs of concept where required to validate feasibility, reduce delivery risk or demonstrate the proposed solution.
* Test material assumptions relating to model performance, data, integration, security, scalability, latency and consumption cost, with clear success and exit criteria.
* Translate prototype findings into the production architecture, estimate, assumptions and risk position, engaging specialist engineering support where required.

**Delivery planning and resource model**

* Translate the solution into a realistic delivery approach covering workstreams, deliverables, milestones, dependencies and mobilisation.
* Define or validate the resource model, effort estimates, skills, location strategy and use of global delivery centres, partners or subcontractors.
* Assess delivery timelines and define appropriate governance, roles, responsibilities, escalation and change control.
* Identify requirements for managed services, production support, model monitoring, platform operations or continuous optimisation where applicable.

  

**Commercial solution development**

* Work with commercial, finance, sales and delivery stakeholders to develop a commercial construct aligned to the architecture and delivery model.
* Validate estimates, rate-card assumptions, third-party costs, consumption charges and contingency, ensuring all material delivery costs are represented.
* Ensure the resource model, delivery estimate, pricing, contribution and margin assumptions remain internally consistent, with uncertainty managed through appropriate commercial mechanisms.
* Support pricing and approval processes and challenge commercial constructs that create unmanageable technical or delivery risk for NTT DATA.

  

**Scope and statement-of-work development**

* Support the drafting and review of proposals and statements of work, defining scope, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, client responsibilities and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure contractual artefacts accurately reflect the approved architecture, delivery approach, resource plan and commercial model, without ambiguous or unbounded commitments.
* Coordinate legal, security, data protection and responsible AI input and support negotiation of technical and delivery-related contractual terms.

  

**Deal assurance and governance**

* Assess the completeness and quality of the proposed solution across architecture, technical feasibility, delivery readiness, resource requirements, commercial consistency and risk treatment.
* Identify material technical, data, security, privacy, legal, commercial and delivery risks and ensure appropriate owners and mitigations are in place.
* Prepare and present assigned opportunities for relevant assurance and approval gates, coordinating required stakeholder review and sign-off.
* Provide a clear, evidence-based assurance recommendation: proceed, proceed subject to conditions, return for rework or do not proceed in the proposed form.
* Track assurance conditions, escalate material concerns and maintain appropriate decision records; ensure independent review where the architect has materially developed the solution.

**Transition and handover to delivery**

* Maintain a controlled solution baseline through contracting and mobilisation, ensuring material changes are reflected consistently across deal artefacts.
* Lead the transition to delivery, providing the approved architecture, scope, commercial baseline, resource plan, assumptions, dependencies, risks and client commitments.
* Support early mobilisation, resolve gaps between what was sold and what is being delivered, and capture feedback to improve future solutioning and estimates.

**Reuse and capability development**

* Contribute reusable AI architectures, delivery patterns, prototypes, estimation models, proposal assets and commercial assumptions informed by pursuit and delivery experience.

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

**About the Team**

Product Support helps Chargebee customers succeed after go-live. We troubleshoot complex billing and subscription workflows, debug API and integration issues, and partner with Product and Engineering to improve reliability, reduce repeat tickets, and strengthen self-serve through better documentation and tooling.

**About the role (Job Summary)**

You will own complex customer issues end-to-end across Chargebee’s product, APIs, and integrations. You will reproduce problems, identify root causes, communicate clearly with customers, and drive resolution with the right internal teams. You will also turn support patterns into better self-serve content and actionable product feedback.

**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)**

1. Build deep product and API expertise to deliver advanced technical support across email, chat, and calls.
2. Own and drive complex issues end-to-end by reproducing problems, troubleshooting systematically, and coordinating internal teams when needed to reach a confirmed resolution.
3. Provide consultative support by understanding customer workflows and guiding best-practice configuration and integration choices.
4. Troubleshoot customer API usage and integrations, including payload analysis and debugging in a test environment.
5. Support integrations across CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce), finance platforms (NetSuite, Xero, Intacct), and payment gateways (Adyen, Authorize.net, Stripe).
6. Identify recurring pain points and trends, and convert them into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering to improve the product and supportability.
7. Create and improve self-serve content such as knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and runbooks to reduce repeat tickets.
8. Improve team efficiency through better workflows, tooling, and process improvements, while supporting customers 24/7 through rotational shifts.

**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)**

1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
2. 3+ years supporting a SaaS product in a customer-facing role, with strong debugging and problem-solving skills and a structured troubleshooting approach.
3. Clear, polished communication with strong attention to detail and accuracy.

b3aaa6f4.title: Solutions Architect II, Direct Tax Technology
b3aaa6f4.description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about transforming tax technology through innovation? Amazon's Direct Tax Technology team is seeking a Solutions Architect II to revolutionize how tax professionals work. In this role, you'll leverage modern technologies including Python and generative AI to design and implement solutions that empower Amazon's Direct Tax Reporting and Compliance organization. You'll tackle complex technical challenges at unprecedented scale, building world-class systems that drive efficiency and enable tax professionals to meet Amazon's unique global challenges.
  
  
This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by architecting solutions that transform tax operations for one of the world's most innovative companies. You'll work at the intersection of tax domain expertise and modern cloud technologies, creating elegant technical solutions that directly improve how Amazon's tax team operates at a global scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design and implement scalable tax technology solutions using Python, generative AI, and modern development practices to solve complex tax processing challenges
  
  
Define front-end architectures and user experiences, owning specific technical components while establishing best practices for model development and solution design
  
  
Collaborate with tax professionals, Product Managers, and fellow Solutions Architects to translate customer requirements into technical specifications that engineering teams can execute
  
  
Lead end-to-end solution architecture for tax technology projects, including planning, design, implementation, testing, and continuous process improvement as part of an autonomous team
  
  
Mentor and develop other Solutions Architects by sharing technical expertise, facilitating knowledge transfer, and contributing to team growth through code reviews and technical guidance
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your day blends creative problem-solving with hands-on technical work. You might start by architecting a generative AI solution to streamline tax compliance workflows, then collaborate with tax professionals to refine user experience requirements. After lunch, you'll dive into Python modeling to optimize data processing pipelines, followed by a design review where you mentor junior architects on best practices. The afternoon could include troubleshooting a technical challenge with your team, contributing to solution planning, and ending with a customer workshop where you demonstrate how new capabilities will transform their tax operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Direct Tax Technology team sits within Amazon's Tax organization and is dedicated to supporting tax professionals in the Tax Reporting and Compliance group with innovative technology solutions and streamlined processes. Our team tackles the unique and complex challenges that come with operating at Amazon's scale, building systems that enhance processing efficiency and empower our internal customers.
  
  
We foster a culture of innovation and collaboration where technical excellence meets business impact. Our mission is to continuously evolve tax technology capabilities, ensuring our tax professionals have the tools they need to succeed. Join a team where your work directly influences how Amazon manages tax compliance and reporting, and where you'll have opportunities to explore emerging technologies like generative AI while growing your skills alongside talented engineers and architects.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

795deacf.title: Solutions Architect
795deacf.description:
At AT DAWN Technologies, we are a fast-growing technology services company building high-impact teams across Data Engineering, AI, and Backend Development. Our clients include some of the most innovative product companies in the world. We operate delivery centers in India and Vietnam, enabling rapid, high-quality execution with a product mindset.

We are seeking an experienced
**Enterprise Solution Architect**
with expertise in
**High**
**Performance Computing (HPC) and Container platforms in Linux-based environments**
to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting solutions including but not limited to installation, configuration, integration and implementation of HPC technologies and enterprise-grade container orchestration platform.

We are looking for a person with very strong technical skills and a proven track record of designing and working with container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, CNCF Kubernetes, HPC Schedulers such as Slurm or PBS Pro, HPC/AI Cluster management technologies such as HPCM or BCM and the ability to work in a dynamic customer-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Candidate must have strong proficiency as a Solution Architect in at least three areas and proficiency in other areas.

* Leadership and Strategy:
* Develop HPC and container platform roadmaps and strategies for growth based on business needs.
* Engage in and enhance the complete service lifecycle—from conceptualization and design to implementation and operation.
* Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these in design activities.
* Solution Planning and Design:
* Gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and design integrated HPC and container solutions that align with business objectives.
* Architect and optimize the technical solutions to meet the requirements of the customer.
* Identify the potential challenges and constraints that impact the solution and project plan.
* Opportunity assessment:
* Respond to the technical sections of RFIs/RFPs and Lead proof-of-concept engagements to a successful conclusion
* Utilize an effective consultative approach to advance opportunities.
* Innovation and Research:
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and industry developments related to HPC, Kubernetes, containers, cloud computing, and Security.
* Develop best practices, Accelerators and Show & Tell for HPC and container platform solutions and integrations.
* Customer-centric mindset:
* Strong focus on understanding customer business requirements and solving complex cloud technology issues
* Be the trusted advisor, delight customers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences to drive customer success.
* Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non-technical stakeholders
* Team Collaboration:
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including system administrators, developers, data scientist and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.
* Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources within the company
* Mentor and train new team members and lead the way in participation in tech talks, forums, innovation.

**Required Skills:**

* Knowledge and experience with Linux System Administration, package management, scheduling, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance optimization, and networking concepts.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with HPC technologies, workload schedulers – Slurm, Altair PBS pro, and cluster managers – HPCM, Bright cluster manager.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker, Singularity, or Podman.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two of the container orchestration technologies like CNCF Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher RKE/K3S, Canonical charmed kubernetes or Ezmeral Runtime. Good to have
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with OpenStack cloud solutions.
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with virtualization technologies like KVM, OpenShift virtualization
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two various Linux distributions like RHEL, SLES, Ubuntu, Debian.
* Good Knowledge of GPU technologies, NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA vGPU technology
* Good knowledge of HPC networking stack (high speed networking), InfiniBand, Mellanox
* Good experience in performance optimization and health assessment of HPC components

such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and container orchestration platforms.

* Must be good in any of the programming or scripting languages like python, bash
* Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, Routing and Load Balancing.
* Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Solid business acumen and ability to converse with client on issues and challenges.
* Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.
* Demonstrates a high-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, HPC and Container platform Specialist, or similar role, with expertise in designing and implementing complex solutions.
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers and Kubernetes (RHCSA, RHCE), CNCF certification - CKA, CKAD, CKS is preferred.
* Typically, 6-8 years of experience in delivering complex HPC and container platform projects.

Job Title

**Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Lead / Architect**

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced **Oracle Fusion HCM Technical Lead/Architect** with 10+ years of overall experience and strong expertise in **end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementations**. The candidate will be responsible for architecting, designing, developing, integrating, and supporting Oracle Fusion HCM solutions while collaborating closely with functional consultants, business stakeholders, and project teams.

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical leadership skills and have hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion HCM technical components, integrations, reporting, analytics, Redwood UI/UX, and workflow automation.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementation projects.
* Define overall solution architecture and technical strategy.
* Collaborate with Functional Leads and business stakeholders to design scalable HCM solutions.
* Design and develop Oracle Fusion HCM customizations and extensions.
* Build and support integrations using:

+ OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud)
+ REST APIs
+ SOAP Web Services
+ HDL (HCM Data Loader)
+ HSDL
+ Fast Formula

* Develop and maintain BI Publisher Reports, OTBI Reports, and Dashboards.
* Design modern Redwood UI/UX components and user experiences.
* Implement workflow automation and approval processes.
* Perform data migration, data validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide technical solutions.
* Mentor technical teams and ensure adherence to Oracle best practices.
* Support project governance, architecture reviews, and client discussions.

Mandatory Skills

* Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud
* End-to-End Oracle Fusion HCM Implementation Experience
* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* Oracle HCM Extracts
* HCM Data Loader (HDL)
* HSDL
* Fast Formula
* REST APIs & SOAP Web Services
* BI Publisher
* OTBI Reports & Dashboards
* Redwood UI/UX Development
* Oracle Cloud Security & Roles
* Workflow Automation
* Data Migration & Integrations
* Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership

Preferred Modules

* Core HR
* Talent Management
* Recruitment
* Learning
* Compensation
* Benefits
* Payroll
* Absence Management
* Workforce Management

Required Experience

* 10+ years of overall IT experience.
* 5+ years of Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud implementation experience.
* Minimum 2-3 complete end-to-end Oracle Fusion HCM implementation projects.
* Experience working as Technical Lead / Architect.
* Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills.

Good-to-Have

* Oracle Cloud Certifications.
* Banking/Financial Services domain experience.
* Experience with Redwood design framework implementation.
* Team handling and delivery management experience.

d8adb7a2.title: 2026-1642 - Oracle Cloud Senior Consultant - Finance
d8adb7a2.description:
Highstreet IT is seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Finance Senior Consultant with deep expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials to lead enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives. This role requires a strong functional consultant who can lead solution design, engage with business stakeholders, and deliver high-quality Oracle Cloud Finance implementations.  
The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience in Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Cash Management (CM), Expenses (EXP), and General Ledger (GL), along with strong consulting, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities. You will play a key role in translating business requirements into scalable Oracle Cloud solutions, mentoring junior consultants, and contributing to the growth of Highstreet IT's Oracle Finance practice.

Key Responsibilities  

* Lead end-to-end implementation of Oracle Cloud Finance modules including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Cash Management (CM), Expenses (EXP), and General Ledger (GL), and design scalable, optimized solutions aligned with Oracle and industry best practices.
* Drive project cadence meetings, stakeholder discussions, solution configuration, prepare Lean specifications, perform Functional Unit Testing (FUT), and validate business solutions.
* Conduct requirement gathering workshops and translate business requirements into Oracle Cloud Finance solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders and finance process owners by recommending process improvements and automation opportunities across Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R) business processes.
* Lead Conference Room Pilot (CRP) sessions, solution demonstrations, and end-user training.
* Own module-level delivery throughout the project lifecycle, including Design, Build, Test, Deploy, and Hypercare.
* Ensure project deliverables meet agreed timelines, quality standards, and budget expectations.
* Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies proactively.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment activities, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Define finance integration touchpoints and collaborate with technical teams to support successful integrations.
* Support data migration activities using FBDI templates and ensure data accuracy and completeness.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants and analysts by reviewing deliverables and ensuring adherence to Oracle and Highstreet IT best practices.
* Develop implementation accelerators, templates, reusable assets, and contribute to strengthening Highstreet IT's Oracle Finance practice and go-to-market initiatives.

Required Experience and Skills  

* 7–12+ years of experience in Oracle Finance, including Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
* Minimum 2–3 end-to-end Oracle Cloud Finance implementation projects.
* Proven experience leading module-level delivery throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Experience working in consulting and global delivery environments preferred.
* Strong hands-on expertise in: Accounts Payable (AP),Accounts Receivable (AR),Cash Management (CM),Expenses (EXP),General Ledger (GL),Strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay (P2P),Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R) business processes.
* Deep understanding of data migration strategies and system integrations.
* Good knowledge of FBDI templates, REST/SOAP integrations, OTBI, and BI Publisher (BIP) reporting.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to independently lead workshops and solution discussions.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, global consulting environment.
