2aae32df.description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title: Director Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - O&G**
**Location: Hyderabad, India**
**Employment Type:**
[full-time]
  
  
**Job Summary:**
Director Forward Deployed Solution Architect provides enterprise and portfolio-level architecture leadership as a senior-principal individual contributor across AVEVA’s most strategic and complex FDE work. The role shapes the functional and solution architecture agenda, advises senior customer and internal stakeholders on transformation pathways and long-term solution direction, and establishes architecture principles, governance, standards, reference patterns, and Industry Accelerator models that scale across customers, regions, and the FDE portfolio. As a recognized architecture authority, the role resolves unprecedented or highly ambiguous architecture challenges, raises quality and consistency across strategic engagements, and translates recurring customer needs, operating-model requirements, architecture constraints, product gaps, and emerging industry or technology trends into clear recommendations for Product, Portfolio, R&D, and FDE leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Shape enterprise and portfolio-level functional and solution architecture across AVEVA’s most strategic FDE engagements as a senior-principal individual contributor.
* Establish architecture principles, governance, standards, reference architectures, reusable industry patterns, and accelerator models that scale across customers and regions.
* Advise senior customer and internal stakeholders on transformation pathways, operating-model implications, architecture trade-offs, and long-term solution direction.
* Resolve unprecedented, highly ambiguous, or multidimensional architecture challenges spanning business processes, AVEVA products, industrial data, OT/IT systems, cloud, integrations, AI, security, and operations.
* Translate complex customer operating models, workflows, KPIs, data, constraints, and transformation priorities into scalable target architectures and reusable capability models.
* Provide architecture direction across multiple strategic engagements, workstreams, regions, or accounts, raising consistency, quality, and reuse without direct people-management accountability.
* Govern architecture quality, scalability, maintainability, security, interoperability, production readiness, and alignment to measurable customer outcomes.
* Define and govern repeatable validation approaches for complex operational scenarios, including KPI validation, day-in-the-life workflows, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and value realization.
* Shape architecture principles and governance for AI and advanced analytics, ensuring safe, scalable, grounded, and value-led adoption.
* Synthesize recurring customer requirements, architecture constraints, product gaps, and emerging industry needs into evidence-based Product, Portfolio, R&D, and FDE leadership recommendations.
* Convert strategic engagement learning into reusable reference architectures, Industry Accelerators, functional models, governance methods, and productization opportunities.
* Coach and develop senior Solution Architects and technical contributors, strengthening architecture capability and professional standards across the FDE community.
* Influence portfolio direction and policy discussions while escalating final investment, organizational, and enterprise-policy decisions to the appropriate leadership owners.

**Essential Skills:**

* Typically 12-16 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in enterprise architecture, industrial transformation, strategic solution delivery, or related disciplines.
* Senior-principal individual contributor and recognized authority in enterprise-scale industrial solution architecture.
* Deep expertise in industrial operating models, workflows, transformation priorities, and one or more strategic industries.
* Proven ability to resolve unprecedented, highly ambiguous, and multidimensional architecture challenges.
* Enterprise architecture capability across AVEVA products, industrial data, OT/IT systems, cloud, integrations, security, AI, and complementary technologies.
* Strong KPI and value-realization expertise, including baselines, measurable outcomes, value hypotheses, and impact assessment.
* Executive advisory and influencing capability with senior customer, operational, architecture, Product, Portfolio, R&D, and FDE stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to set architecture principles, governance, standards, reference patterns, and reusable accelerator models across customers or regions.
* Broad AVEVA portfolio knowledge and the judgment to identify capability gaps, reuse opportunities, product implications, and strategic trade-offs.
* Define and Design AI Agents, Skills corresponding to domain skills
* Strong understanding of industrial data and integration ecosystems, including SCADA, historians, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, cloud, edge, security, and interoperability.
* Proven ability to coach senior architects and raise architecture quality through influence rather than direct people-management authority.
* Evidence of shaping Product, Portfolio, R&D, or FDE priorities through synthesized customer and industry insight.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Enterprise and portfolio-level FDE architecture standards, governance, reusable models, and accelerator patterns are adopted across strategic engagements.
* Senior customer and internal stakeholders receive credible architecture guidance on transformation pathways, operating-model implications, trade-offs, and long-term solution direction.
* Highly ambiguous architecture challenges are resolved with clear principles, scalable patterns, and practical governance that improve consistency and quality.
* Recurring customer needs, product gaps, architecture constraints, and emerging industry trends are translated into evidence-based Product, Portfolio, R&D, and FDE leadership recommendations.
* Senior Solution Architects and technical contributors are strengthened through coaching, standards, reference patterns, governance methods, and architecture community leadership.

**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

8a70e564.title: Salesforce, Lead IT Architect, Platinion
8a70e564.description:
**Locations**
: Gurgaon | Mumbai
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Salesforce Architect who can lead and deliver complex Salesforce solutions for our clients in various industries. You will define the Salesforce strategy, architecture, integration, development, and security of multiple Salesforce applications across sales, service, and marketing clouds. You will also work with senior client stakeholders, manage project teams, and collaborate with other vendors.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the development of Salesforce strategies and architectures for clients in target industries such as Manufacturing, CPG, Industrial Goods, Financial Services, etc.
* Oversee the implementation of Salesforce solutions using Data, Marketing, Sales, service, experience, industry clouds (Field Service etc), and other Salesforce products
* Integrate Salesforce applications with external systems using identity and access management, data architecture, and best practice integration patterns
* Build secure and scalable apps using sharing architecture, LWC, Apex, Flow builder, and other development tools
* Advise clients on build vs. buy decisions, single-org vs. multi-org strategies, and DevOps practices on the Salesforce platform
* Work with CXO-level stakeholders to understand their business needs, present solutions, and manage expectations
* Lead business development and sales activities to generate new opportunities and expand existing relationships with clients
* Manage project teams, vendors, budgets, timelines, and quality assurance activities
* Stay updated on the latest trends and developments in Salesforce and CRM domains
* Develop trust-based relationships with clients as a trusted C-level advisor
* Lead the delivery of high-quality products that exceed client expectations
* Support the professional development of your team members through coaching and feedback
* Contribute to the intellectual capital of the firm by creating knowledge documents on a specific content platform

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 8 t0 14 years of experience in IT Architecture, Technology transformation, Salesforce architecture and development
* Salesforce Application Architect and System Architect certifications
* Experience in leading and delivering complex Salesforce solutions using sales cloud, marketing cloud, service cloud, and marketing cloud for at least 5-10 clients in target industries
* Experience in integrating Salesforce applications with external data platforms (Data lakes, etc.), ERP systems (Manufacturing industry), CBS systems (Financial industry), LMS systems (Financial industry), analytical systems (Tableau, etc.), messaging systems (Kafka, etc.), and public cloud platforms (one major public cloud)
* Experience in working with Indian clients and organizations
* Strong understanding of CRM market and competitors (SFDC, MS Dynamics, Oracle, Zoho, etc.)
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to travel as per requirement

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
  
  
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

* Strong hands-on knowledge of Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, agentic workflows, AI integration patterns, and enterprise AI architectures.

* Experience in architecture decision-making, technology evaluation, and managing technical trade-offs across enterprise initiatives.

* Strong stakeholder management, consulting, and executive communication skills.
* Experience collaborating with presales, consulting, engineering, cloud, AI, and delivery teams.
* Ability to create solution blueprints, reference architectures, reusable frameworks, and technology accelerators.
* Strong understanding of emerging technologies, intelligent automation, cloud, AI, and data-driven innovation.
* Automotive domain knowledge, including connected vehicles, customer experience, digital retail, dealer ecosystems, aftersales, mobility solutions, or related industry areas, is highly desirable.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end architecture design and technical strategy for strategic digital transformation and innovation initiatives.
* Translate business goals, market opportunities, and industry challenges into scalable, secure, and technically viable solution architectures.
* Define architecture frameworks, technology stacks, integration models, deployment strategies, and architectural standards.
* Drive architecture governance, design reviews, and technical decision-making across multiple initiatives.
* Lead the development and evolution of reusable accelerators, solution frameworks, reference architectures, and technology assets.
* Establish architectural best practices that promote scalability, maintainability, reusability, and operational excellence.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, with a focus on Generative AI, intelligent automation, cloud platforms, and advanced data architectures.
* Design enterprise AI solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG frameworks, AI agents, and agentic workflows to address business challenges.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, domain consultants, and presales teams to shape innovative solution offerings.
* Participate in customer-facing workshops, technical discovery sessions, architecture discussions, and solution presentations.
* Communicate architectural vision, technology recommendations, design rationale, and technical trade-offs to senior stakeholders and technology leadership teams.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams.
* Partner with data, AI, cloud, engineering, and delivery teams to ensure successful implementation of architectural solutions.
* Drive the creation and maintenance of architecture documentation, technical standards, and knowledge-sharing practices.
* Assess solution feasibility, risks, security considerations, performance requirements, and long-term sustainability.
* Contribute to thought leadership, technology strategy, innovation initiatives, and industry-focused solution development within the organization.
* Support the development of differentiated solution offerings that strengthen organizational capabilities and market positioning.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve business outcomes through technology innovation, data-driven solutions, and digital transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

13b59cb3.title: Associate Director - Systems Architecture - Solutions
13b59cb3.description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our People & Investment team, part of our Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Gurugram/Noida This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Associate Director - Systems Architecture - Solutions
  
  
Experienced Solution Architect responsible for defining, designing, and governing end-to-end technology solutions that address complex business requirements and align with enterprise architecture standards and strategic technology direction.
  
  
Solution Architect partners with business stakeholders, product owners, project sponsors, enterprise and domain architects, engineering teams, AI/ML teams, security teams, infrastructure/cloud teams, and external vendors to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, intelligent, cost-effective, and maintainable technology solutions.
  
  
The role will also contribute to the adoption of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-enabled automation, identifying where AI provides measurable business value while ensuring appropriate security, governance, and human oversight.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Lead the end-to-end solution architecture for complex technology initiatives, from discovery and requirements through design, implementation.
* Understand business capabilities, functional requirements, constraints, and strategic objectives and translate them into appropriate solution architectures and technology designs.
* Define architecture across applications, APIs, integrations, data, cloud/infrastructure, security, identity, observability, and operational components.
* Produce architecture deliverables including high-level designs, solution architecture diagrams, integration/data-flow diagrams, architecture decision records, technology recommendations, and implementation roadmaps.
* Evaluate solution options and perform build-vs-buy, COTS/SaaS, cloud service, platform, and technology assessments, documenting trade-offs, risks, costs, and architectural decisions.
* Define and validate non-functional requirements (NFRs) including availability, scalability, performance, resilience, security, privacy, disaster recovery, maintainability, and supportability.
* Design integration solutions using appropriate patterns such as APIs, event-driven architecture, messaging, microservices, batch/file integration, and third-party/SaaS integrations.
* Ensure solutions comply with organizational standards for security, data protection, regulatory requirements, architecture principles, technology standards, and cloud governance.
* Identify architecture risks, technical debt, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints early and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Participate in architecture governance and design reviews, presenting solutions and obtaining required architecture/security approvals.
* Collaborate with Enterprise and Domain Architects to ensure solutions align with broader enterprise architecture, reusable platforms, strategic roadmaps, and modernization objectives.
* Support modernization initiatives including cloud adoption, application modernization, API enablement, automation, AI-enabled solutions, and legacy transformation, where appropriate.
* Provide architecture oversight for large and complex technology programs, including initiatives involving significant third-party/vendor solutions and technology investment.

**What you need to have:**
The successful candidate should demonstrate strong experience in:
  
  

* End-to-end Solution Architecture
* Cloud architecture, preferably AWS and/or Azure
* Application and integration architecture
* API and event-driven architecture
* Microservices and distributed systems
* Data architecture and data integration
* Security and Identity & Access Management
* High availability, resilience and disaster recovery
* Performance and scalability
* DevSecOps and CI/CD concepts
* Observability and operational architecture
* SaaS/COTS and third-party product integration
* Cost optimization and solution lifecycle considerations
* Working with Agile/product-based engineering teams
* Leading technical discussions across multiple engineering and architecture disciplines
* Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
* Single Sign-On (OAuth, SAML)
* Development Stack-MEAN stack, .NET Core, Python, or similar middleware technologies

**What makes you stand out:**
The candidate should be a seasoned technology professional capable of working independently with minimal supervision while providing technical leadership across multiple teams. They should be comfortable operating at both strategic and detailed solution-design levels understanding the business problem, evaluating solution options, defining the target architecture, explaining architectural trade-offs, and guiding engineering teams through implementation.
  
  
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills are essential, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and influence architecture decisions across business, engineering, security, infrastructure, and leadership teams.
  
  
**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

81fc1149.title: Senior Solutions Architect
81fc1149.description:
**Job Summary**

Walgreens is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to provide advanced expertise and individual-contributor leadership across solutions architecture. This role will lead complex work, shape solution direction, mentor others through influence, and partner across teams to deliver reliable, scalable, secure, and measurable outcomes. Proven functional/technical experience in Workforce management tools such UKG Workforce Pro. Experience with other HR systems is preferred.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of UKG Workforce Management (WFM) solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and technology roadmaps.
* Act as the primary subject matter expert for Workforce Management, Time & Attendance, Scheduling, HR, and Payroll processes, providing technical and functional guidance to stakeholders and project teams.
* Partner with business leaders, HR teams, payroll teams, product owners, and technical stakeholders to gather requirements, define solution strategies, and translate complex business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Design and govern enterprise integration solutions using Dell BOOMI, APIs, middleware technologies, and cloud-based architectures to support seamless data exchange across HR and business applications.
* Define architecture standards, integration frameworks, reusable components, best practices, and governance models to improve solution consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution assessments, and design discussions while identifying and mitigating technical risks, dependencies, performance bottlenecks, and security concerns.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on system reliability, automation, performance optimization, operational efficiency, security, compliance, and user experience.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Security, Infrastructure, Data, Enterprise Architecture, and Development teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers, analysts, and implementation teams through design reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, coaching, and governance activities.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and UKG platform capabilities to recommend innovative solutions and strategic enhancements.
* Serve as a trusted advisor during critical production incidents, complex operational challenges, and major transformation initiatives, providing subject matter expertise and architectural guidance.
* Communicate architectural decisions, recommendations, risks, trade-offs, and implementation strategies to both technical and executive leadership audiences.
* Ensure all solutions comply with organizational standards related to security, privacy, audit requirements, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.
* Support project estimation, solution planning, resource alignment, and roadmap development for Workforce Management and HR technology initiatives.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and influence decision-making across multiple business and technology functions without direct reporting authority.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8-13 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Applications, Workforce Management, or HR Technology domains.
* Strong functional and technical expertise in UKG Workforce Pro (Kronos).
* Extensive experience with HR and Payroll integrations.
* Hands-on development experience with Dell Boomi Integration Platform.
* Experience leading solution design, implementation, and support activities.
* Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into technical and architectural solutions.
* Experience managing stakeholders and influencing technical decisions.
* Strong understanding of APIs, middleware, integration patterns, and cloud-based architectures.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Retail industry experience.
* Experience managing or leading technical teams, solution architects, or integration teams.
* Extensive experience serving as an SME for Workforce Management applications.
* Experience supporting large-scale UKG Workforce Pro implementations.
* Strong knowledge of Workforce Management processes including Timekeeping, Scheduling, Attendance, and Labor Management.
* Advanced Dell Boomi development and integration expertise.
* Experience with HRIS, Payroll, and HCM platforms.
* Strong SQL, database, and data modeling knowledge.
* Experience defining architecture standards, integration frameworks, and technology roadmaps.
* Experience working in enterprise-scale environments supporting thousands of employees.

e34e59bc.title: Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant - Oracle Time and Labor (OTL)
e34e59bc.description:
**Join us at** **iteria.us**

With over 25 years of proven success, **iteria.us** has earned a reputation for delivering exceptional IT services and application managed solutions. We specialize **in Oracle Cloud, Managed Services, and Custom Application Development,** bringing deep industry expertise, white-glove customer service, and unwavering resource continuity to every client we serve.

Our mission is simple: we partner closely with our clients to understand their unique challenges, deliver impactful solutions, and help them become more agile, resilient, and competitive. At **iteria.us**, we don’t just solve problems—we help our clients evolve.

**Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant specializing in Oracle Time and Labor (OTL) and Absence management to join our dynamic team. As a pivotal member of our organization, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining sophisticated configurations within Oracle Time and Labor and Absence Management applications. This role demands a comprehensive understanding of Oracle HCM systems, including Global HR, Oracle Time and Labor, and Absence Management modules, to effectively customize and optimize Oracle applications that meet complex business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive configurations for Oracle Time and Labor and Absence Management applications, ensuring optimal system performance and user experience.

Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, HR teams, and project sponsors to gather detailed requirements, analyze business processes, and design innovative solutions for deploying Oracle HCM modules across various functional areas.

Possess hands-on expertise in configuring and customizing Oracle HCM modules to precisely align with complex business requirements, regulatory compliance needs, and organizational policies.

Implement seamless integration between Absence Management, Time and Labor, and Payroll systems, with specialized focus on US legislative rules, compliance frameworks, and regulatory reporting requirements.

Design and configure absence plans, accrual policies, time entry rules, and approval workflows to support diverse workforce management scenarios and business operational needs.

Develop comprehensive test scripts, detailed user manuals, and engaging training guides to support successful system adoption and ensure end-user proficiency across all implemented modules.

Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams including technical developers, business analysts, project managers, and client stakeholders to ensure timely project delivery within established budget parameters.

Provide expert technical guidance on Fast Formula development, including creation of complex calculations, eligibility rules, and custom business logic to meet specific organizational requirements.

 Configure time and labor policies including time entry methods, time calculation rules,

overtime policies, and shift differentials to support various workforce management

scenarios.

 Implement absence management processes including leave accruals, absence certifications,

return-to-work procedures, and integration with disability management systems.

 Support Oracle HCM Cloud upgrade activities, quarterly releases, and new feature

implementations, ensuring continuous system optimization and enhanced functionality

delivery.

 Conduct thorough system testing including unit testing, integration testing, and user

acceptance testing to maintain high standards of system quality and performance reliability.

 Provide ongoing functional support, troubleshooting, and system optimization

recommendations to enhance time and attendance management efficiency and accuracy.

 Stay current with Oracle HCM Cloud innovations, legislative updates, and industry best

practices to continuously improve system capabilities and compliance adherence.

**Required Skills:**

 A minimum of 6+ years of hands-on experience implementing and configuring Oracle HCM

modules is essential, with specific expertise in Oracle Time and Labor and Absence

Management applications.

 Proven functional expertise in integrating Absence Management with Time and Labor and

Payroll systems, particularly within US legislative frameworks and compliance requirements.

 Strong understanding of HCM business processes including time tracking, absence

management, accrual calculations, and workforce scheduling across various industry

verticals.

 Experience in Fast Formula development and configuration for complex business rule

implementations and custom calculation requirements.

 Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into functional system

configurations and process designs that optimize workforce management operations.

 Hands-on experience with Oracle HCM Cloud tools including HDL (HCM Data Loader),

spreadsheet data loaders, and system configuration utilities.

 Knowledge of US labor laws, FMLA regulations, and other legislative requirements impacting

time and attendance management systems.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proven ability to resolve complex functional

issues and optimize system performance.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solution Architect – Network based in India.**
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to design and deliver innovative, scalable, and commercially viable technology solutions across enterprise networking, cloud infrastructure, and Microsoft technologies. In this client-facing role, you will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical implementation, transforming sales-qualified opportunities into comprehensive, delivery-ready solutions. You will collaborate closely with sales teams, clients, engineers, and technology partners to define architectures, assess technical feasibility, and establish project scope and resource requirements. Your expertise will help organizations modernize their network infrastructure, adopt cloud technologies, and strengthen their digital capabilities. You will also act as a trusted technical advisor, presenting architecture strategies and recommendations to both business and technical stakeholders. This is an opportunity to combine technical leadership, commercial awareness, and consulting expertise in a collaborative, client-focused environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Requirement Validation and Sales Collaboration: Evaluate sales-qualified opportunities by validating client requirements, technical feasibility, project scope, and delivery expectations. Work closely with sales teams to identify gaps, clarify requirements, and align technical solutions with timelines and commercial objectives.

Act as a trusted advisor by presenting technical proposals, architecture blueprints, implementation strategies, and technology roadmaps to business and technical stakeholders.
* Solution Architecture and Design: Design comprehensive end-to-end technology solutions across SD-WAN, enterprise networking, Microsoft product ecosystems, and cloud implementation services. Ensure proposed architectures are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned with business objectives and industry best practices.
* Network and SD-WAN Solutions: Develop enterprise networking architectures covering routing, switching, firewalls, MPLS, BGP, network segmentation, and SD-WAN technologies. Support network transformation initiatives, including migration from traditional WAN infrastructures to modern SD-WAN solutions.
* Microsoft Technology Solutions: Design solutions involving Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, Intune, Teams, and SharePoint. Incorporate Microsoft licensing considerations, security capabilities, Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, and Zero Trust principles into proposed architectures.
* Cloud Architecture and Implementation: Develop Azure and AWS solutions across IaaS, PaaS, hybrid cloud, and cloud migration initiatives. Define cloud governance strategies, security requirements, cost optimization approaches, and implementation plans.
* Resource Planning and Commercial Estimation: Determine project resource requirements, estimate implementation effort in terms of resources and delivery days, and contribute to solution costing and commercial proposals.
* Technical Documentation and Proposals: Prepare detailed architecture documentation, Bills of Materials (BOMs), Statements of Work (SOWs), technical proposals, and implementation roadmaps to support solution approval and delivery.
* Internal Coordination and Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with delivery leads, engineers, project managers, vendors, and practice leaders to validate proposed solutions and ensure technical and operational alignment.

**Requirements**

* At least 8 years of professional experience as a Solution Architect, Pre-Sales Architect, or Senior Technical Consultant within managed services, systems integration, technology consulting, or similar environments.

* Strong understanding of Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, Intune, Teams, and SharePoint.

* Hands-on architectural experience with Azure and/or AWS, covering IaaS, PaaS, hybrid cloud environments, cloud migration, governance, security, and cost optimization.
* Strong commercial awareness and experience with resource planning, effort estimation, solution costing, and project scoping.
* Ability to produce comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture designs, BOMs, SOWs, proposals, and implementation plans.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with the capacity to manage multiple opportunities and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Benefits**

d29ff2b1.title: Applied AI Architect
d29ff2b1.description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

6ce727b8.title: Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - Advanced Analytics
6ce727b8.description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - Advanced Analytics
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement
  
  
**The job**
The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. The role is accountable for quality, timelines, reusable technical outputs, and timely risk escalation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover.
* Build, configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and adapt AVEVA solutions in real customer environments.
* Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.
* Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps
* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.
* Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities.
* Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early.

**Essential Skills**

* Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery.
* Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover.
* Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints.
* Practical domain awareness of the customer’s operating model, workflows, KPIs, and value drivers, so the solution solves the right industrial problem.
* Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities.
* Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early.
* Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills.
* Developing AI Agents, Skills, Tools, Plugins etc. using any one of the agentic framework preferably MAF
* AI tools for SDLC like Copilot & practical awareness of AI/ML and Generative AI use cases within agreed technical, safety, and governance guidance.
* Accountability for quality, schedule, documentation, testing evidence, reusable outputs, and reliable handover.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Defined FDE technical workstreams are delivered reliably, on time, and in line with agreed architecture, standards, and customer success criteria.
* AVEVA solutions are configured, integrated, tested, validated, documented, and handed over with clear evidence of quality and operational readiness.
* Non-routine technical issues are resolved using sound judgment, with material risks, dependencies, and trade-offs escalated early.
* Reusable configurations, templates, troubleshooting notes, implementation guidance, and AI or integration patterns improve delivery quality for future FDE engagements.
* Peers, Architects, Leads, and customer-facing stakeholders view the role as a dependable technical contributor who builds confidence through practical execution, clear communication, and reliable handover.

**Services at AVEVA**
Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.
  
  
You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our
awards and recognition
.
  
  
Find out more:
https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

757521d2.description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**MTS SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is looking for a specialized software engineer who is passionate about improving the performance of key applications and benchmarks**.** You will be a member of a core team of incredibly talented industry specialists and will work with the very latest hardware and software technology.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate should be passionate about software engineering and possess leadership skills to drive sophisticated issues to resolution. Able to communicate effectively and work optimally with different teams across AMD.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Architect, Design and Develop Storage solutions on DPUs in the areas of NVMe-PCIe NVMeoF(TCP, RDMA), VirtIO for Cloud and AI usecases.
* Build Innovative solutions and solve challenging problems in areas of Storage Disaggregation, Virtualization, Storage services (Encryption, Compression, Replication and Erasure Coding), etc
* Contributions to Patents, Standards and Open Source Initiatives
* Work with AMD’s architecture specialists to improve future products
* Apply a data minded approach to target optimization efforts
* Stay informed of software and hardware trends and innovations, especially pertaining to algorithms and architecture
* Design and develop new groundbreaking AMD technologies
* Participating in new ASIC and hardware bring ups

* Debug/fix existing issues and research alternative, more efficient ways to accomplish the same work
* Develop technical relationships with peers and partners

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

  

* Prior Storage experience in any of NVMe, NVMe-oF, VirtIO, SCSI/FCP, iSCSI, RDMA and TCP areas
* Strong object-oriented programming background, C/C++
* Strong systems programming background
* Exposure to Linux block layer, block device drivers (linux, ESXi, Windows), QUEM/KVM Virtualization, PCIe, TCP and basic networking is added advantage

* Ability to write high quality code with a keen attention to detail
* Experience with modern concurrent programming and threading APIs
* Experience with software development processes and tools such as debuggers, source code control systems (GitHub) and profilers is a plus
* Effective communication and problem-solving skills

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent

Job description:
  
  

Join Wipro Technologies as a
**Solution Architect L1**
specializing in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning within our Technology Services sector, specifically the Data - EPM practice. As a vital member of the TS - Applied AI & Data group, you will play a key role in shaping end-to-end digital transformation projects by designing scalable, innovative solutions that deliver significant business value.

In this role, you will leverage your 8-10 years of industry experience and strong expertise in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, developers, and project managers. You will be responsible for architecting robust solutions that meet complex business requirements, enabling clients to harness the power of advanced analytics and planning capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the architectural design and implementation of SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions ensuring alignment with client goals and technological best practices.
* Analyze current systems and business processes to identify gaps and recommend ways to optimize performance using analytics solutions.
* Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to translate business requirements into technical architecture and deliverables.
* Develop detailed solution blueprints, including data models, integration strategies, and deployment plans tailored to client environments.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior architects and developers, fostering continuous learning and growth.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, governance models, and industry standards throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Stay current with emerging trends in SAP Analytics Cloud and broader data analytics technologies to drive innovation.
* Support pre-sales activities by contributing to proposals, presentations, and proof-of-concept demonstrations.
* Facilitate effective communication among stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment throughout project execution.

Qualifications and Skills

* Deep technical knowledge and hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud Planning.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, business intelligence concepts, and enterprise performance management (EPM).
* Proven experience architecting solutions within large-scale, complex enterprise environments.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working in collaborative, agile teams with a client-centric mindset.
* Commitment to continuous professional development and keeping current with technological advancements.

914aebd1.title: Cloud Architect Platform Engineering
914aebd1.description:
**RTC Restaurant Technology**

The Restaurant Technology portfolio is the set of restaurant and business applications that power day-to-day operations across our restaurants and the business behind them. You will architect the cloud and platform foundation that these applications run on today and as the portfolio modernizes, with a focus on reliability, performance, and security for systems that restaurants depend on every hour they are open.

**OXP / Digital Engineering**

The Digital Engineering portfolio is made up of our customer-facing Whataburger digital applications, including:

* The Whataburger mobile app (iOS and Android)
* Whataburger.com
* Loyalty
* Other applications and services that sit under the digital portfolio

These applications are built, or will be built, on top of the infrastructure and platform you will design and architect.

Key Responsibilities

**Cloud-Native Architecture & Design**

* Lead architecture and design conversations for the RTC and OXP/Digital portfolios with engineering, product, security, and business stakeholders.
* Design cloud-native reference architectures on Azure and GCP using containers, managed Kubernetes (AKS, GKE), serverless, and managed data and messaging services.
* Architect and guide the build of active-active, multi-region platforms, including global traffic management, data replication, failover, and resiliency patterns that meet defined RTO/RPO and SLO targets for mobile app, web, loyalty, and restaurant-facing systems.
* Run architecture reviews and design authority checkpoints, and drive tradeoff decisions across cost, performance, resilience, security, and portability between Azure and GCP.

**Platform Engineering & Developer Experience**

* Design and evolve the internal developer platform: self-service provisioning, golden paths, service templates, and a developer portal (e.g., Backstage) used by RTC and Digital application teams.
* Define multi-tenant Kubernetes platform standards, including cluster topology, networking, ingress, service mesh, secrets management, and workload identity.
* Build the platform as a product: set a roadmap, gather feedback from engineering teams, and measure adoption and developer productivity.
* Provide build oversight to ensure delivery teams follow architectural standards and platform best practices.

**CI/CD & Engineering Frameworks**

* Define and evolve the next-generation CI/CD strategy: pipeline standards, release patterns (blue/green, canary, progressive delivery), and environment promotion models.
* Design and oversee reusable pipeline frameworks and templates across Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Cloud Build / Cloud Deploy, or equivalent tooling.
* Embed automated quality, security (DevSecOps), supply chain controls, and policy-as-code gates (e.g., Azure Policy, GCP Organization Policy, OPA/Gatekeeper) into pipelines.

**Infrastructure as Code & GitOps**

* Establish IaC standards and modular patterns (Terraform preferred; Bicep and Crossplane or equivalent as needed) with strong governance, testing, and drift detection.
* Champion GitOps (Argo CD, Flux) and automation-first practices across provisioning, configuration, and operations.
* Design landing zones and multi-subscription / multi-project structures with consistent guardrails for identity, networking, and security.

**SRE Engineering**

* Partner with SRE to embed reliability into the platform: SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, observability (OpenTelemetry-based), alerting, and incident response practices. Help building the best-in-class SRE Dashboards both from business and Technology standpoint to view everything in single-pane of glass.
* Design resilience testing, including chaos engineering and failover exercises, and contribute to DR/BCP planning and operational readiness for production launches.
* Build reliability and operability standards into golden paths so every application inherits them by default.

**AI Engineering**

* Apply AI and GenAI tooling to accelerate architecture, IaC and pipeline authoring, code review, incident analysis, and operational insights.
* Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted platform and SRE capabilities (e.g., intelligent pipeline optimization, anomaly detection and AIOps, automated documentation, self-service assistants) with appropriate guardrails.
* Design the cloud foundation for AI workloads using Azure AI / Azure OpenAI and GCP Vertex AI where programs require it.

**Security & Cost**

* Partner with security and FinOps to build identity, data protection, compliance, and cost optimization into every design.

Required Qualifications

* [8–12 ] years in cloud, infrastructure, or platform engineering, with [3 ] years in a cloud architect role.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in Azure and GCP, including core services for compute, networking, identity, storage, and managed data.
* Strong cloud-native experience: Kubernetes (AKS and GKE), containers, microservices, service mesh, and event-driven architectures.
* Proven experience designing and delivering active-active / multi-region architectures for high-volume, customer-facing platforms.
* Strong IaC skills (Terraform required) and experience building modular, reusable code at scale.
* Hands-on experience designing CI/CD platforms and frameworks, with GitOps practices (Argo CD or Flux).
* Working knowledge of SRE practices: SLOs, observability, incident management, and resilience engineering.
* Experience building or operating an internal developer platform with a platform-as-a-product mindset.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI/GenAI tools to engineering or operations workflows.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with restaurant/QSR, retail, e-commerce, or omnichannel digital ordering, mobile, and loyalty platforms.
* Experience supporting restaurant-facing or edge-connected systems alongside cloud platforms.
* Experience with API management and gateways (Azure API Management, Apigee), and distributed data stores (Cosmos DB, Spanner, or similar).
* Familiarity with observability stacks (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Cloud Operations).
* Cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Terraform Associate, or CKA/CKAD.
* Experience with Backstage or similar developer portal tooling.

What Success Looks Like

* RTC and OXP/Digital applications (mobile app, Whataburger.com, loyalty, and the wider portfolio) run on resilient, active-active, cloud-native infrastructure that meets availability and performance targets and any Infrastructure builds which are versioned and automated from all use cases standpoint.
* A self-service internal developer platform and standardized CI/CD frameworks adopted across teams, with measurable gains in deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate.
* SRE and AI engineering practices are built into the platform, improving reliability, incident response, and developer productivity.
* IaC, GitOps, and AI-assisted practices become the default way teams build and operate on Azure and GCP.

The role will also involve conducting technical proof of concepts (POCs), demonstrations, presentations, and technical validation activities to showcase the value and capabilities of supported products and solutions.

f9e45671.title: Principal Presales Consultant
f9e45671.description:
Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000+ users across 70+ global financial enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.

**Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo**

Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology. Our platform's human-centric design, coupled with enterprise-grade scalability and AI-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.

**Recognition & Trust**

● Backed by $45M+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.

● Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!

● Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced Functionality ranking.

● Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a

"Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.

● Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence

**The Role**

As a
**Principal - Pre Sales,**
you will sit at the intersection of enterprise software architecture, executive financial strategy, and business transformation. You will bridge the gap between complex AI-driven technology and prospective client business outcomes, owning the financial justification (ROI, TCO, net revenue uplift) and strategic value narrative for Vymo's largest prospective clients across global BFSI markets.Working alongside Regional VPs, Account Executives, and Enterprise Architects, you will act as a trusted advisor to CFOs, CROs, COOs, and CIOs, translating technical capabilities into multi-million-dollar business impact.

**What You will do**

**Strategic Discovery & Enterprise Solution Design**

* Run discovery workshops with prospects to identify key business bottlenecks and sales productivity gaps.
* Design secure enterprise architecture blueprints that integrate Vymo with core banking, insurance, and CRM systems.

**Value Quantification, Proposal Leadership & Proof of Value (PoV)**

* Build financial models, ROI business cases, and TCO comparisons to prove the monetary value of Vymo to prospective clients.
* Lead major RFP submissions and Proof of Value (PoV) pilots to demonstrate tangible business impact before contract signing.

**C-Suite Engagement & Executive Storytelling**

* Work directly with C-suite leaders to align Vymo’s platform capabilities with executive-level business goals.
* Translate complex AI features and technical workflows into simple, persuasive stories for non-technical leaders.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with product and engineering teams to share market feedback and improve Vymo's product roadmap.
* Collaborate with implementation and post-sales teams to ensure smooth client onboarding and handover.

**Experience and Fluency**

* **Domain Expertise:**
  Strong knowledge of banking and fintech software platforms (e.g., Digital Engagement Platform, core banking, or payment rails)
* **Experience & Workflow Depth:**
  8 –12 years in B2B SaaS Presales, Solutions, or Management Consulting with deep domain expertise mapping BFSI workflows across Lending, Collections, Insurance Distribution, and Sales Productivity.
* **Discovery & Value Engineering:**
  Proven track record leading discovery-led engagements to build data-backed ROI/TCO models, commercial pricing structures, and clear financial and operational business cases for C-suite decision-makers.
* **Enterprise Sales Partnership:**
  Hands-on experience co-owning complex enterprise sales cycles alongside AEs, effectively balancing customer requirements with commercial viability and post-sale delivery feasibility.
* **AI & Tech Transformation:**
  Strong technical ability to translate complex software stack breakdowns, CRM ecosystems, and security standards into clear CXO conversations around AI-enabled operating models, integration architectures, and data governance.

**Mindset & Core Traits**

* **Curiosity & Agency:**
  Obsessed with diagnosing root causes before proposing tech; you use discovery to isolate structural problems rather than treating symptoms, building the operational script as you go.
* **Grounded Builder:**
  Guided by a natural curiosity that balances customer needs with delivery feasibility; you intuitively map messy enterprise workflows into viable, structured platform frameworks from scratch.
* **Diplomatically Direct:**
  Possess the structural thinking and commercial credibility to tell a banking CXO when their legacy process is the bottleneck, balancing customer expectations with realistic commercial boundaries.

45db5b47.title: Solution Architect - Presales
45db5b47.description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for L2 Presales Engineers with strong expertise in Modernization, Data & AI, and Migration to strengthen our presales capabilities in these strategic technology areas.
  
  
The selected candidates will be responsible for handling core L2-level presales activities, including customer discovery, solution design, architecture, technical presentations, solution discussions, and customer-facing technical engagements.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of technical depth, solutioning capability, and customer-facing presales experience. Migration expertise is mandatory, along with strong knowledge of Modernization and Data & AI.
  
  
The resources will work closely with the presales and sales teams and will also contribute to cross-skilling and knowledge sharing across the broader presales organization.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Data & Modernization Presales Engineer with hands-on experience in application modernization, database modernization, cloud migration, and AWS modernization services. The candidate will support sales teams in designing modernization solutions, conducting technical assessments, preparing proposals, developing business cases, and assisting customers in their transformation journey from legacy applications and databases to modern cloud-native platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of modernization tools such as AWS Transform (ATX), Kiro, Amazon Q Developer, database migration technologies, application re-platforming, and cloud-native architecture patterns
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Conduct technical discovery sessions with customers to understand business and technology requirements.
* Translate customer requirements into appropriate technical solutions and architectures.
* Design and present solutions focused on application modernization, cloud transformation, migration, data, and AI.
* Develop high-level solution architectures, technical proposals, presentations, and solution documents.
* Participate in customer meetings, workshops, technical discussions, and solution demonstrations.
* Collaborate with sales, delivery, engineering, and architecture teams to develop end-to-end solutions.
* Provide technical inputs for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and other presales engagements.
* Assess existing customer environments and identify modernization and migration opportunities.
* Support estimation, solution sizing, effort assessment, and technical assumptions.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends across Modernization, Cloud, Data, and AI.
* Build reusable solution assets, reference architectures, presentations, and technical collateral.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and cross-skilling initiatives within the presales team.
* Support multiple customer opportunities while managing priorities and timelines effectively.
* Conduct application and database modernization discovery workshops with customers.
* Assess legacy applications and recommend Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, or Modernization strategies.
* Analyze existing database platforms and define migration approaches to Aurora PostgreSQL, PostgreSQL, Aurora MySQL, or AWS-native services.
* Execute application and database assessment tools and prepare modernization reports.
* Utilize AWS Transform, Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, AWS SCT, and other modernization tools to identify migration opportunities.
* Design target-state cloud architectures aligned with AWS Well-Architected principles.
* Prepare High-Level Designs (HLDs), solution architectures, migration plans, and modernization roadmaps.
* Create effort estimations, bill of materials (BoM), TCOs, and technical proposals.
* Present solution recommendations, modernization strategies, and business benefits to customer stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities including RFP/RFI responses, technical discussions, and solution demonstrations.
* Identify application dependencies, integration challenges, and modernization risks.
* Work closely with AWS teams, OEM partners, sales teams, and delivery teams for solution validation.
* Define migration waves, cutover approaches, testing strategies, and rollback plans.
* Stay current with emerging AWS modernization services, GenAI-assisted development tools, and cloud-native architectures.
* Support PoCs, pilot engagements, and customer workshops focused on application and database modernization initiatives.
* Assess existing data platforms including Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, ETL pipelines, BI platforms, and recommend modernization strategies on AWS-native services.
* Design high-level architectures for Data Lakes, Data Platforms, Analytics Solutions, GenAI applications, RAG-based solutions, and AI-powered modernization initiatives
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI-assisted tools for application modernization, code transformation, database migration, documentation generation, and productivity improvements
* Support presales activities related to Data Engineering, Analytics, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions, including preparation of solution proposals, roadmaps, effort estimates, and business cases.
* Work with customers to define AI use cases, data readiness requirements, governance considerations, and modernization priorities aligned to business outcomes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in Presales, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, or Solution Engineering.
* Strong experience in customer-facing presales engagements.
* Strong understanding of Application Modernization and transformation concepts.

The Solution Architect provides technical leadership and designs complex solution architectures that support business strategy and streamline technology-enabled workflows. This position focuses on emerging technologies, including AI, Generative AI, and machine learning, and guides solutions from research and analysis through architecture, delivery support, and operational readiness.

* Experience designing and integrating AI and ML capabilities into applications, including model serving considerations and data dependencies.
* Experience with one or more languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, or Scala.
* Experience with data persistence technologies across SQL and NoSQL.

* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, including automated testing and deployment automation.
* Strong communication skills and ability to translate business needs into clear technical direction.
