8088dfe5.title: Technical Architect
8088dfe5.description:
**About EDMO**

EDMO is an AI-powered company that provides enrollment-centric solutions to universities, colleges,

and higher education institutions. By streamlining repetitive tasks—such as document verification,

transcript evaluation, SOP/essay reviews, and applicant matching—EDMO enables its clients to

process student applications faster and more accurately. Its intelligent workflows not only reduce

administrative workload but also empower admission advisors to focus on personalized guidance

and student engagement.

With features like AI-powered chatbots, Photo ID verification, GPA calculator, and transfer credit

evaluation, EDMO ensures transparency and efficiency across the enrollment journey. Institutions

using EDMO services report significant time savings, improved decision-making, and enhanced student satisfaction.

At its core, EDMO is built to reimagine & streamline admissions—making them smarter, quicker,

and more human-centric.

​

**Role overview**

EDMO is looking for a Technical Architect to own “how this will work for this customer” across

complex product development and university implementations. This role sits at the intersection of sales, product, engineering, and implementation, ensuring that what is promised to clients is technically feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with EDMO’s core platform.

​

You will lead technical discovery, design end‑to‑end solutions (especially integrations and

configuration), and guide implementations so that each deployment is repeatable rather than a

one‑off custom project.

​

**Key responsibilities**

1. Lead technical discovery with universities
2. Run deep‑dive sessions with client IT and admissions teams to understand systems (CRM/SIS/LMS), telephony/chat stack (e.g., Genesys), SSO, security/compliance, and data‑flow requirements.
3. ​Translate business and admissions‑process needs into clear technical requirements, constraints, and non‑functional expectations (performance, privacy, retention, observability).
4. Design end‑to‑end solutions and integrations
5. Own the solution blueprint for each customer: integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, MCPs / connectors), data contracts, mapping to CRM/SIS, and event flows into EDMO.
6. Decide what is configuration vs. product gap vs. true custom work, clearly articulating trade‑offs, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
7. Ensure solutions adhere to EDMO’s architectural guardrails on security, multi‑tenancy, scalability, and maintainability.
8. **Pre‑sales and scoping support -**
   Partner with Sales and Customer Success in late‑stage opportunities as the senior technical voice, especially where integrations and complex workflows are involved.
9. Validate feasibility, effort, and risks before contracts/SOWs are signed, helping ensure EDMO does not commit to non‑viable or non‑scalable customizations.
10. Contribute to RFP responses, solution summaries, and executive‑level technical presentations for key accounts.
11. Implementation oversight and handoff- Work closely with Implementation / Professional Services to turn the solution blueprint into a concrete plan: milestones, cut‑over strategy, environments, data migration, and UAT.
12. Stay engaged through go‑live as an escalation point for scope changes, new technical risks, and critical design decisions that affect stability or timeline.
13. Ensure a clean transition from project mode to steady‑state Customer Success, with clear documentation and knowledge transfer.
14. Architecture, standards, and product feedback- Champion repeatability: push toward configuration, patterns, and reusable assets/templates instead of bespoke code on every project.
15. Work with the CTO and Product to feed recurring client needs and integration patterns into the roadmap and reference architecture.
16. Contribute to internal playbooks, reference diagrams, and best practices for integrations, security reviews, and enterprise onboarding.

​

**What success looks like**

1. Enterprise university implementations go live with stable, observable integrations and minimal post‑go‑live firefighting.
2. Deals are scoped realistically, with fewer “we sold something we cannot or should not build” situations.
3. ​Over time, more of what you design becomes standardized features and implementation patterns, reducing custom effort per customer.

**Required experience**

1. 6–10+ years in a technical role such as Solutions Architect, Integration Architect, Senior Engineer, or Solutions/Pre‑Sales Engineer in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
2. ​Strong experience designing and implementing integrations between SaaS platforms and enterprise systems (CRM/SIS/ERP, telephony/contact‑center, identity providers, data platforms).
3. ​Solid understanding of modern integration patterns: REST APIs, webhooks, event‑driven architecture, iPaaS/MCP‑style connectors, and data synchronization strategies.
4. ​Hands‑on familiarity with at least some of: Salesforce or other CRM, student information systems, contact‑center platforms (e.g., Genesys), and cloud platforms.
5. ​Proven track record working directly with enterprise customers, leading technical workshops, and navigating between business and technical stakeholders.
6. ​Ability to create clear solution artifacts: architecture diagrams, integration specs, sequencing diagrams, and SOW inputs understandable by both engineers and non‑technical leaders.

​

**Nice to have**

1. Experience in higher education technology (admissions, enrollment, student success) or other regulated domains with complex workflows.
2. ​Exposure to AI/ML or conversational AI platforms and how they integrate into existing enterprise ecosystems.
3. ​Background in Professional Services or Customer Success Engineering where you owned outcomes for large, multi‑stakeholder implementations.
4. ​Skills and attributes- Strong systems thinking and architecture mindset: can balance ideal design with pragmatic delivery constraints.
5. Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior IT and business leaders as well as working hands‑on with engineers.
6. Low‑ego collaborator who can push back on risky asks while staying customer‑centric and solution‑oriented.

1a6e264e.title: Senior AI Solutions Architect
1a6e264e.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Job Profile Summary**
The Senior AI Solutions Architect is an advanced subject matter expert responsible for shaping, validating and assuring complex artificial intelligence solutions during the opportunity-to-order lifecycle.
  
  
The role operates as the primary technical and delivery interlock between regional go-to-market teams and the Global AI Delivery Unit. It enables sellers and regional solution teams to access AI delivery expertise without requiring core delivery resources to become extensively engaged in routine pre-sales activity.
  
  
The Senior AI Solutions Architect works with clients, sales teams, solution teams, commercial management, delivery leaders and specialist technical teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, commercially viable and delivery-ready AI solutions.
  
  
The role contributes to, or leads, the development of solution architectures, prototypes and proofs of concept where required. It validates solution feasibility, delivery scope, resource requirements, effort estimates, commercial assumptions, delivery risks and contractual commitments before NTT DATA enters into a client agreement.
  
  
As part of the Global AI Delivery Unit, the role helps protect delivery outcomes and the AI Delivery P&L by ensuring that proposed solutions have an appropriate delivery structure, cost-recovery model, risk position and transition plan before customer signature.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Deal intake and GTM interlock**

* Act as the primary technical and delivery interlock for assigned AI opportunities from qualified intake through solution approval, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Engage with regional GTM, sales and solution teams early in the opportunity lifecycle to understand the client’s business problem, intended outcomes, technical environment, data landscape and commercial requirements.
* Assess whether the opportunity is sufficiently qualified for Global AI Delivery engagement and identify any additional information, discovery or customer validation required.
* Review use-case descriptions and business requirements to assess whether the proposed use of AI is appropriate, feasible and aligned with measurable client outcomes.
* Support structured discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into actionable technical and delivery requirements.
* Identify the specialist capabilities required to support the pursuit and coordinate targeted engagement from Global AI Delivery Unit, security, legal, commercial and regional delivery teams.
* Manage the involvement of delivery specialists carefully, ensuring that delivery expertise is used for material design decisions and specialist validation without drawing delivery teams unnecessarily into general pre-sales activity.
* Maintain clear communication with opportunity owners regarding solution status, outstanding decisions, risks, dependencies and readiness for assurance.

**AI solution architecture and design**

* Shape or own the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions across application, model, data, integration, infrastructure and security domains.
* Evaluate architecture options and select appropriate AI models, cloud services, orchestration frameworks and third-party technologies, balancing cost, performance, scalability, security and delivery complexity.
* Define secure integration, functional and non-functional requirements, data governance and responsible AI requirements for the proposed solution.
* Align solutions with NTT DATA reference architectures, reusable assets, delivery patterns and approved technology standards.

**Prototyping and feasibility validation**

* Develop, lead or coordinate prototypes and proofs of concept where required to validate feasibility, reduce delivery risk or demonstrate the proposed solution.
* Test material assumptions relating to model performance, data, integration, security, scalability, latency and consumption cost, with clear success and exit criteria.
* Translate prototype findings into the production architecture, estimate, assumptions and risk position, engaging specialist engineering support where required.

**Delivery planning and resource model**

* Translate the solution into a realistic delivery approach covering workstreams, deliverables, milestones, dependencies and mobilisation.
* Define or validate the resource model, effort estimates, skills, location strategy and use of global delivery centres, partners or subcontractors.
* Assess delivery timelines and define appropriate governance, roles, responsibilities, escalation and change control.
* Identify requirements for managed services, production support, model monitoring, platform operations or continuous optimisation where applicable.

**Commercial solution development**

* Work with commercial, finance, sales and delivery stakeholders to develop a commercial construct aligned to the architecture and delivery model.
* Validate estimates, rate-card assumptions, third-party costs, consumption charges and contingency, ensuring all material delivery costs are represented.
* Ensure the resource model, delivery estimate, pricing, contribution and margin assumptions remain internally consistent, with uncertainty managed through appropriate commercial mechanisms.
* Support pricing and approval processes and challenge commercial constructs that create unmanageable technical or delivery risk for NTT DATA.

**Scope and statement-of-work development**

* Support the drafting and review of proposals and statements of work, defining scope, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, client responsibilities and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure contractual artefacts accurately reflect the approved architecture, delivery approach, resource plan and commercial model, without ambiguous or unbounded commitments.
* Coordinate legal, security, data protection and responsible AI input and support negotiation of technical and delivery-related contractual terms.

**Deal assurance and governance**

* Assess the completeness and quality of the proposed solution across architecture, technical feasibility, delivery readiness, resource requirements, commercial consistency and risk treatment.
* Identify material technical, data, security, privacy, legal, commercial and delivery risks and ensure appropriate owners and mitigations are in place.
* Prepare and present assigned opportunities for relevant assurance and approval gates, coordinating required stakeholder review and sign-off.
* Provide a clear, evidence-based assurance recommendation: proceed, proceed subject to conditions, return for rework or do not proceed in the proposed form.
* Track assurance conditions, escalate material concerns and maintain appropriate decision records; ensure independent review where the architect has materially developed the solution.

**Transition and handover to delivery**

* Maintain a controlled solution baseline through contracting and mobilisation, ensuring material changes are reflected consistently across deal artefacts.
* Lead the transition to delivery, providing the approved architecture, scope, commercial baseline, resource plan, assumptions, dependencies, risks and client commitments.
* Support early mobilisation, resolve gaps between what was sold and what is being delivered, and capture feedback to improve future solutioning and estimates.

**Reuse and capability development**

* Contribute reusable AI architectures, delivery patterns, prototypes, estimation models, proposal assets and commercial assumptions informed by pursuit and delivery experience.
* Share knowledge, coach regional teams and continuously improve the methods, templates and governance controls used by the AI Deal Intake, Assurance & Governance function.

**Knowledge and Attributes**

* Advanced enterprise solution architecture knowledge across application, integration, data, infrastructure, cloud and security domains.
* Strong understanding of AI, generative AI and agentic AI solution patterns, including model selection and evaluation, RAG, prompting, grounding, data pipelines, APIs and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of major cloud platforms and their AI, data, integration and security capabilities, with working knowledge of software engineering, DevOps, MLOps and LLMOps.
* Ability to develop or lead prototypes and assess the path from proof of concept to a secure, scalable and supportable production solution.
* Strong understanding of security, privacy, compliance, data governance and responsible AI considerations.
* Commercial acumen across estimates, rate cards, pricing models, third-party costs, contribution, margin, contingency and cost recovery.
* Understanding of statements of work, contractual assumptions, acceptance criteria, client dependencies, change control and delivery transition.
* Strong client-facing consulting, communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical, commercial, delivery and executive audiences.
* Ability to exercise constructive challenge, make evidence-based decisions and manage multiple complex opportunities under demanding pursuit timelines.
* Strong analytical capability and attention to detail when reviewing solution, commercial and contractual artefacts.

**Academic Qualifications And Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, business or a related field.
* Relevant cloud or AI certification from Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform is preferred.
* Enterprise or solution architecture certification such as TOGAF is advantageous; additional AI, security, privacy, agile, project or service-management certifications are beneficial.

**Ideal / Desired Experience**

* Extensive experience in enterprise solution architecture, technical consulting, AI engineering or complex technology delivery, preferably within a large-scale technology-services environment.
* Experience working across pre-sales and delivery, engaging senior clients and translating business needs into viable technical solutions.
* Demonstrated experience designing or validating enterprise AI and generative AI solutions, including prototypes and integration with enterprise platforms and data.
* Experience with one or more major cloud platforms and their AI, data and integration services.
* Experience defining delivery scope, work breakdown structures, resource models, effort estimates and delivery plans.
* Experience contributing to commercial models, pricing assumptions, rate-card constructs or business cases for complex technology engagements.
* Experience drafting or reviewing statements of work, managing technical and delivery risk, and supporting formal solution or deal-assurance reviews.
* Experience transitioning solutions into delivery and working across sales, commercial, engineering, delivery, security, legal and partner teams; regulated environments and AI managed services/MLOps/LLMOps experience are advantageous.

**Workplace type:**
Remote Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

Strong understanding of **cloud-native AI architectures** (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration.

Strong communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement.a

Experience with **multimodal models** (text + image/audio/video).

Knowledge of **AI governance, ethical AI, and compliance frameworks**.

Python, GenAI, System Design and Architecture, RAG, LLM, Agentic

**Area(s) of responsibility**
-----------------------------

**Job Title: Oracle Fusion Finance & Costing Consultant**
=========================================================

**Location:** Noida, India - Birlasoft Office

**Years of Experience:** 8-10 years

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Fusion Finance & Costing Consultant with a strong background in finance and costing within Oracle Fusion applications. The ideal candidate will possess a deep functional understanding of Finance, Cost Accounting, Product Costing, and General Ledger, with the ability to analyze complex costing and accounting issues independently. This role requires a proactive approach to troubleshooting and resolving cross-functional issues, ensuring seamless integration between Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Finance.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead and support Oracle Fusion Cost Accounting and Financial Accounting activities.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Cost Organization, Cost Books, Cost Elements, Cost Components, Valuation Structures, and Cost Profiles.
* Apply deep knowledge of costing methods, including Standard Cost and Actual Costing.
* Analyze the accounting impact of Procurement, Inventory, Manufacturing, Order Management, and Inter-organization transactions.
* Manage Receipt Accounting, Inventory Accounting, Manufacturing Accounting, and Cost Accounting distributions.
* Analyze transaction flow from operational/subledger transactions through Subledger Accounting (SLA) to General Ledger (GL).
* Troubleshoot costing issues such as incorrect valuation, missing cost distributions, accounting errors, and reconciliation differences.
* Perform detailed Cost Accounting to GL reconciliation and identify root causes for discrepancies.
* Understand period-end costing and financial close processes, including pending transactions, cost processing, accounting creation, GL transfer, and reconciliation.
* Collaborate closely with Finance, SCM, Manufacturing, and technical teams to resolve cross-functional issues.
* Review existing configurations and recommend improvements aligned with Oracle Fusion best practices.

**Mandatory Skills**
--------------------

* At least 2-3 full-cycle Oracle Fusion implementations.
* Expert-level knowledge of:
* + Oracle Fusion Cost Accounting
  + Receipt Accounting
  + Inventory and Manufacturing Costing
  + General Ledger
  + Subledger Accounting
  + Accounting Rules and Account Derivation
  + Period Close and Reconciliation
* Strong understanding of SCM-to-Finance accounting integration.
* Ability to trace a transaction from its source through cost distributions, SLA journal entries, and GL journals.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly for costing and GL reconciliation issues.
* Ability to work independently with business and functional stakeholders.
* Experience in manufacturing/process manufacturing environments.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Knowledge of Oracle Inventory, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Order Management.
* Experience supporting large-scale Oracle Fusion implementations, cutovers, and production stabilization.
* Supply Chain Planning certification in Financials or SCM would be an advantage.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. A Master's degree or relevant certifications is a plus.

**Deal Breaker Skill:** Cost Accounting expertise is essential for this role.

**Job Description**
As an Oracle Cloud ERP Functional Support Consultant (L2), you will be responsible for providing first and second line support across the Oracle ERP suite. You will act as the initial point of contact for user queries and system issues, ensuring effective triage, resolution where possible, and appropriate escalation to L2/L3 teams.
  
  
This is a process-driven, customer-focused role requiring strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively within an ITIL-aligned support environment.
  
  
You must be willing to work flexible hours on rotation including cover until 23:00 UK Time/ 04:30 IST (shift allowance payable).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
You will deliver day-to-day operational support activities across one or more Oracle ERP modules (Financials, Procurement, Projects, HCM and other ERP areas), working as part of a global managed services team.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include triaging incoming incidents and service requests, assessing their priority and business impact, and ensuring they are correctly categorised, logged, and assigned within the ITSM tool. You will take ownership of tickets through their lifecycle, monitoring progress, proactively following up with resolver groups, and ensuring timely resolution within agreed SLAs.

You will perform routine system administration activities such as user setup, password resets, role provisioning, and basic access management in accordance with defined security and governance procedures.
  
  
You will engage with customers through agreed communication channels, providing regular and clear updates on ticket status and ensuring a high standard of customer service at all times.
  
  
Where issues cannot be resolved at L1 or L2, you will ensure they are escalated to L2/L3 support teams with sufficient detail, including replication steps, logs, and impact analysis, to enable efficient resolution.
  
  
You will contribute to knowledge management by documenting recurring issues, known errors, and standard operating procedures, helping to build a robust and reusable knowledge base.
  
  
Additionally, you will support service improvement initiatives by identifying recurring incidents or trends and raising these with senior team members to enable root cause analysis and problem management.

9638348d.title: Technical Program Manager
9638348d.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Commercial and Money Movement Solutions (CMS) within Visa has a strategic growth initiative to expand beyond core consumer card payments (C2B) and into broader money movement flows between individuals, businesses, and governments. The investments that Visa has made over decades in C2B provide Visa with the infrastructure, technical capability, brand, expertise, and relationships to tap into money movement between a much broader coupling of counterparties (B2B, B2b, B2C, P2P, G2C, G2B, etc.). The target market opportunity of more than 185T in potential volume is a Board-level aspiration for the company, with an aggressive net revenue CAGR forecast of 25%+ over the next five years.

Visa is evolving from legacy Agile to outcome-led, telemetry-driven, human-accountable delivery to unlock faster innovation, greater customer impact, and higher productivity through a single agentic pipeline with Human in the loop.

Visa Commercial Solutions (VCS) is a key business within (CMS responsible for growing all flows between businesses and governments from SMBs to the largest global corporates. We enable business and government entities of all sizes to thrive in dynamic global and local markets, by providing innovative end-to-end payment capabilities and frictionless experiences that simplify the critical processes that businesses perform daily. These critical processes include managing expenses, compliance, vendors and reporting and of course, making payments. Our suite of products and solutions deliver better cash flow, productivity, administrative efficiency, reconciliation, control and acceptance for clients. Visa is the number one payment network for small businesses, and we are rapidly growing our depth and breadth of solutions for large corporates and governments. We work closely with Issuers, Merchants, FinTechs and other ecosystem players to deliver these services.

The VCS PMO team has responsibility for driving transformation, enabling and orchestrating the end-to-end delivery on Fiscal year OKRs and organizational strategy. The team works collaboratively with Product Development, Product Management, Operations & Infrastructure, Cyber-Security, Client Services, and other key enterprise teams, across both global and region stakeholders, ensuring collaboration, alignment, governance, execution, and delivery.

Lead Technical Program Manager for Visa Commercial Solutions will provide oversight and governance on cross-functional delivery of the VCS programs & initiatives as well as ensure seamless and timely planning, prioritization and execution, leveraging the Visa Agentic Tool Chain (VATC). This role is critical for a successful delivery of the 2030 Strategic objectives and milestones on the product & technology roadmap.

The person must possess a can-do attitude, a growth-oriented mindset, process-focused and an ability to deal with change and ambiguity. Candidates must have a high technical background, extremely data centric and analytical, and be willing to learn new technologies, leverage Claude Code, Gen AI and other Agentic AI technologies to optimize and govern the programs. (S)he must understand the products and solutions being developed and possess a keen business acumen. Experience in Enterprise Operational methodologies (Agentic, Agile, Stage gate) is highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

* Deep expertise in steering and implementing large scale product development transformations from ground up and act as a point of contact with geographically disbursed teams where risk and ambiguity is high, and outcome driven.
* Manage the team’s growth, learnings, and overall development while aligning with the organization’s and PMO’s goals.
* Partner with Product & Technology leads to drive and ensure effective Annual Operational Planning, Quarterly Product Reviews and program reviews leveraging Visa Enterprise tools (GitHub, ServiceNow, Clarity, Power BI, Jira/Jira Align).
* Help and facilitate prioritization of Initiatives & Epics (Product requirements) that align to the Objectives & Business Results (OKRs) and available workforce capacity.
* Manage resource rosters for their Portfolios or Team of Agentic Squads in Jira, Jira Align and Polaris
* Manage program forecasts, budgets, labor capitalization and asset depreciation/amortization.
* Ensure effective participation of the teams in the Quarterly Planning activities across programs, collaborating with partners in Operations & Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and other Visa Technology verticals.
* Ensure that the program and projects follow Visa's Agentic Lifecycle Methodology and Key Controls, and that accurate and timely information is reported regularly on program progress and financial status in various forums and reporting modes.
* Act as a coach and mentor to the PMO team and the scrum teams on adopting agile best practices. Be the leader in advancing the ongoing transformation to Visa’s Agentic Lifecycle Management Operating Model.
* Learn and adopt Visa’s Secure Software Development Lifecycle Management (SSDLC), Golden Rules, release management and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes.
* Provide telemetry in quality, flow, and value metrics-based reporting to all stakeholders, hold regular program-level reviews
* Cultivate a mindset of rigorous planning & prioritizing while proactively identifying risks and dependencies to accelerate value realization.
* Manage cross-functional communications to maximize understanding, impact, and speed of change adoption.
* Act as a coach and mentor to the Engineering, PMO and Product teams on adopting agile best practices and a cadence of portfolio, program & team level ceremonies.
* Capture metrics & measurables that clearly indicate progress toward accomplishment of Reimagining Work at Visa Initiative.
* Develop a rigor for understanding and leveraging the productivity, quality, flow, usage, adoption , and value-based metrics to accelerate benefit realization.
* Generate and improve the agility metrics (performance, predictability, and persistency) by optimizing and governing the Visa processes for planning, budgeting, prioritization, delivery, release management, workforce planning and stakeholder (ELT, SLT) reporting.

84c3afbf.title: Lead Technical Program Manager, Network Delivery
84c3afbf.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 5 years of experience in leadership role with/without direct reports.
* Experience in technical program management.
* Experience in a people management or team leadership role.
* Experience in technical program management for network infrastructure delivery.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional/team projects.
* Experience with network certifications such as PMP, Agile project management, BICSI RCDD, BICSI RTPM, CCDE, CCNP, or CCIE.
* Experience designing and facilitating the implementation of networking data centers or colocation facilities.
* Experience managing technical vendors and leading quarterly business reviews.
* Experience working in integrated teams composed of both technical and non-technical members.

**About the job**
Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.
  
  
Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering-specific programs and teams.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager focused on Enterprise Network Delivery, you'll work on the Google Enterprise Network team to ensure the security, reliability, scalability, and automation of one of the largest enterprise networks in the world. You will define priorities based on our Objectives and Key Results (OKR's) to drive network product development and life-cycle decisions. You will be working with Network Engineers, Software Engineers, and Operations teams to ensure new solutions meet Operational needs and drive out technical debt and design/deployment snowflakes. Technical Program Manager in Generative AI (GEN) solves testing problems relating to efficient scaling, security and high availability as Google continues to push the boundaries for innovative new technologies.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and drive the development and delivery of enterprise network engineering products while leveraging automation and software programs by coordinating with global delivery teams across the company to facilitate efficient network services to customers.
* Partner with Network Engineers, Software Engineers, and Project Managers to deliver large technical networking projects.
* Develop reports to track scope, schedule, budget, risks, and overall project status; coordinate with stakeholders to manage, track, and control project issues to ensure timely delivery.
* Work with management to design and launch new processes, institute process improvements, and ensure the efficient/reliable achievement of process objectives.
* Manage third-party vendors responsible for the monitoring and troubleshooting of network services, including facilitating any escalations requiring engineering assistance.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

038b97c7.title: Technical Program Manager
038b97c7.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Technical Program Manager
  
  
**About Your Role**
As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex product engineering programs across full stack customer-facing platforms, from service architecture through user experience delivery. You will partner with software engineering, product management, and business leadership teams to translate strategic goals into executable technical programs. Your work will help improve delivery predictability, align cross-functional priorities, and accelerate the launch of scalable, high-quality products in dynamic environments.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead end-to-end technical programs across full stack product engineering environments, including customer-facing services, applications, and experience-focused delivery.
* Bridge software engineering, product management, and business leadership teams to define program scope, execution plans, milestones, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Coordinate multi-team deliverables, manage dependencies, track critical paths, and drive release schedules across complex technical initiatives.
* Translate broad business objectives and customer needs into actionable technical requirements, delivery plans, key performance indicators (KPIs), and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Partner with engineering and product teams to align design, development, testing, release, and operational readiness across distributed workstreams.
* Drive program governance through regular status reviews, risk management, issue tracking, escalation planning, and stakeholder communication.
* Communicate clearly with technical teams and non-executive leadership through structured updates, delivery dashboards, and risk reviews.
* Support teams in navigating ambiguity, resolving blockers, and maintaining execution discipline in fast-moving, high-scale product environments.
* Contribute to process improvements that strengthen release coordination, delivery transparency, and cross-team accountability.

**Experience You'll Need To Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program delivery, or related roles in product engineering environments.
* Experience leading technical programs across customer-facing, high-scale, dynamic application environments spanning services and user experience delivery.
* Experience coordinating multi-team deliverables, dependency management, critical path tracking, and release scheduling across complex engineering initiatives.
* Experience translating business goals and customer requirements into technical plans, KPIs, SLAs, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Experience communicating with technical teams and business stakeholders through regular status reviews, risk reviews, and structured program governance.
* Experience supporting or delivering high-throughput, scalable distributed systems or large-scale consumer or enterprise products.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience in financial services, payments, or other high-availability product environments.
* Experience working closely with software engineering teams in full stack delivery models.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery frameworks in enterprise engineering programs.
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent certification.

**How You'll Work**

* This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
  
  
**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

541f28e5.title: Sofware Architect - Artificial Intelligence - ITS-047
541f28e5.description:
Req Id: 4640

Posting Start Date: 11/3/26

Job Description:

AI Engineer

Global Enterprise Security | AI Engineering

Level: Security Engineer III/IV

Team Overview

GES AI Engineering is a small, high-leverage team that builds agentic AI and automation capability for Global Enterprise Security as a whole — not for a single program. The team is chartered to build once, reuse everywhere: shared agent platforms, evaluation tooling, and automation patterns that any GES team can adopt.

The team is four AI Engineers that are assigned to GES priorities as they arise rather than to one fixed team's tooling. An engineer's specific assignment will change over time as GES leadership reprioritizes; what stays constant is the underlying skill set below. Engineers cross-cover each other's assignments during surges, incidents, or absences.

Role Overview

The AI Engineer designs, builds, and operates agentic AI workflows and automation on behalf of Global Enterprise Security's teams — most often as an embedded partner rather than the workflow's eventual owner. This is a builder role: the engineer scopes a partner team's problem, prototypes an agent or automation against it on a shared platform (for example AWS Bedrock or an equivalent managed model platform), proves it is accurate and safe, and either hands it to the partner team to operate or keeps it running as a shared GES capability.

Assignments are expected to vary — a given engineer might spend a quarter embedded with a detection team, the next building a fleet-scale automation, and the one after that prototyping something for a team that has never used agentic tooling before. Because of that, this position is hired against durable capability, not against a fixed backlog: how quickly and safely the engineer can turn an unfamiliar security workflow into a working, trustworthy automation.

What You’ll Do

Problem Scoping and Solution Design

* Take an ambiguous, partner-team-described problem in any security domain and scope a narrow, testable first version of it — clarifying what "good" looks like before writing code.

* Choose the right automation or agentic pattern for the problem at hand (deterministic automation, retrieval-augmented response, tool/function-calling agent, multi-step orchestration) rather than defaulting to the most complex option available.

* Identify which parts of a partner team's workflow are high-volume and low judgment (good automation candidates) versus which require human decision-making and design the human/agent boundary accordingly.

* Assess data availability, access, and integration requirements early, and flag when a proposed assignment isn't yet ready for an AI-assisted solution.

Agentic Workflow and Automation Engineering

* Build agents and automation on the organization's shared model and orchestration platform(s) (for example AWS Bedrock or a comparable managed platform), including model selection/routing, tool and function definitions, and context and retrieval management.

* Build integrations and tool interfaces — including MCP servers or equivalent connectors — that give an agent scoped, least-privilege access to the data and systems it needs, and no more.

* Develop and maintain automation or agent logic as code: version control, peer review, staged promotion from development through production, and rollback capability.

* Write clean, maintainable Python and API integrations that a teammate can pick up and extend without the original author in the room.

Evaluation, Safety, and Production Hardening(Following skills are plus but not mandatory)

* Build an evaluation harness for every assignment before calling it done — golden examples, precision/recall or task-success measurement, and hallucination/false-action detection — and use it to decide whether a prototype is ready to progress.

* Define human-in-the-loop approval gates for any destructive or high-impact action, and ensure every automated or agent-driven action is logged, attributable, and reversible where feasible.

* Monitor deployed workflows for drift, degraded accuracy, and cost or rate-limit issues, and respond before they become incidents.

* Apply a bias toward measured autonomy: earn expanded authority for automation by demonstrating accuracy in the partner team's environment, not by assumption.

Shared Platform Contribution and Reuse

* Contribute to the shared agentic AI platform used across GES — model routing, guardrails, connectors, and evaluation tooling — so the next assignment starts from a stronger foundation than the last.

* Default to reusing existing connectors, patterns, and evaluation tooling across assignments rather than building bespoke solutions and generalize a one-off build into a shared component when it's likely to be needed again.

* Track and report what was automated, how much manual effort it removed, and where the next-highest-value assignment likely is.

AI Governance, Security, and Assurance

* Apply secure design and secure coding practices to all automation and agent code; treat model inputs, tool outputs, and third-party content as untrusted, knowledge on this is a plus.

* Working knowledge of implementing and validating controls against prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency, and sensitive data leakage in every deployment, regardless of which team it's built for, is a plus.

* Knowledge of maintaining evidence supporting applicable compliance obligations (for example PCI DSS, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, CMMC) for anything the engineer builds or operates, and work with GRC, Privacy, and Architecture on model approval and multi-tenant data boundaries is plus.

Enablement and Cross-Team Collaboration (Following skills are a plus but not mandatory)

* Document every workflow, agent, and its known limitations well enough that the receiving team can operate and trust it without the AI Engineering team in the room.

* Train and coach partner-team staff on how to use, question, and escalate around AI-assisted output.

* Evaluate emerging agentic and automation platforms relevant to a current or upcoming assignment, and produce clear, evidence-based build-versus-buy recommendations.

* Work comfortably as an embedded partner inside a team that isn't your own — building trust quickly, respecting existing process, and transferring ownership cleanly when an engagement ends.

Required Qualifications

* Six or more years in software, security, or platform engineering, including experience building and shipping automation or AI-assisted tooling into production.

* Hands-on experience building agentic workflows on at least one managed model platform (for example AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or a comparable agent-orchestration platform), including model selection/routing, tool and function calling, and context/retrieval management.

* Having Knowledge on Cybersecurity specialization to build from — one or more of: security operations/detection engineering, offensive security, identity and access, cloud security, GRC/risk, or vulnerability and fleet management — with enough depth to design a workflow a specialist in that domain would trust is a plus but not mandatory.

* Demonstrated ability to scope an ambiguous problem quickly and deliver a credible first working version, then iterate based on evaluation results rather than intuition.

* Strong Python development skills, with proven experience building and consuming REST APIs and integrating disparate enterprise tooling.

* Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including IAM concepts and least-privilege service credentials, knowledge on this is added advantage.

* Version control and CI/CD discipline: Git-based workflow, peer review, and automated testing.

* Demonstrated experience building agent evaluation approaches — golden datasets, precision/recall or task-success measurement, hallucination and false-action detection.

* Clear written communication; able to document a workflow well enough that a non-builder on the receiving team can operate it unaided.

* Comfort with ambiguity and reprioritization: this role is defined by capability, not by a fixed project backlog, and assignments will change.

Preferred Qualifications

* Knowledge of SOAR platform (Splunk SOAR, Torq, Tines, Swimlane, Cortex XSOAR, or equivalent) or an agentic security platform used for triage, enrichment, or response.

* Experience implementing or securing MCP servers or comparable agent tool interfaces is a plus.

* Familiarity with AI risk frameworks including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE ATLAS is a plus.

* Detection engineering background: MITRE ATT&CK mapping, detection-as-code, SIEM query languages and data models is a plus.

* Knowledge on fleet/endpoint management and patch automation tooling, or with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and Kubernetes is a plus.

* Multi-tenant or managed service provider operations experience is plus.

* Certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, AWS Certified Machine Learning, GCIA, GCIH, GCDA, AZ-500, or SC-200 is good have but not mandatory.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means bringing engineering judgment and safety discipline to every problem GES hands you, regardless of which team or platform it touches.

The AI Engineer will help ensure that automation and agentic AI are applied where they genuinely reduce risk, effort, or delay for a partner team - not simply because the technology is available or the assignment calls for something impressive. They will investigate what a workflow requires before building anything, identify where human judgment must stay in the loop, gather the evaluation evidence needed to show a solution is accurate and safe, and scope how much autonomy that solution has earned.

This role will help strengthen the connection between a partner team's real operational problem, the automation or agent built to address it, and the shared AI Engineering platform underneath it - so that trust, reuse, and safe autonomy compound across GES rather than resetting with every new assignment.

Working Expectations

* Operates under formal change management for anything touching production, customer-facing, or partner-team environments.

* Participates in a shared on-call rotation for platform availability and major incident support alongside the AI SOC Engineer.

* Assignments are set by GES leadership based on current priorities and may shift with limited notice; the engineer is expected to ramp on a new problem domain efficiently.

* Cross-covers teammates' assignments during surges, incidents, or absences.

ca01e6ba.title: AI Solution and Platforms Junior Architect/Engineer
ca01e6ba.description:
Overview

The Junior AI Observability Architect is an execution-focused engineer who designs, builds, and operates observability capabilities within a defined domain of the enterprise AI observability platform. Working under the strategic direction of the Senior AI Observability Architect, this role translates architecture blueprints into production-grade instrumentation, telemetry pipelines, dashboards, quality gates, and safety signals across agentic AI systems.

The junior architect is a hands-on engineer who codes, integrates, tests, and iterates owning feature-level delivery within one or more specialization tracks while developing a growing understanding of the full observability platform. They are a technical practitioner first, with an emerging architect mindset.

Responsibilities

1. Observability Platform Engineering OTEL Integration (25%)

* Implement OpenTelemetry (OTEL) instrumentation within assigned agent frameworks or platforms including custom exporters, span enrichers, semantic conventions, and context propagation hooks.
* Build and maintain telemetry pipeline components (collectors, processors, exporters) that route metrics, logs, traces, and semantic signals to central observability backends.
* Integrate OTEL with enterprise agentic platforms as assigned which may include Salesforce AgentForce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Agent 365, or internal frameworks following architecture blueprints set by the L11.
* Develop and maintain observability dashboards, alerting rules, and SLO/SLA definitions for the assigned sub-domain, ensuring signal quality and low false-positive rates.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for the observability platform contributing to RCA documentation and runbook improvement.
* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for all telemetry components; maintain >80% test coverage across owned services.

2. Safety, Security Red Teaming Support (15%)

* Instrument safety-critical signal capture within assigned pipelines including guardrail trigger rates, policy violation events, prompt injection detections, and hallucination flags.
* Support red team exercises by building observability hooks that capture adversarial test results, attack surface telemetry, and behavioral deviation signals in real time.
* Implement secure trace handling for sensitive AI decision events applying data masking, PII redaction, and audit-log retention policies as defined by the security architecture.
* Assist in maintaining the Security Observability Playbook documenting findings, updating escalation paths, and contributing to incident classification procedures.
* Monitor agent-to-agent protocol traffic (A2A, UCP, AP2) for anomalous communication patterns and flag deviations for review by the L11 architect and security team.

3. Responsible AI (RAI) Governance Signal Instrumentation (10%)

* Implement RAI signal collectors within assigned agent workflows capturing fairness indicators, bias detection outputs, explainability scores, and content safety classifications.
* Maintain RAI telemetry pipelines and ensure data quality, completeness, and timeliness of governance signals feeding into compliance dashboards.
* Contribute to audit-readiness work by ensuring all AI decision traces within the assigned domain include required governance metadata and are retained per policy.
* Support gap analyses by comparing current RAI signal coverage against governance framework requirements and flagging coverage gaps to the L11.

4. Quality Engineering for Agentic Solutions Post Go-Live Continuous QE (15%)

* Build and maintain quality gate components within CI/CD pipelines using observability data to detect performance regressions, behavioral drift, and SLA breaches before they reach production.
* Instrument and monitor Skill Evaluations (evals) across the Memory, Skills, and MCP harness stack collecting eval results, tracking pass/fail trends, and alerting on regression thresholds.
* Implement continuous quality monitoring for post-go-live agentic solutions tracking agent success rate, tool-call fidelity, latency distributions, and user outcome proxies.
* Conduct structured testing of new agent capabilities using standardized eval harnesses documenting results and feeding findings into quality improvement cycles.
* Develop automated quality reports and quality metric dashboards for stakeholder review, surfacing trends and anomalies in agent behavior over time.

5. Memory, Skills, MCP Harness Engineering Observability (10%)

* Instrument agent memory operations (read/write latency, cache hit rates, memory drift) across episodic, semantic, and working memory backends within the assigned scope.
* Add trace instrumentation to MCP server interactions tagging tool registrations, skill invocations, context injections, and result returns with semantic OTEL attributes.
* Capture harness execution telemetry for self-evolving and RL systems logging reward signals, policy update events, environment transitions, and convergence indicators.
* Monitor skill eval harness execution pipelines detecting flaky evals, environment setup failures, and result inconsistencies that could mask real capability regressions.

6. Data Science Python Engineering (10%)

* Write production-grade Python for observability tooling custom OTEL exporters, signal aggregators, anomaly detectors, and data transformation pipelines adhering to team engineering standards.
* Apply basic statistical and data science methods to telemetry data time-series analysis, threshold tuning, distribution characterization to improve signal quality and alerting precision.
* Contribute to Python SDK and library development that simplifies OTEL onboarding for agent developers across the organization.
* Participate in code reviews, apply test-driven development practices, and continuously improve the quality and maintainability of the observability codebase.

7. Agent Fleet, Physical AI Multi-Modal Observability (5%)

* Implement telemetry for agent fleet coordination capturing spawn/termination events, inter-agent communication traces, load distribution metrics, and fleet health indicators.
* Contribute to observability instrumentation for physical AI pipelines (edge inference, sensor fusion, robotics control loops) as directed focusing on latency, reliability, and data quality signals.
* Add OTEL instrumentation to multi-modal model pipelines tracing vision, audio, and text input processing stages and capturing cross-modal alignment quality signals.

8. Agentic Marketplace, Registry A2A / UCP / AP2 Observability (5%)

* Instrument the Agentic Marketplace and Agent Registry with usage telemetry tracking agent invocations, capability health scores, adoption trends, and dependency relationships.
* Implement protocol-level observability for A2A (Agent-to-Agent), UCP, and AP2 communication flows capturing message latency, error rates, retry patterns, and trust boundary crossings.
* Contribute to Marketplace Observability Dashboard

6b423bf3.title: Fullstack Architect
6b423bf3.description:
**Job Description Full Stack Architect (Next.js, React.js & Python)**

  

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**

  

**Position:** Full Stack Architect / Technical Architect  
 **Experience:** 6-8 Years  
 **Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Duration:** Fulltime

**Location:** Jaipur

**Technology Stack:** Next.js, React.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Cloud (AWS/Azure)

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Full Stack Architect** with strong expertise in Next.js, React.js, and Python to design, architect, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on development experience, strong system design capabilities, and the ability to lead technical architecture decisions across frontend, backend, databases, cloud infrastructure, and integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement end-to-end architecture for enterprise-grade full-stack applications.
* Lead frontend architecture using **React.js, Next.js, TypeScript**, and modern UI frameworks.
* Design scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using **Python, FastAPI, or Django**.
* Define application architecture, including microservices, modular monoliths, and event-driven systems.
* Establish reusable components, coding standards, and architectural best practices.
* Design database schemas, optimize queries, and manage relational and NoSQL databases.
* Architect authentication, authorization, RBAC, and secure API integrations.
* Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and system design decisions.
* Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Implement performance optimization, caching, monitoring, and application scalability strategies.
* Guide development teams through code reviews, technical mentoring, and solution implementation.
* Support cloud-native deployments, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and production readiness.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend suitable architectural solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Frontend Technologies**

* Strong expertise in React.js, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
* Experience with Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and React Server Components.
* Strong understanding of state management, component architecture, and frontend performance optimization.
* Experience with Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar UI frameworks.
* Knowledge of micro-frontend architecture is an advantage.

**Backend Technologies**

* Strong hands-on experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Django.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, asynchronous services, and microservices.
* Strong understanding of API security, authentication, authorization, and middleware.
* Experience with background processing, task queues, and distributed systems.

**Database & Data Layer**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
* Knowledge of MongoDB, Redis, or other NoSQL/caching technologies.
* Strong understanding of database modeling, indexing, and query optimization.
* Experience with ORMs such as SQLAlchemy.

**Architecture & System Design**

* Strong knowledge of High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD).
* Experience designing scalable, distributed, multi-tenant enterprise applications.
* Understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean architecture.
* Experience with API gateways, message queues, caching, and event-driven architecture.
* Ability to make architectural decisions considering performance, security, cost, and maintainability.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* Experience with AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based deployments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
* Understanding of cloud networking, monitoring, logging, and infrastructure scalability.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience integrating Generative AI and LLM-based capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
* Experience with WebSockets, real-time applications, and asynchronous communication.
* Knowledge of GraphQL and API orchestration.
* Familiarity with Databricks, data platforms, or analytics-driven applications.
* Experience working with enterprise SSO, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and Microsoft Entra ID.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Ability to lead technical teams and mentor senior developers.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews and technical feasibility assessments.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture and implementation plans.
* Strong communication skills for collaborating with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience supporting technical estimations, solution proposals, and delivery planning.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6-8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant hands-on experience in full-stack application development.
* At least 23 years of experience in technical architecture, solution design, or technical leadership.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering production-grade enterprise applications.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Deliver scalable, secure, maintainable, and production-ready application architectures.
* Establish consistent technical standards across frontend and backend development.
* Improve application performance, reliability, and development efficiency.
* Provide architectural guidance while remaining actively involved in critical technical implementations.

fe29adfd.title: It Architect
fe29adfd.description:
**Ready to take your career global?**   
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We are looking for the IT Architect to join our ever evolving Genius team and help shape the future of global commerce.   
   
**What you'll own**   
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience  
 - 12+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in a solution architect, lead engineer, or principal engineer capacity  
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping payment integrations: card-present, gateway integrations, semi-integrated payment flows, tokenization, or PCI-scoped architectures  
 - Hands-on experience building or operating cloud-native systems on AWS or Azure (microservices, event-driven architecture, API design)  
 - Strong API design skills across REST and OpenAPI, including authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, API key lifecycle)  
 - Experience integrating third-party platforms and designing scalable integration patterns (adapters, SPIs, provider-agnostic contracts)  
   
**What you'll bring**  
**Technical:**  
- Cloud platforms:\*\* AWS (ECS/Fargate, EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Aurora, S3, CloudWatch) and/or Azure (App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Cosmos DB)  
 - Backend:\*\* Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Go, or comparable; comfortable reading and reviewing across stacks  
 - Data:\*\* Relational (MySQL/PostgreSQL/Aurora), caching (Redis), search (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), big data pipelines (BigQuery, Athena, S3-based lakes)  
 - Messaging / events:\*\* Kafka, SQS/SNS, or comparable event-driven architectures  
 - Mobile platforms:\*\* Familiarity with iOS, Android, or React Native in the context of commerce client applications  
 - IaC and CI/CD:\*\* Terraform, GitHub Actions, Harness, or equivalent  
 - AI/ML:\*\* Practical experience with foundation model APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, GCP Vertex), prompt engineering, RAG patterns, agent frameworks, or MCP tooling  
-Skills / Knowledge:\*\* Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.  
 -Job Complexity:\*\* Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.  
 -Supervision:\*\* Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel.  
- Action over artifacts:\*\* Ships solutions, not documents. Diagrams exist to align teams, not to substitute for delivery. Value is measured by what teams build and ship, not by the elegance of designs in isolation.  
 - Bias toward decisions:\*\* Makes the call when teams are stuck, documents the why and the risks.  
 - Shared mindset:\*\* Before approving a net-new build, the first question is whether a peer domain already solved it or also has value in it.  
 - Communicates across levels:\*\* Equally comfortable in an engineering design review and a product conversation about tradeoffs.  
**#Tooling**  
- \*\*Project and delivery management:\*\* Jira, Confluence  
 - \*\*Architecture and diagramming:\*\* Lucidchart, Miro, draw.io, or comparable  
 - \*\*API design and documentation:\*\* Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, Apigee, or comparable  
 - \*\*Observability:\*\* Datadog, CloudWatch, or comparable APM/logging platforms  
   
**It's a bonus if you have**   
- Experience with point-of-sale systems or commerce platforms  
 - Familiarity with payment gateway ecosystems  
 - Experience designing or working with unified integration platforms, API gateways (Apigee, Kong, AWS API Gateway), or developer portals  
 - Experience building or architecting AI-enabled features: chatbot/conversational AI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LLM tool use (function calling, MCP), or AI-assisted developer tooling  
 - Experience working across verticals (SMB, mid-market, enterprise) and understanding the architectural tradeoffs each requires  
- Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope management and semi-integrated payment architectures  
 - Familiarity with P2PE, tokenization, and secure card data handling  
 - Understanding of payment tender types: credit/debit, gift card, BNPL, ACH, and alternative payment methods  
**About the team**   
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We are proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections it's unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.   
   
**What makes a Globalpayer?**   
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We are curious and innovative - always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it's our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.   
   
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

8fa382c1.title: Strategic Account & Delivery Manager
8fa382c1.description:
**Company Description**

EDMO is an AI-powered company specializing in enrollment-centric solutions for higher education institutions, offering tools to streamline admission processes. By automating tasks like document verification, transcript evaluation, and applicant matching, EDMO enables institutions to process applications efficiently and with greater accuracy. Its innovative features, such as AI-powered chatbots and GPA calculators, enhance transparency and efficiency across the enrollment journey. Clients benefit from reduced administrative workloads, improved decision-making, and enhanced student engagement. EDMO is committed to making the admissions process smarter, faster, and more personalized.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Project, Account & Integration Manager to oversee strategic US-based enterprise accounts. This role combines project and account management with a strong focus on leading product integration efforts—ensuring our solutions are successfully deployed and delivering maximum value for our customers.

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of large-scale client projects, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and within-scope execution—including product integrations.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, and resource allocations, coordinating cross-functional internal/external teams.
* Apply established project management methodologies (PMO, Agile, Lean, etc.) and tools for structured execution.
* Proactively identify and resolve risks/issues, control scope, and manage change processes.
* Prepare regular status updates, present project progress to customers and leadership teams.

**Product Integration**

* Take ownership of product integration work for enterprise clients, from planning through go-live, ensuring seamless deployment of all solution components.
* Collaborate with clients and technical teams to define integration requirements and success criteria.
* Oversee the design, customization, configuration, and deployment of product integrations, acting as the liaison between client technical teams and internal product/engineering teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues, coordinating root cause analysis and implementing lasting solutions.
* Ensure all product integrations meet customer needs, compliance standards, and performance expectations.
* Lead user acceptance testing and client enablement for integrated solutions, ensuring successful adoption and usage.

**Account Management & Growth**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for US-based enterprise customers, developing deep relationships with key stakeholders.
* Own and manage a portfolio of large enterprise accounts, crafting and executing account growth strategies.
* Identify, pursue, and secure new business opportunities within existing accounts, consistently meeting/exceeding revenue goals.
* Conduct regular business reviews, deliver performance reports, and recommend strategic solutions—driving upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Gather, communicate, and act on client feedback to improve service delivery and inform product enhancements.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Coordinate cross-functional teams including technical, sales, support, and integration resources to deliver value to enterprise clients.
* Drive accountability, provide coaching/mentorship, and foster collaboration within project and integration teams.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards, security, and quality controls, as well as contractual obligations.

**Market & Industry Awareness**

* Stay informed about market trends, customer business environments, and competitive landscapes relevant to client accounts.
* Leverage industry knowledge to propose innovative solutions and best practices—including integration trends—tailored for US enterprises.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred in Business, Management, Computer Science, or related fields.
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in enterprise project management and/or account management, including direct experience with product software or SaaS integrations for US clients.
* Proven track record of growing large, complex accounts, successfully delivering enterprise-grade projects, and handling product integrations.
* Strong understanding of integration standards, APIs, enterprise platforms, and deployment processes.
* Deep knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices.
* Excellent client relationship, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, technical, and leadership skills.
* Experience working with cross-cultural and international teams; familiarity with US business practices preferred.
* Industry experience in technology, SaaS, enterprise software, or consulting is highly valued.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work with leading U.S. universities and shape the future of EdTech.
* Collaborative, mission-driven team culture.
* Exposure to cutting-edge AI tools transforming global education.

**You will be joining Deutsche Bank Management Consulting (DBMC), the Bank’s in-house management consulting global team that partners with senior leaders to actively contribute to the bank’s strategic objectives. You can expect challenging and varied tasks - from day one. As part of your job, you will rotate into new project teams every 3-6 months and get to know all business divisions (Corporate & Investment Bank, DWS, Private Bank) as well as infrastructure functions (e.g., Risk, Finance) of the bank. You will engage with the bank’s most senior leaders. We regularly work with top executives, gaining a strategic, high-level view of the bank’s priorities.

* Lead and deliver end-to-end project modules across business and infrastructure functions, applying structured problem-solving methodologies, clearly defining situation, complication, and decision points
* Lead and develop project teams by setting clear expectations, managing team performance, allocating responsibilities effectively, and providing regular coaching and constructive feedback to support individual development and high-quality project delivery
* Take ownership for the conceptual planning and implementation of strategic projects
