* Own and contribute to project knowledge resources to enable knowledge reuse, consistency, and capability building within DBMC.
* Supervise, coach, and quality‑assure the work of junior and senior consultants and ensure timely delivery of their outputs
* Own and drive strategic internal initiatives alongside client projects, in close collaboration with consulting teams across London, Frankfurt and Mumbai
* Flexibility to work across global time zones (European hours), as required for the project needs and stakeholder interactions.
* Act in line with the bank’s values & aspirational culture, contributing to an inclusive, collaborative, and high‑performance team environment.
Ensure awareness of and adherence to relevant bank policies, practices, governance, and control requirements, proactively flagging delivery, risk, or stakeholder concerns.  

  

**Your skills and experience:**
-------------------------------

We are looking for professionals with excellent academic performance across relevant disciplines), in all disciplines (Master's degree mandatory). Professional qualifications are important, but your personality is even more decisive to us.

* Minimum 10 years of relevant Consulting and Financial Services experience (Post MBA) across relevant Consulting, Financial Services, AI transformation or technology-enabled business deliv-ery (ideally in financial services) focusing on strategy, transformation & demonstrating prob-lem‑solving, structured thinking, and delivery ownership
* Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional strategy and transformation engagements end-to-end, from problem definition and workplan development through recommendation, stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Proven experience leading and managing diverse teams with the ability to motivate team members to deliver complex project outcomes successfully
* Strong senior stakeholder management and executive advisory skills, with the ability to build credibility, challenge constructively and shape decisions with senior leaders across business and infrastructure functions.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and independently structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses, evaluate strategic options and translate analysis into pragmatic, actionable recommendations.

* Strong understanding of the Financial Services industry, including banking business models, operating models, key value drivers and the broader risk, regulatory and technology environment.
* Track record of translating strategy into execution, including designing target operating models, process improvements, governance structures, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to identify, anticipate and proactively manage project risks, dependencies and stakeholder challenges, escalating appropriately while maintaining accountability for delivery.
* Experience working effectively across functions, geographies and cultures, with the adaptability to engage different stakeholder groups and operate in complex organisational environments
* Conceptual and practical understanding of Generative AI, workflow automation or agentic workflows is beneficial. Software engineering experience is not required
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs
* Clear, confident communicator in English, capable of explaining and interpreting complex information to support stakeholder alignment and decision‑making; German language skills are an advantage.
* Commitment to continuous learning and development, Proven experience in coaching and developing junior professionals
Relevant internships, certifications, and entrepreneurial activities are also a plus

* Flexibility around key moments in the day and respect for personal priorities

--------------------------

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Senior Technical Program Manager
  
  
**Overview:**
The AI Platform Engineering team is responsible for enabling the enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence by building, operating, and evolving shared AI platforms, services, governance capabilities, and operational practices. Our mission is to provide scalable, secure, reliable, and compliant AI infrastructure that empowers teams across Mastercard to accelerate the development and deployment of AI-powered solutions.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead the delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives that support the evolution of Mastercard's AI platform ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, product, architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, operations, and business stakeholders to drive alignment, manage dependencies, reduce execution risk, and ensure successful delivery of strategic programs.
  
  
This team functions as an enterprise AI Platform Engineering organization, delivering and operating shared capabilities that enable application teams to build and scale AI-powered products across public and private cloud environments.
  
  
This role provides the opportunity to help shape and execute the roadmap for Mastercard's next generation AI platform capabilities. Rather than focusing on a single product or application, you will drive programs that span platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, developer enablement, governance, operational excellence, and enterprise adoption.
  
  
You will work on challenging problems involving large-scale technology delivery, platform adoption, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, operational readiness, governance, and organizational transformation while helping shape Mastercard's long-term AI platform strategy.
  
  
**About The Role:**
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Platform Engineering, you will be responsible for leading large-scale technology initiatives from concept through implementation and operationalization. You will coordinate work across multiple engineering and business organizations, ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into executable plans and delivered successfully.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with sufficient technical depth to engage effectively with engineers, architects, and technology leaders. You are passionate about execution, organizational effectiveness, continuous improvement, and enabling teams to deliver complex technology solutions at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs from initiation through deployment and operational readiness.
* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans that account for dependencies, risks, resource requirements, milestones, and evolving business priorities.
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, operations, and business stakeholders.
* Establish clear program objectives, success metrics, execution strategies, and delivery mechanisms.
* Proactively identify, manage, and resolve risks, issues, dependencies, and organizational blockers.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for program status, ensuring stakeholders have timely, accurate, and actionable information.
* Drive effective decision-making by facilitating discussions, evaluating tradeoffs, and escalating issues when necessary.
* Coordinate delivery across multiple teams, ensuring dependencies are understood, managed, and communicated effectively.
* Develop executive-ready communications, dashboards, status updates, presentations, and program reviews.
* Lead planning sessions, steering committees, roadmap reviews, operational reviews, and stakeholder meetings.
* Establish governance, reporting, and operational mechanisms that improve transparency, predictability, and execution effectiveness.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve delivery processes, operating models, planning practices, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ensure programs meet organizational standards for security, compliance, risk management, operational readiness, and business continuity.
* Utilize metrics and data-driven insights to assess program health, communicate outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support strategic planning, portfolio management, roadmap development, prioritization, and organizational scaling initiatives.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and customer focus.

**All About You:**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Experience leading large-scale technical programs involving multiple engineering teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives within software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, data, or technology organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated plans, coordinate dependencies, mitigate risks, and drive successful delivery outcomes.
* Experience communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience managing competing priorities and delivering results in fast-paced, evolving environments.
* Ability to influence across organizations without direct authority.
* Experience working with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation and reporting.
* Experience working within highly collaborative, cross-functional technology organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting cloud platforms, developer platforms, AI/ML platforms, data platforms, infrastructure platforms, or enterprise software systems.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, system architecture, cloud computing, and modern technology delivery practices.
* Experience supporting platform adoption, developer enablement, operational excellence, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Experience establishing delivery governance, operational reviews, portfolio management, or enterprise planning practices.
* Experience working within regulated environments requiring strong security, governance, compliance, and risk management controls.
* PMP, PgMP, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable program management certifications.
* Experience supporting large-scale platform modernization or digital transformation initiatives.

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

**The role**

As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of a defined workstream within large-scale GPU and data center infrastructure deployment programs. In this role you’ll be responsible for tracking progress, managing dependencies, and ensuring your workstream is delivered on time and at quality.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of infrastructure, execution, and coordination, with strong exposure to real-world data center delivery.

Travel: On-site presence at data centers will be required during key deployment phases.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Own delivery of a defined workstream within a larger data center or infrastructure program.
* Track scope, schedule, and dependencies, escalating risks when needed.
* Coordinate with engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting on progress, risks, and blockers.
* Support vendor and contractor coordination within your scope.
* Work closely with the Senior TPM to align on priorities and execution approach.

**Technical Scope & Expectations**

This role requires exposure to physical infrastructure environments, not only software-based projects.

**You Should Be Comfortable Working With Or Learning About**

* Data center environments: basic understanding of infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, networking dependencies).
* Compute infrastructure: knowledge about server and storage equipment.
* Networking: cabling, connectivity, and integration dependencies.
* Deployment & bring-up: understanding how systems move from installation to operational readiness.

You are not expected to be an expert, but you should:

* Be willing to learn technical concepts quickly.
* Understand how different parts of infrastructure depend on each other.
* Identify when something is not ready or at risk and escalate appropriately.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams.

**We Expect You To Have**

* 2–5 years of experience in program management, operations, or technical coordination roles.
* Ability to organize work, track progress, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.
* Structured thinking and attention to details.
* Willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, technical environment.

**It will be an added bonus if you have**

* Exposure to data center, networking, or hardware-related projects,
* Familiarity with program management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.),
* Understanding of cloud environments infrastructure,
* Certifications or coursework in program management.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

* Establish and maintain CMMS equipment files, parts inventory, equipment bill of materials, and Program Manager schedules.

7febc02a.title: Program Manager III
7febc02a.description:
General Atomics is seeking a Technical Program Manager III to support the planning, execution, and technical performance of one or more established engineering programs based in New Delhi, India.
  
  
Reporting to a senior program manager, this position is responsible for supporting assigned programs from initiation through delivery while managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, technical performance, resources, and customer relationships. The role will coordinate with engineering, operations, contracts, finance, suppliers, business partners, and company leadership across India and internationally. This will work effectively with India-based customers, government representatives, suppliers, and business partners, as well as internal teams in the United States and other locations. The position requires sound technical judgment, strong program leadership, and the ability to resolve complex execution issues in a multicultural and multinational environment.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Support all phases of assigned programs, including initiation, acquisition support, planning, execution, integration, testing, delivery, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain program plans, schedules, budgets, risk assessments, performance metrics, and delivery methods.
* Manage program scope, cost, schedule, quality, technical performance, and customer commitments.
* Coordinate with engineering and technical teams to establish design concepts, technical criteria, development activities, testing plans, and integration objectives.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for program-related issues and coordinate the resolution of technical, schedule, cost, quality, and resource concerns.
* Establish effective working relationships with India-based customers, government representatives, suppliers, business partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Communicate program status, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions to customers, senior leadership, and cross-functional teams.
* Support program reviews, technical interchange meetings, customer briefings, and executive presentations.
* Coordinate the preparation of proposals, business plans, statements of work, specifications, operating budgets, and contract terms and conditions.
* Support contract acquisition, negotiations, modifications, and customer engagements in coordination with contracts and business development teams.
* Identify program issues and support the development of solutions, including resource reallocation, schedule recovery actions, process improvements, and changes to contract requirements.
* Manage cross-functional teams and, where applicable, accomplish program objectives through subordinate managers or team leads.
* Support the recruitment, development, retention, and performance of the management, professional, and technical personnel required for program execution.
* Contribute to new business development, expansion of existing programs, and potential partnerships or strategic alliances in India and the broader Asia-Pacific region.
* Coordinate activities across India-based and international teams, including communication, decision-making, schedules, and deliverables.
* Support compliance with applicable company policies, contractual requirements, export-control obligations, security requirements, and Indian laws and regulations.
* Protect proprietary technology and maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive company, customer, and program information.
* Perform other duties as assigned or required.

57d64fe9.title: Senior Public Transportation Architect
57d64fe9.description:
**Overall Summary**

  

The Senior Public Transportation Architect serves as a senior technical delivery professional responsible for the planning, design, and multidisciplinary coordination of complex transit infrastructure and public transportation facility projects. The role is intended for an experienced engineer-architect who can lead technical workstreams, coordinate across disciplines, support client and stakeholder discussions, and deliver practical, sustainable, and operationally effective transit facilities.

  

The role supports projects such as transit stations, bus rapid transit facilities, multimodal transportation hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, park-and-ride facilities, passenger transfer facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure. The position is focused on technical excellence, project delivery, design integration, quality, and mentoring within multidisciplinary transit infrastructure teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead planning, programming, architectural design, and construction support for transit stations, multimodal hubs, maintenance facilities, BRT facilities, operations centers, and other transportation infrastructure projects.
* Serve as Lead Architect, Design Lead, or Discipline Lead for complex transit infrastructure assignments, ensuring that architectural deliverables are coordinated, technically sound, and aligned with project requirements.
* Coordinate and integrate architectural solutions with civil, structural, geotechnical, MEP, rail systems, communications, traction power, transportation planning, operations, safety, security, sustainability, and digital delivery disciplines.
* Develop facility concepts that balance passenger experience, operational efficiency, accessibility, safety, maintainability, resiliency, sustainability, lifecycle performance, and future expansion needs.
* Prepare, review, and coordinate design criteria, reports, technical memoranda, drawings, specifications, BIM models, and contract documents across project phases.
* Support project managers with scope management, schedule coordination, budget awareness, resource planning, risk reviews, and quality assurance for architectural and facility-related tasks.
* Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews, constructability reviews, value engineering sessions, and technical quality reviews to improve project outcomes.
* Interface with client teams to present design concepts, resolve technical issues, and support approvals.
* Support construction-phase services including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and coordinating design clarifications.
* Promote BIM coordination, digital delivery workflows, and innovative approaches to improve quality, coordination, and delivery efficiency.
* Mentor architects, engineers, designers, and BIM/modeling staff.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Bachelors degree in Architecture or related engineering field from an accredited institution.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in architecture, transportation facilities, transit infrastructure, or complex public infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 8 years of experience delivering rail, metro, BRT, bus, or multimodal transportation facility projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and coordinating with civil, structural, MEP, systems, operations, safety, and sustainability disciplines.
* Experience supporting project delivery through multiple phases, including planning, feasibility, conceptual design, detailed design, procurement support, and construction support.
* Strong working knowledge of accessibility requirements, sustainable design principles, and public infrastructure design requirements.
* Strong communication, coordination, and technical leadership skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Masters degree in Architecture, Urban Design, Transportation Planning, or a related field.
* Experience with transit stations, rail/metro facilities, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and storage facilities, operations centers, passenger facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure.
* Experience integrating architecture with rail systems, transit operations, maintenance requirements, transportation engineering, and public realm design.
* Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, CM/GC, or other alternative delivery methods.
* Proficiency with BIM, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and digital delivery workflows.
* Experience delivering large-scale transit infrastructure projects for North American, Middle East, or other international clients.

  

**Primary Focus**

  

Transit stations, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, and fleet electrification infrastructure.

  
  

**Delivery Role**

  

Leads and coordinates with civil, structural, MEP, rail systems, operations, safety, sustainability, and digital delivery teams
